jobs.description:
Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our LATAM engineering team. You will design and build the backend systems that power Jeeves's financial platform — working across payments, cards, spend management, and compliance infrastructure that serves businesses across the Americas and beyond.
This is a backend engineering role at its core, we're looking for a strong backend engineer who knows how to work effectively with AI tools, understands where AI can accelerate development and product capabilities, and is comfortable integrating AI-powered features into production backend systems.
Given the global nature of our business and the collaborative nature of our team, fluency in English is required for daily work with engineering, product, and business teams across multiple regions. Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is equally required — our LATAM teams, customers, and operational partners work in both languages, and you will too.
Location: This is a full-time remote position.

What You'll Do:

    Backend Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable backend services that process financial transactions and serve Jeeves customers across 20+ countries.
  • Write clean, testable, production-quality code in Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript; participate actively in design and code reviews.
  • Build and consume RESTful and GraphQL APIs; design inter-service communication using gRPC, message queues, and event-driven architectures.
  • Design and optimize relational and non-relational database schemas (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis) for correctness, performance, and scale.
  • Own backend features end-to-end — from scoping and technical design through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Implement security best practices: authentication, authorization, input validation, and data protection across distributed services.

    • AI-Assisted Feature Development

  • Integrate LLM API calls (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) into backend services as product features — such as spend categorization, document parsing, or natural language workflows — ensuring those integrations are reliable, observable, and cost-efficient.
  • Build backend pipelines that consume AI-generated outputs safely: validate structured outputs, handle fallback scenarios, and design graceful degradation when AI services are unavailable or return low-confidence results.
  • Collaborate with AI and data science teams to integrate model outputs into backend APIs — bridging experimental AI work and production systems.
  • Use AI coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) fluently as part of your everyday development workflow.

    • Reliability & Operations

  • Instrument services with structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics for full operational visibility.
  • Participate in on-call rotation; respond to production incidents and contribute to post-incident reviews.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline improvements, testing infrastructure, and deployment practices.

    • Cross-Regional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, product, compliance, and data teams across multiple time zones and regions — communicating in both English and Spanish or Portuguese as the situation requires.
  • Contribute to a globally distributed engineering culture through thorough documentation, async design reviews, and thoughtful pull request feedback.
  • Bring your regional perspective to product and engineering conversations — our LATAM customers have specific needs, and engineers who understand those markets make our product better.

Requirements:

    Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience building and operating production systems.

  • Fluent in English — professional fluency required for daily work with global teams in written and spoken contexts.

  • Fluent in Spanish or Portuguese — required for collaboration with LATAM teammates, customers, and operational partners.

  • Strong proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, or Node.js/TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and building RESTful APIs, microservices, and event-driven backend systems.

  • Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred): schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate third-party APIs reliably in production — including error handling, retry logic, and observability.

  • Experience working on globally distributed teams across time zones and regions.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of everyday engineering work — integrating LLM API outputs into backend services and using AI coding assistants fluently.

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, payments, or a regulated industry — familiarity with ledger systems, payment rails, or financial compliance (KYC/AML, PCI-DSS) is a strong plus.

  • Prior experience at a startup or high-growth scale-up, comfortable building in ambiguity without heavy process support.

  • Experience with multi-currency systems or cross-border payment processing.

  • Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture.

  • Global work experience — prior roles at companies operating across multiple countries and regulatory environments.

  • Fluency in both Spanish and Portuguese is a meaningful additional asset.

Job Description: SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC) Technical Architect
Role Summary
The SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC) Technical Architect will lead the design, configuration, integration, and deployment of SAP MBC for global payment processing and Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) integration within the SAP S/4HANA landscape.
The architect will collaborate closely with Finance, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Banking Partners, SAP Basis, Security, Integration, and Functional teams. The primary objective is to establish a secure, scalable, and compliant banking architecture supporting outbound payments, inbound bank statements, cash reporting, and bank communication standards.
Key Responsibilities
MBC Solution Architecture
  • End-to-End Design: Architect comprehensive SAP MBC solutions for global banking connectivity.
  • Integration Strategy: Define and govern integration pathways between SAP S/4HANA, SAP MBC, Corporate Banking Partners, the SWIFT Network, and Payment Service Providers (PSPs).
  • Connectivity Frameworks: Establish robust connection frameworks for high-volume payment and statement processing.
Payment Integration
  • Outbound Architecture: Design global outbound payment processes, including ACH, Wire Transfers, SEPA, EFT, International Payments, and Intercompany Payments.
  • Format Configuration: Configure and support Payment Medium Workbench (PMW), DMEE/DMEEX trees, modern payment file formats, and payment batch processing (e.g., SAP Batch Loss / BCM).
  • Treasury Controls: Ensure payment approvals and release workflows strictly align with Corporate Treasury controls.
Bank Statement Processing
  • Inbound EBS Architecture: Design and optimize inbound EBS workflows.
  • Format Implementation: Deploy global and regional message formats, including MT940, CAMT.053, CAMT.054, BAI2, and localized formats.
  • Clearing & Posting: Configure EBS posting rules, interpretation algorithms, automatic clearing rules, and Lockbox integration.
Integration & Middleware
  • Middleware Design: Lead technical integration designs leveraging SAP BTP Integration Suite, SAP Cloud Connector, SAP PI/PO (where applicable), APIs, and SFTP channels.
  • Monitoring & Alerts: Define comprehensive application monitoring, error-handling, and automated alert frameworks.
Treasury & Cash Management Support
  • Treasury Partnership: Collaborate with Treasury teams on Bank Account Management (BAM) integration, cash positioning, cash reporting, and liquidity planning.
  • Module Compatibility: Ensure seamless compatibility with SAP Cash Management and SAP Treasury and Risk Management (TRM).
Security & Compliance
  • Banking Security: Design secure data transmission architectures utilizing PGP encryption, digital certificates, TLS/SSL, advanced authentication, and strict Segregation of Duties (SoD).
  • Audit Readiness: Support corporate audit and regulatory compliance frameworks, including SOX and internal financial control standards.
Testing & Deployment
  • Lifecycle Management: Lead System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), End-to-End Payment Testing, and Bank Certification Testing.
  • Cutover Orchestration: Develop meticulous technical deployment plans, production cutover procedures, and rollback strategies.
Required Qualifications
Experience
  • SAP Finance & Treasury: 10+ years of architectural experience in SAP Finance and Treasury ecosystems.
  • SAP MBC Expertise: 5+ years of hands-on experience implementing SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC).
  • S/4HANA Lifecycle: Minimum of 3 completed end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementations.
  • Global Exposure: Proven track record managing global payment processing and complex international banking integrations.
Technical Skills
  • SAP Modules: SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP Cash Management, SAP Treasury (TRM), SAP Bank Account Management (BAM), and SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC).
  • Payment Technologies: PMW, DMEE/DMEEX, ISO 20022 message standards (PAIN, CAMT), ACH, EFT, SEPA, and Global Wire systems.
  • Bank Statements: MT940, CAMT.053, CAMT.054, and BAI2.
  • Integration Ecosystem: SAP BTP Integration Suite, API Management, REST/SOAP Web Services, SFTP, and SAP Cloud Connector.
  • Security & Crypto: PGP Encryption, Digital Certificates/Asymmetric Key Pairs, TLS/SSL, and SAP Authorization concepts.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP Treasury Certification or SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting Certification.
  • Hands-on experience with modern SAP BTP Integration Suite capabilities.
  • Background in highly regulated industries (e.g., Medical Devices or Manufacturing).
  • Experience deploying multi-country banking solutions, with specific exposure to North America, Ireland, and Mexico banking requirements.
Nice-to-Have Experience (Integer Context)
  • Working in complex, multi-company code environments.
  • Establishing payment processing workflows within Shared Service Center (SSC) models.
  • Supporting Global Treasury Operations and corporate intercompany settlements.
  • Automating Electronic Bank Statements (EBS) and migrating legacy formats to modern ISO 20022 standards.
Key Deliverables
  1. MBC Architecture Design Document (ADD)
  2. Global Banking Connectivity Strategy
  3. Payment File Design Specifications
  4. DMEE/DMEEX & PMW Technical Layouts
  5. EBS Processing, Content Mapping, and Posting Rules Design
  6. Security, Encryption, and Compliance Architecture Specifications
  7. Interface & Integration Specifications
  8. End-to-End Test Scenarios, Scripts, and Validated Results
  9. Production Cutover & Technical Go-Live Plan
  10. Hypercare Support Documentation

jobs.description:
Company Background

HyAxiom Inc., A Doosan Company (Formerly Doosan Fuel Cell America, Inc.) is a global leader in clean energy solutions founded on the strength of the people and technology developed at United Technologies over the past fifty years, paired with the unparalleled support from the Doosan Group, our parent company. We are committed to advancing a hydrogen-led future of clean and sustainable energy in the United States and elsewhere around the world.

Come join our Team!

Job Information

As an Associate or Manager, Strategy & Business Development, you will help drive the company’s highest-priority strategic and growth initiatives.

Working closely with senior leaders across the organization, the Associate or Manager will operate at the intersection of corporate strategy, strategic finance and business development. The role will combine rigorous financial and market analysis with hands-on execution of strategic initiatives, new business opportunities, and partnerships. Depending on experience, the successful candidate will either support or independently lead key analyses and workstreams, with increasing responsibility for developing recommendations, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and driving initiatives from analysis through execution.

This is an opportunity for an individual with a strong foundation in investment banking, investing, management consulting, corporate development, or a similarly rigorous analytical environment to transition into a broad operating role with exposure to executive decision-making, energy markets, customers and major corporate initiatives.

Level will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, capabilities, and demonstrated scope of responsibility.

Location: Onsite or Remote, with approximately 10-20% travel, including occasional trips to HyAxiom’s headquarters in Connecticut and conferences.

*If onsite: South Windsor office, CT

Role & Responsibility

  • Corporate Strategy & Strategic Initiatives (40%)
    • Drive or support, depending on experience, execution and performance management of the company’s portfolio of strategic initiatives, including annual and long-term KPI establishment, performance monitoring, cross-functional coordination and identification of areas requiring management action.
    • Partner with Finance and other functions to translate the company’s strategic priorities, market outlook and competitive positioning into fact-based analyses supporting major strategic and capital-markets decisions.
    • Conduct scenario, sensitivity, valuation and investment analyses to support executive decision-making and capital-markets readiness.
    • Develop recommendations on the strategic and economic implications of major growth opportunities, investments and commercial decisions.
    • Develop concise, executive-ready analyses and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Market & Competitive Intelligence (20%)
    • Conduct market research, market sizing and industry trend analysis across technologies, customers, competitors and potential growth markets.
    • Analyze public companies using financial statements, SEC filings, earnings materials, investor presentations and valuation frameworks; perform comparablecompany and competitive benchmarking analyses.
    • Develop investment-style perspectives on competitors and relevant public-market peers, including business model, growth, profitability, valuation and investor positioning.
    • Translate market and competitive intelligence into implications and recommendations for company strategy.
  • Business Development & Strategic Partnerships (40%)
    • Support and, depending on experience, lead early-stage engagement with prospective customers and strategic partners.
    • Develop financial and commercial models to evaluate potential opportunities and partnerships.
    • Assess customer economics, project economics, pricing structures and alternative commercial models.
    • Support the structuring, negotiation and evaluation of strategic partnerships and other growth opportunities.
    • Prepare customer and partner presentations, proposals, and other commercial materials.

Eligibility & Job Requirements

Education & Professional Credentials

    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or another quantitative discipline
    • Master’s or additional coursework / certifications in strategy, analytics, or finance are a plus.

ExperienceRequired

    • Associate: typically, ~3-5 years of relevant experience; Manager: typically, ~5-8 years of relevant experience in -- investment banking, investment management, private equity, management consulting, corporate strategy, corporate development or a similarly rigorous analytical environment. Level and title will be determined based on experience, capabilities and demonstrated scope of responsibility.
    • Strong financial modeling, valuation and financial statement analysis skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to analyze public companies and synthesize financial, strategic and market information into an investment or strategic point of view.
    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Ability to structure and solve complex, ambiguous business problems.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex analyses into concise, executive-ready insights.
    • High level of ownership, attention to detail and execution discipline; ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across functions.

Preferred

    • Investment banking or investing experience, particularly within Power & Utilities, Energy, Industrials, Infrastructure, Technology or related sectors.
    • Strong familiarity with public markets, capital markets, public-company financial reporting and investor perspectives.
    • Exposure to IPOs, equity capital markets transactions, investor-facing work or public-company readiness initiatives.
    • Experience conducting company, industry and investment analysis and developing comparable company / valuation frameworks.
    • Familiarity with Capital IQ, AlphaSense, FactSet, Bloomberg or similar platforms.
    • Interest in energy, power infrastructure, data centers and emerging energy technologies.

Other

Why Join HyAxiom?

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Nebius is looking for a Principal Product Marketing Manager to set the direction for our enterprise story: the narrative, messaging, and go-to-market strategy that turn Nebius’s full-stack differentiation into pipeline and revenue with mid-market and enterprise buyers.

You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.

This is a role for a recognized enterprise product marketing leader from B2B cloud or AI infrastructure who has shaped category narratives and led complex go-to-market motions, and can prove it through the messaging they built, the programs they orchestrated, and the revenue outcomes behind them. You understand the AI cloud stack well enough to earn credibility with engineering leaders, and you know what it takes to move a complex enterprise buying committee (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Data/AI Officers, CISOs, VPs of Infrastructure, security and procurement teams) through a 6–18-month cycle. You set the strategy and frameworks that others execute against, and you measure your impact in win rates, pipeline influenced, and field adoption, not assets shipped.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Marketing, you will be the senior voice for how Nebius positions itself to the enterprise and a force multiplier for the organization: setting the enterprise go-to-market strategy across product lines, guiding and mentoring other product marketers, and equipping sales, solutions architecture, and partnerships to carry the story into the field. You will work directly with senior leaders across product, engineering, sales, and executive leadership as a trusted strategic partner.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Set the enterprise narrative and positioning strategy. Own the enterprise layer of the Nebius story end to end, from our “ultimate AI cloud” positioning down to persona-specific messaging, and define the frameworks and standards that other product marketers and content teams build on. Translate our differentiators and each layer of the cloud stack (custom GPU servers, AI orchestration and MLOps tooling, Token Factory, and our agentic layer) into credible messaging that resonates with technical and business decision-makers alike.
  • Lead enterprise go-to-market strategy across products and launches. Define the enterprise go-to-market plan across the Nebius portfolio, set priorities and sequencing for major launches, and drive alignment across product, sales, solutions architecture, partnerships, and marketing. Make the trade-offs on where to focus and invest, and hold cross-functional teams accountable to shared outcomes.
  • Design and own the enterprise customer journey. Own the logic and strategy of the 6–18-month enterprise buying cycle, defining what moves a buyer at each stage from awareness to evaluation, decision, and expansion. Set the plays, content, and touchpoints for each stage and partner with digital/ABX and field marketing leaders to sequence and target them by account, using ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase.
  • Build the enterprise business case. Develop the messaging, proof, and business case around what enterprises actually evaluate: total cost of ownership, reliability and SLAs, security and compliance, data sovereignty and residency, migration risk, and vendor lock-in. Equip Nebius to win through security review, procurement, and the CFO’s office, and engage directly with senior executives on strategic deals.
  • Drive enablement strategy and field adoption. Set the enablement strategy for sales, solutions, and partner teams, and ensure they can articulate Nebius’s value to every persona on the buying committee: first-call decks, battlecards, discovery guides, ROI/TCO tools, objection handling, and competitive positioning against hyperscalers and neoclouds. Lead enablement programs and measure adoption, win rates, and deals influenced.
  • Own competitive and category positioning. Maintain a sharp, evidence-based view of the AI enterprise infrastructure landscape and help shape how the category is defined. Turn market and competitive intelligence into positioning the field can defend and campaigns can lead with, and keep Nebius’s differentiation current as the market moves.
  • Lead the enterprise content and proof strategy. Define the enterprise asset strategy and own quality across the library: solution briefs, white papers, reference architectures, case studies, web pages, webinars, and videos. Personally produce the most strategic pieces and set the bar for the rest.
  • Elevate communications, analyst, and investor narratives. Shape the enterprise narrative for press moments, site launches, analyst briefings, and investor materials, in close coordination with comms, legal, and executive leadership. Serve as a spokesperson and subject matter expert for the enterprise story in analyst, customer, and industry settings.
  • Champion the voice of the customer. Partner with sales and customer marketing to build a pipeline of references, case studies, and proof points, and bring enterprise pain points and wins back into product strategy and messaging.
  • Mentor and multiply. Coach and guide other product marketers and cross-functional contributors, establish best practices, messaging methodologies, and workshop frameworks (such as SCIPAB), and raise the quality and consistency of product marketing across the organization.
  • Contribute strategically at the leadership table. Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, and help shape how we position Nebius in a fast-moving AI infrastructure market. Act as a trusted partner to product, engineering, sales, and partnerships leaders, with a seat at the table, not just as a content source.

We expect you to have:

  • 8+ years in product marketing, with a strong track record leading enterprise go-to-market in cloud infrastructure or AI infrastructure (ideally the AI cloud market) at a growing, modern company.
  • Proven ownership of the enterprise segment across the marketing lifecycle, with the ability to speak to win rates, pipeline data, and revenue impact on significant enterprise deals.
  • Demonstrated experience setting go-to-market strategy and leading cross-functional launches across multiple products or product lines, influencing leaders without direct authority.
  • Hands-on experience designing and orchestrating multi-stage enterprise customer journeys across long (6–18 month) buying cycles, and running account-based programs on ABM platforms such as 6sense or Demandbase in partnership with digital/ABX teams, with clear, measurable outcomes.
  • Strong technical understanding of AI/ML workflows and the AI cloud infrastructure stack: GPU platforms and the NVIDIA ecosystem, networking, storage, IaaS, inference, and ML tools (e.g., PyTorch, Ray, Slurm, MLflow, Kubernetes, inference and agentic platforms), with the ability to go deep with engineers and translate up for executives and business buyers.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

Alignable is the largest online network for small business owners, with more than 10 million members across North America. The mission is simple: help small businesses grow through trusted relationships.

Members use Alignable to find out who in their network can help them next. Sometimes that's a warm introduction, sometimes a referral, sometimes advice from someone who's been there. It works because it isn't transactional. Owners help each other, and growth built on trust lasts.

We're also one of the most AI-forward companies serving small businesses. Allie, Alignable's AI assistant, is live today for every paid member, helping them find the right people in their network and pick the next step. A version of Allie for free members is next. The growth team works the same way. AI is in the daily work, not a side project.

What you will bring:

    Our activation team gets new members started. Our retention team keeps paying members around. This role owns the middle: free members who are active, getting value, and not paying yet. Your job is to spot who's ready and give them a reason to say yes.

    This role is a senior individual contributor. You do the work yourself. Pull the data, form the hypothesis, build the test, read the result, tell the team what happened. Nobody hands you a test plan. You'll have one upgrade target that's yours, and you'll work closely with Activation, Retention, Product, Engineering, and Data to make it all happen.

    This is closer to growth engineering than traditional marketing. The tools we have will get you a long way. Where they don't, you'll build what's missing, with an engineer or with AI.

What you will own:

    Active member conversion

  • Free to paid conversion for active members in the segments you target, against an upgrade target and a known baseline
  • Finding the ready-to-buy moments in product usage data, and building the offers, prompts, and paths that turn them into upgrades
  • Mapping the path from activated to paid, messy real-world details included, and fixing where it breaks

    • Allie as a conversion channel

  • Defining where Allie conversations with free members should lead to an upgrade, in the app and in the Allie experience
  • Partnering with Product on the free version of Allie so it's built to convert from day one
  • Product and Engineering build Allie. You make sure Allie drives upgrades.

    • What's free and what's worth paying for

  • Figuring out which features drive upgrades and which belong in the free plan
  • Testing offers, paywall moments, and the story about why paying is worth it
  • Bringing the evidence to pricing and packaging decisions, which get made with leadership

    • Tests are how you get there. Upgrades and revenue are how we keep score.

Who thrives at Alignable:

    You get restless when a number sits flat. You don't judge a week by what shipped. You judge it by whether more people paid. When you're behind, you dig in, find another angle, and keep going until it moves.

This role is NOT for you if:

    • You'd rather perfect a plan than ship a test this week
    • A missed target feels like someone else's problem
    • Fine results feel like a finish line

What you will bring:

    • 5 to 8 years in growth, conversion, lifecycle, or product-led growth
    • Personal ownership of a free to paid, trial to paid, or upsell lift, with the numbers to back it up
    • A history of being held to a revenue or conversion target, including at least one time you were behind and closed the gap
    • Fluency with product usage data. You turn what you find into testable hypotheses.
    • Comfort shipping experiments. You prototype with AI coding tools and work closely with engineers to get changes into production.
    • AI in how you work every day: analysis, writing, building, testing
    • You run on your own. Give you a target and the context, and you'll figure out the first move.
    • You can tailor a message to a specific audience and make paying feel like the obvious next step
    • Experience at a subscription or freemium company where users upgrade on their own

      • Nice to have:

    • Performance marketing, paid acquisition, or social targeting
    • Small business customers and imperfect, real-world data
    • Startup experience, or something you built from scratch

What success looks like:

    • First 30 days: your first tests are live and at least one target segment is moving against its baseline.
    • By month 3: upgrade rates in your target segments are clearly up, and you can show your work caused it.
    • By month 6: upgrade rates in your target segments are multiples of where they started. Allie is a proven upgrade channel for free members. The people you converted are still paying 90 days later.

Why Alignable?

    • AI at the Center of Your Work: You'll use AI every day for the work that matters most, like analyzing data, shaping hypotheses, writing and testing messages, and building experiments. It's how you think and ship, not just a shortcut for busywork.
    • Impact & Mission: Your work helps more small business owners get real value from Alignable and Allie, and grow through the people they already know.
    • Team & Environment: Work directly with Alignable's founders and growth leaders, with room to test ideas fast and see the results.
    • Compensation & Benefits: $135,000 to $180,000 base salary plusuncappedvariable pay tied to your results (see Compensation below). Plus unlimited vacation, comprehensive health benefits, paid parental leave, a flexible remote/hybrid working model, professional development reimbursement, a $500 new hire home office setup, and a 401(k) program.
    • Diversity & Inclusion: We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe they create stronger businesses and better outcomes.

Our culture in action:

  • 🎉 Enjoy the Journey: We're passionate about our mission but don't take ourselves too seriously. We celebrate customers, teammates, and key moments.
  • 🤝 Be Stronger Together: We combine strengths, build trusted relationships, and treat everyone as partners. No egos welcome.
  • 🌈 Be Different Together: We create space for everyone to show up as their truest selves and seek diverse perspectives.
  • 👑 Act Like an Owner: We proactively act on behalf of the entire company and customers, not just ourselves. No passing the buck.
  • 🎯 Change the Game: We start with first principles, assume nothing is impossible, and go after 10x outcomes relentlessly.
  • 📈 Adapt & Evolve: We accept we won't be right every time and create an environment where people feel safe to admit failure and lean into learning.
  • 🧠 Exercise Excellent Judgment: We turn knowledge into understanding based on equal parts data and intuition.
  • ⚡ Profound Bias for Action: Speed matters. We value calculated risk-taking while avoiding one-way doors.
  • ❤️ Be Customer Obsessed: We work vigorously to earn and keep customer trust in everything we decide to work on and how we do it.

Position Summary

The Project Claims & Commercial Controls Manager is a strategic commercial leader responsible for protecting project profitability through proactive contract administration, change order management, claims strategy, commercial risk management, and financial oversight across the project portfolio.

Reporting to the CFO, this role serves as an independent partner between Finance and Operations, ensuring contractual entitlements, customer change orders, commercial risks, supplier exposure, and project financial assumptions are identified, documented, challenged, and resolved before they impact project margins.

The successful candidate combines project management experience with strong commercial, contractual, and financial expertise to improve commercial discipline, maximize customer recovery, minimize risk, and strengthen project financial performance.

This position works closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Program Directors, Finance, Operations, Executive Leadership, customers, and subcontractors. While Project Managers retain ownership of project execution and customer relationships, this role provides independent commercial oversight, governance, and strategic support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with project teams to identify scope changes, schedule impacts, engineering changes, and other events requiring commercial action.
  • Monitor and oversee the change order process to ensure timely submission of supporting documentation, proactive project manager follow-up, and adherence to commercial deadlines.
  • Monitor aging commercial issues, drive accountability, and escalate unresolved risks.
  • Support the timely development and submission of Extension of Time (EOT) requests, equitable adjustment proposals, cost recovery claims, and settlement proposals to ensure successful commercial outcomes.
  • Perform schedule delay, disruption, and cost impact analyses in collaboration with the project Operations and Engineering leads to support claims, negotiations, and dispute resolution.
  • Review and evaluate project documentation and deliverables to develop and support commercial strategies for successful change order pursuits
  • Proactively identify commercial, contractual, financial, and operational risks impacting project performance.
  • Support Cost-to-Complete (CTC) reviews with respect to change order impacts / assessed likelihood of outcome
  • Provide Finance and Executive Leadership with visibility into commercial exposure, margin risk, recovery opportunities, and expected financial impacts.

Negotiation & Leadership

  • Lead or support negotiations involving change orders, claims, and contract disputes.
  • Partner with Project Management, Operations, Finance, and Legal to develop commercial strategies and mitigate risk.
  • Establish commercial controls, governance processes, and documentation standards.
  • Coach project teams on contract compliance, commercial awareness, and change management.
  • Escalate significant commercial risks and unresolved issues to executive leadership as appropriate.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, Finance, Quantity Surveying, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in project-based industries with increasing responsibility in commercial management, project management, claims, contracts, or project controls.
  • Strong background in customer change orders, claims management, contract administration, and commercial negotiations.
  • Experience with project financial controls, budgeting, forecasting, and Cost-to-Complete (CTC) management.

  • Experience in material handling, automation, systems integration, industrial construction, manufacturing, or other complex engineered project environments is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to travel as required to project sites and customer locations.

Preferred Skills

  • Commercial contract administration
  • Claims preparation and negotiation
  • Change order management
  • Delay and disruption analysis
  • Cost impact analysis and financial forecasting
  • Cost-to-Complete (CTC) management
  • Commercial risk assessment and mitigation
  • Executive communication and presentation
  • Contract interpretation and compliance
  • Supplier and subcontractor commercial management
  • Project scheduling and scope management
  • Conflict resolution and negotiation

The ideal candidate is a confident, analytical, and commercially minded leader who is comfortable challenging assumptions, driving accountability, and influencing cross-functional teams. They possess exceptional business judgment, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to balance customer relationships with disciplined commercial decision-making.

This individual thrives in complex project environments, takes ownership of unresolved issues, and proactively identifies opportunities to improve commercial performance while protecting company profitability.

About the Community Economic Defense Project (CEDP) & CED Law

Our Mission

We partner with low-income and working people to build economic and racial equity. We do this by confronting economic abuse and investing in community wealth. We use an ever-evolving set of legal, economic and advocacy tools to challenge and dismantle unjust systems, building quickly towards a world where all people have what they need to live and thrive.

Our Organization

The Community Economic Defense Project (CEDP) is a Colorado-based nonprofit. Launched in 2020 as the COVID-19 Eviction Defense Project, our organization was formed to keep our neighbors housed during the pandemic. Working with clients, we built a deeply integrative approach to eviction, foreclosure, and homelessness prevention that centers the legal and financial needs of housing-insecure families and uses a variety of tools to keep them housed.

Our team now serves more than 1,000 people per month, bringing together housing lawyers, economists, data analysts, policy-experts, organizers, and technologists to serve our clients. We have served more than 68,000 low-income Coloradans across 54 counties, distributing more than $280 million in emergency assistance. We have also contributed to the passage of major legislation to prevent eviction, stop economic abuse, and make credit and life-saving medication cheaper. CEDP’s model has been cited as a best practice by the White House and HUD in 2022-2023, think tanks like the Urban Institute, and in the media.

Building on our work to stop evictions, CEDP has further expanded its integrated services model to include disaster response, predatory towing, debt collection, benefit access & navigation, long-term rental assistance, and homelessness response. Similar to CEDP’s work on rental housing, these efforts offer a continuum of care that includes navigation and advisory services, targeted payments, legal support, and the ability to participate in advocacy.

jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a builder role at the intersection of AI, customer experience, and operational excellence. You'll be the single accountable owner of Sophia, Bullhorn Support's customer-facing self-service AI agent (built on Salesforce Agentforce), driving measurable case deflection while keeping the customer experience excellent.

You'll inherit strong foundational tooling but will need to diagnose gaps, tune the agent, establish guardrails and governance, and build the measure-and-improve cadences that make self-service durable at scale. This role owns and tunes the system; it doesn't require building it from scratch or writing production code.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • End-to-end ownership of Sophia: configuration, prompting, performance, and success, including subagents, topics, actions, routing, escalation-to-case, and guardrails.
  • Designing, testing, and iterating the prompts and instructions that drive the agent's behavior, tone, and accuracy, validated in sandbox with regression testing before every production release.
  • Case deflection and containment targets: defining them, driving them, and reporting on them, while protecting CSAT.
  • Production monitoring and QA: reviewing transcripts, tracking accuracy and drift, and catching regressions early.
  • Guardrails, human-in-the-loop policies, and responsible-AI practices, with a rollback plan for every change.
  • Connecting internal and external self-service, and representing Support's needs into Bullhorn's internal AI knowledge initiative.
  • Partnering across Support Operations, CX Data & Analytics, Enablement, and platform/vendor contacts, and providing executive-level updates on self-service performance.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 4+ years in support operations, customer experience, conversational/AI design, or a self-service/deflection role at a SaaS or technology company, including hands-on ownership of a self-service or AI support capability.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and tuning conversational AI agents in production (Agentforce strongly preferred), including Agent Script.
  • Prompt engineering experience: designing, testing, and iterating prompts to improve accuracy and behavior.
  • Proven case deflection results using self-service AI tooling, with the ability to use data and conversation analysis to evolve self-service over time.
  • Salesforce Service Cloud (case management) and Experience Cloud (customer portal) experience. •

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with other AI-assisted support tools and BI/data-visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Salesforce reports).
  • Background in staffing, HR tech, or enterprise SaaS, and experience supporting global teams across US and EMEA time zones.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this Role:

As a Lead Design Engineer at Samsara, you'll build the systems that power our product and scale our impact as a design team. You'll define the components, patterns, tokens, and guidelines for both people and agents to build with. You'll work in design and in code, shipping highly interactive UI across web and mobile. You’ll codify our principles, heuristics, and taste for high quality ai generation. Your work will shape how quickly teams can build, how reliably our products behave, and how confidently customers use them.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop core system components, evals, and feedback loops to harden AI design and code generation.
  • Govern taste through structure, preventing ai slop from ever making it into our customers’ hands.
  • Make sure system decisions translate cleanly into code, with shared ownership of quality, performance, and maintainability.
  • Build accessibility, responsiveness, and performance into the system by default.
  • Set clear contribution, governance, and deprecation models that balance speed with system integrity.
  • Meet regularly with the designers and engineers who use the system, and bring their feedback alongside usage data into what you build next.
  • Share the AI tools, workflows, and tactics that work with the wider design and engineering teams.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as the company scales globally across new offices.

Minimum Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in design engineering, design systems, product design, or front-end engineering, building UX/UI for web and mobile applications.
  • Shipped design system or component library work, with a portfolio, case studies, or code samples that explain what you built, how you decided, and how teams adopted it. We cannot consider applications without a portfolio at this time.
  • Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the judgment to know when to use an established pattern and when to invent one.
  • Experience with design tokens, theming, and accessibility standards.
  • AI tools in your regular practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Figma Make), with shipped work you can attribute to them, and experience connecting them to a design system. You can explain, review, and debug the code they generate.
  • Experience partnering with designers, engineers, and product managers on short cycles.

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$137,445—$231,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFlosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Flosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.

This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.

We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.

About Flosum

Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.

Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.

We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.

What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
  • Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.
  • Define how Flosum's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.
  • Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.
  • Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations.

Execution & Delivery

  • Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it.
  • Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination.
  • Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
  • Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
  • Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
  • Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.

What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role

  • You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
  • You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
  • You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
  • You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
  • You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

What We Expect in the First 12 Months

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose

  • Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture.
  • Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
  • Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.
  • Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale.

Months 3-6: Ship and Win

  • Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability.
  • Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn.
  • Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan.

Months 6-12: Scale and Lead

  • Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset.
  • Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment.
  • Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

Benefits

Why Flosum

  • Category-defining opportunity: You will shape the future of how enterprises build on Salesforce. This is not incremental; it is transformational.
  • Direct CEO partnership: You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founder who is deeply technical, product-obsessed, and committed to building the best platform in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Fortune 100 customer base: Your product decisions will directly impact how the world's largest and most complex organizations operate.
  • AI inflection point: Agentforce and autonomous agents are rewriting the rules. Flosum is the first native platform to integrate these capabilities. You will define what comes next.
  • Missionary culture: We hire people who want to make a dent, not pad a resume. If you are looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are heard, this is it.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus
  • Direct access to Salesforce ecosystem events, conferences (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX), and customer engagement

jobs.description:
Work from anywhere, impact everywhere

Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank.
We’re a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world.

Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country.
To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job.
We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow.
We are committed to changing the way things are done.

Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position

Work from anywhere!

Position overview

As Financial Controller, you will own the integrity of financial reporting across the Xapo group, a Bitcoin-first, regulated credit institution headquartered in Gibraltar.

Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams and take each cycle from first draft to sign-off: consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, the multi-entity close, regulatory returns to the GFSC and FCA, and the external audit.

You will apply IFRS to crypto assets, shape our accounting positions and policies, and work with our finance transformation team to build AI and automation into the close and reporting process.

Responsibilities

Financial reporting and control

  • Prepare the group’s consolidated and entity financial statements under IFRS and FRS 102, from first draft to sign-off.
  • Run month-end and year-end close for a multi-entity group in Gibraltar and the UK, including consolidation and intercompany eliminations.
  • Oversee the statutory accounts of each group entity.
  • Make sure the internal control system stays accurate and keeps its integrity.

Regulatory reporting

  • Lead regulatory reporting to the GFSC and FCA, including prudential returns on capital and liquidity and periodic management accounts.
  • Work with Data, Operations, Compliance and other teams to prepare client asset reporting.
  • Keep up with regulatory change and update reporting when requirements change.

External audit

  • Run the group external audit from planning through fieldwork, queries and sign-off.
  • Be the main contact between Xapo and the auditors, answering technical questions and keeping the audit on timetable.

Technical accounting

  • Support the Director of Finance on technical accounting, including the treatment of crypto assets under IFRS.
  • Write technical accounting positions and contribute to decisions on finance systems and infrastructure.
  • Help draft accounting policies, memos and decision records.

Tax

  • Own tax compliance and manage the external tax advisors, including the tax treatment of crypto assets.

Systems, process and automation

  • Improve finance processes and NetSuite reporting.
  • Work with the finance transformation team to build AI and automation into close and reporting, and adopt new tools as they roll out.
  • Manage the existing close and regulatory reporting review process and look for ways to improve it.

Team management

  • Lead and develop the Financial Controlling and Regulatory Reporting teams, fostering strong performance, accountability, and collaboration.
  • Drive a high-performance culture by setting clear objectives, developing future leaders, and ensuring the team has the skills to support evolving business and regulatory requirements.

Skills needed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) preferred.
  • At least 5 years as a Controller leading an accounting function.
  • Experience in a bank, fintech or crypto business.
  • Strong technical knowledge of IFRS and FRS 102, with experience preparing financial statements under both.
  • Crypto asset accounting under IFRS, including fair value revaluation and on-chain reconciliations, backed by a working understanding of blockchain.
  • Regulatory reporting experience, including Basel capital and liquidity returns (e.g. COREP). GFSC or FCA exposure is preferred.
  • External audits experience.
  • NetSuite proficiency is essential.
  • Advanced Excel / Google Sheets. SQL or BI tools (e.g. BigQuery, Looker) are an advantage.
  • Has used AI tools in previous finance roles and is comfortable working alongside AI-driven automations and checking their output.
  • Experience leading and developing a finance team.
  • Clear writer, able to explain complex numbers to non-finance colleagues and handle regulator and auditor correspondence in a fully remote team.
  • Strong analytical skills, sound judgement and high standards of integrity.

Other requirements

  • A dedicated workspace.
  • A reliable internet connection with the fastest speed possible in your area.
  • Alignment with Our Values and the Xapo Values-Driven Leadership principles.

Why work for Xapo?

Impact Globally, Work Remotely.

  • Shape the Future
    Improve lives through cutting-edge technology, work 100% remotely from anywhere in the world.

  • Great work-life balanceBuild amazing things with a balance of autonomy and collaborative teamwork. Set your own work schedule and make use of a flexible PTO plan when you need to recharge.

  • Expect ExcellenceCollaborate, learn, and grow with a high-performance team. Learn how you learn best - from books to conferences, you’ll get a yearly budget for your individual learning and development goals.

At Xapo, we prioritize consumer protection and adhere to regulatory requirements by ensuring that all Xapiens are accountable for upholding principles of fair treatment, transparency, and ethical conduct in their interactions with customers and stakeholders.

We are actively seeking candidates based in the UK or the UAE with strong leadership instincts and a background in B2B travel.

As Skift expands its footprint across content, sponsorship, and live events, new revenue depends on sellers who can build pipelines independently and sell with a real command of the client’s business. This is not a lead-management or order-taking seat. Your mission is to break new business, turn those wins into lasting relationships, and deliver a high-touch client experience. Success in this role requires equal parts resourcefulness and rapport: the strongest candidates are natural hunters who don’t wait for leads to land in their lap, listen more than they pitch, and stay resilient through longer, consultative deal cycles.

Pipeline & Business Development

  • Independently build a large pipeline of leads to drive RFPs and IOs while engaging clients across all levels of business titles and responsibilities.

Forecasting & Collaboration

Skift's culture is diverse, cohesive, and full of people who love what they do and bring the best of themselves to work. We are remote but very connected and caring about each other.

If this role sounds like a fit, we'd love to hear from you. PLEASE SEND US A COVER LETTER ALONG WITH YOUR RESUME sharing why you're interested and how your experience aligns with Skift's mission.

This role helps implement scalable solutions that improve privacy operations and visibility into data use. In addition to core privacy responsibilities, this person will contribute to the evaluation of new initiatives and support strategic projects and emerging regulatory requirements across commercial, clinical, and research environments. This role requires a solid foundation in healthcare privacy, clinical research, and technology-enabled healthcare, coupled with the ability to translate regulatory, ethical, and operational requirements into practical solutions that support the business.

Regarding culture, we seek people who demonstrate Natera's values, enjoy solving complex problems, empower others to thrive, lead by example, and adapt their playbook when necessary.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Privacy Management & Governance

  • Support the operationalization of enterprise privacy governance frameworks that enable responsible, compliant, and scalable use of information

  • Partner with Legal, Regulatory, HealthCare Compliance, Security, and AI and Data Governance teams to align privacy requirements with broader governance and risk initiatives

  • Help apply scalable decision-making frameworks and governance processes that support business objectives while maintaining patient trust and regulatory compliance

  • Translate business, technical, and regulatory requirements into practical, technology-enabled solutions

Clinical, Research & Responsible Innovation Enablement

  • Provide privacy guidance across clinical research, secondary use of data, real-world evidence, genomics, and precision medicine initiatives

  • Support responsible use of patient, clinical, research, and commercial information through risk-based frameworks

  • Partner with Clinical, Medical, Research, Commercial, and Product teams to help evaluate new initiatives, technologies, and partnerships

  • Help ensure innovation initiatives incorporate appropriate privacy, ethical, and regulatory considerations

Strategic Initiatives & Cross-Functional Support

  • Support high-priority initiatives requiring coordination across business, clinical, research, commercial, product, and technology functions

  • Help move projects from concept through implementation, balancing regulatory obligations, operational realities, and organizational goals

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to create alignment and drive successful outcomes

About This Opportunity

We are looking for a talented recruiter who wants the autonomy of running their own operation while leveraging the infrastructure, brand recognition, and support of an established global recruitment organization.

As a Keller Haldren Partner, you will have the freedom to build and grow your own recruitment business, your way, while benefiting from:

  • Brand Power - Immediate credibility with clients and candidates through the Keller Haldren network.
  • Operational Support - Access to our proven systems, technology platforms, and back-office infrastructure
  • Global Network - Connect with fellow partners worldwide for cross-border placements and knowledge sharing
  • Marketing Resources - Professional marketing materials, digital assets, and campaign support tailored for your market
  • Financial Flexibility - Competitive revenue share model with transparent fee structure designed for your market, allowing you to retain significant earnings while accessing enterprise-level resources

The Ideal Partner Profile

You are an established recruitment professional who:

  • Has 5-10 years of proven recruitment experience with a track record of successful placements and client relationships in your local market.
  • Is ready for independence - You have been thinking about starting your own operation but want the backing of an established brand
  • OR has recently launched an independent recruitment business and seeks strategic partnership to accelerate growth
  • Possesses strong industry networks and the ability to generate business through existing relationships
  • Values collaboration while maintaining entrepreneurial drive
  • Understands market dynamics, cultural nuances, and regulatory environment
  • Has the ambition to build a sustainable, profitable recruitment operation

About Keller Haldren

Keller Haldren is a global executive search and recruitment firm with operations across multiple countries. We specialize in connecting exceptional talent with leading organizations and have built a reputation for quality, integrity, and results.

Our partner model has been developed to empower talented recruiters to build their own businesses while benefiting from our established infrastructure, brand, and global network. We believe that the best recruitment businesses are built by passionate professionals who have the freedom to operate autonomously while supported by world-class resources.

Requirements

Essential

  • Minimum 5 years recruitment experience
  • Demonstrated ability to manage full recruitment lifecycle independently
  • Strong client relationship management skills
  • Self-starter mentality with business development capabilities
  • Strong understanding of employment law and recruitment practices
  • Excellent communication skills (fluency in English essential)

Desirable

  • Existing client base or business pipeline
  • Specialization in high-demand sectors
  • Experience with recruitment technology and CRM systems
  • Previous experience running a business or managing P&L
  • Established network within your business community

Benefits

Build Your Business, With Enterprise-Level Backing

Enjoy complete operational autonomy while leveraging the credibility of an established global brand. As a true business partner, you'll earn 100% commission-based income through our transparent revenue share model; keeping the majority of what you generate, with no salary cap limiting your potential.

Access proven technology platforms, back-office infrastructure, and professional marketing resources without the bureaucracy. Connect with our global partner network for cross-border opportunities and knowledge sharing.

Legal & Compliance

  • Keller Haldren welcomes applications from all genders and does not tolerate discrimination, consistent with Swiss law (Federal Constitution & Gender Equality Act). Selection is based on qualifications and business merit.
  • Applicants may request reasonable accommodations during the selection process.
  • No fees are charged to jobseekers. Any legally permitted registration/commission fees under Swiss law are not applied by Keller Haldren.
  • Controller(s): Keller Haldren HQ Purpose: assess and manage your application. Retention: up to 12 months unless you consent to longer. Your rights: access, rectification, erasure/objection per Swiss nFADP. Full policy:
  • We may transfer your data abroad. Transfers follow Swiss law: to adequate countries (per Federal Council list) or, where needed, Swiss SCCs/additional safeguards. Transfers to the USA rely on the Swiss-US Data Privacy Framework for certified recipients.
  • Switzerland does not require salary ranges in job ads; this is a commission-only independent-partner role.
  • This is an independent partner (self-employed) opportunity, not employment with Keller Haldren in Switzerland. Any placement activity in/into Switzerland is conducted via/under a Swiss-licensed partner.
