jobs.description:
Main areas of focus: Revenue Budgeting & Forecasting, Long-Range Planning, Financial Analytics

Location: Remote - U.S. only.

Eligibility: At this time, we are only considering candidates who are eligible to work in the United States without the need of company sponsorship now or in the future.

JOB HIGHLIGHT

You'll steward charity: water's financial health by overseeing the revenue budgeting and forecasting process, projecting cash inflows, supporting cross-functional long-range planning efforts, and performing financial analytics.

JOB SUMMARY

As Senior Manager of Financial Planning & Analysis, you'll work on the Strategic Finance team with a focus on financial performance. You'll own the revenue side of our budget and forecast, build the multi-year models behind our long-range plans, and translate financial data into insight that helps leadership make sharper, faster decisions.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, you'll partner across teams to coordinate the many inputs that feed our financial picture and tie them together into a clear narrative of where we are and where we're headed. It's a role for someone who's equally comfortable deep in a forecast model and working with leadership to understand their strategic vision. With strong quantitative instincts, investigative rigor, and clear communication, you'll help drive the business forward.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR…

  • Developing a deep understanding of how our revenue streams, donor restrictions, expenses, and business rules shape our broader strategy

  • Overseeing the revenue side of the annual budget, monthly actuals reporting, and forecasts, using inputs from Revenue Operations and Accounting

  • Reviewing and pressure-testing Revenue Operations’ bottoms-up revenue forecast by probing assumptions, securing the inputs Finance needs to report, and setting the risk-adjusted revenue figure used for financial planning

  • Building and owning the integrated multi-year financial model as the organization’s single source of truth for long-range planning, integrating revenue, operating expense, and cash and reserves inputs from Strategic Finance, Revenue Operations and the Leadership Team

  • Setting the input requirements, standards, and deadlines that departments follow to feed the multi-year model, ensuring leadership always has a current, coherent long-range picture

  • Leading financial performance analytics, including ROI reporting and ad hoc analyses that inform business decisions

  • Partnering with stakeholders across the organization to shape growth-oriented financial and KPI goals and report on progress

  • Preparing monthly financial results for leadership and supporting preparation for presentations to the Board of Directors and Finance Committee

YOU MUST HAVE…

  • A Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business, finance, or related field

  • 7+ years of experience in a variety of strategic, analytical, and finance roles

  • A background in finance with an established knowledge of financial concepts, with preferred experience in forecasting, long-range planning, and financial analytics

  • Elite Google and Microsoft Suite skills, specifically Google Sheets and Excel

  • Experience with NetSuite, Salesforce, Looker or similar systems is preferred

  • Systems and tooling adaptability with a demonstrated ability to leverage AI to create workflow efficiencies

  • An ability to own and drive multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously

  • An aptitude for working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

  • Excellent quantitative skills, an ability to shift between granular and high-level analysis, a love for informing data-driven strategy and the skills to distill data into actionable insights

  • A rigorously detail-oriented approach, always triple-checking work, and experience producing exceptional deliverables

YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF…

You’re passionate about accuracy

You double-check your work because you know that accurate data is crucial to operate successfully. You care about the numbers being right and take the time to make sure everything reconciles or is set up to be error-proof.

You’re a problem solver

You’re an inquisitive and critical thinker who will investigate the numbers to comprehend the story behind them. You know how to develop an articulation of an ambiguous problem and roll out solutions, recognizing there are many solutions to the same problem. You find new and effective ways to streamline and create processes to increase efficiency.

You’re a team player

You thrive in a creative, inventive, fast-paced environment, with people who are passionate about their work. You’re excited to work cross-functionally with other departments and enjoy achieving a shared goal. People enjoy working with you because they know you’re reliable.

You’re a great communicator

You can turn data and numbers into effective and compelling messages. You are great at sharing insights; but what you love to do is apply real context to findings so that stakeholders understand what it means for them and also how it impacts our business

TEAM OVERVIEW

The Finance team, which includes Accounting and Strategic Finance, works diligently to support our entire organization, keeping our books in order, ensuring that our Operations and Water funds are being allocated responsibly and in line with our strategic goals. They steward donor funds in line with our core pillar that 100% of our public donations will be utilized for water projects.

HIRING TIMELINE

This role was posted on October 14, 2026 and will remain open for approximately 72 hours.

SALARY RANGE

This is an exempt role with a range of $109,000 - $113,000 a year.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Unlimited PTO
Summer Fridays
6-week paid sabbatical leave after 5 years of employment
Annual bonus potential through The Pool
401k plan + employer match
Medical covered at 85% + Dental/Vision contributions
FSA + dependent day care FSA
Employer-paid life insurance, STD, LTD
16-week paid maternity and paternity leave for new parents
Stipends for Home office, Professional Development, and a You-do-You Perk
TSA Pre-check reimbursement
Flexible working hours; team members are expected to be online 10am - 4pm ET regardless of location, plus three hours per day asynchronously, which factors in an hour for lunch
2-4 annual travel requirements that foster team alignment, connection and in-person collaboration

ORGANIZATIONAL OVERVIEW

At charity: water, we believe that water changes everything. We work with local implementing partners to fund sustainable solutions that provide clean and safe drinking water to people around the world. Since 2006, with a diverse team of world-changers and an unstoppable community of supporters, we’ve brought clean water to more than 20 million people worldwide. With the makings of a mid-size tech startup, we’re reinventing charity through endless innovation, contagious passion, beautifully crafted stories, and a powerful brand that inspires a new kind of generosity.
At charity: water, we value every background, identity, and experience. We believe that a diverse team, informed by different cultures and perspectives, makes us stronger. We are committed to doing the work and challenging each other to be an organization in which everyone is respected and heard. We commit to providing genuine opportunities for all people to thrive. And we will continue to embed diversity, inclusion, belonging, and equality in everything we do.
Note, charity: water will never ask you for your credit card or financial information during the interview process. Should you receive a message requesting this information, please mark the email as spam and report here.

jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

What you’ll do:
  • Design, build and implement security and hardening features for enterprise users: Design, implement, test, and ship cutting-edge security features that strengthen Firefox’s security posture.
  • Advance Firefox’s security architecture across multiple operating systems: Contribute to and drive cutting-edge improvements to Firefox’s core security posture, by building privilege isolation and moving trust boundaries or Strengthen Firefox’s security architecture: Improve Firefox’s core security mechanisms including cryptographic protocols, WebPKI, and security-sensitive web APIs.
  • Contribute to our security initiatives: Work across teams to investigate security issues, identify root causes, and deliver robust, maintainable fixes.
  • Improve browser reliability and performance: Diagnose and resolve issues affecting stability, correctness, performance, and memory usage in a complex, multithreaded environment.

What you’ll bring:

  • Systems programming experience and security knowledge: 3+ years of experience in low-level software engineering, strong proficiency in C and/or C++, and a solid understanding of security fundamentals.
  • Debugging and problem-solving skills: Experience diagnosing and resolving issues in multithreaded, cross-platform native applications, including memory and performance challenges.
  • Web platform and modern systems experience: Familiarity with web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and interest or experience in Rust; ability to work effectively within large, complex, multi-language codebases.
  • Effective collaboration and communication: Experience working with distributed teams and communicating technical ideas clearly in writing and conversation.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: React Native Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 5+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are
encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced React Native Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade cross-platform mobile applications supporting digital banking, healthcare, logistics, and customer engagement platforms. This role focuses on building scalable, high-performance mobile applications for both iOS and Android that seamlessly integrate with cloud-native APIs, enterprise authentication systems, and real-time data services.
You will collaborate closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, backend engineers, DevOps teams, and QA engineers to deliver secure, intuitive, and highly responsive mobile experiences. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in React Native with strong JavaScript/TypeScript development skills, modern mobile architecture patterns, and experience publishing enterprise applications to both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-scale React Native applications for iOS and Android platforms.
  • Build reusable UI components and shared mobile libraries that promote consistency across multiple applications.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and cloud-based backend platforms.
  • Implement secure authentication using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Azure AD, Okta, and biometric authentication technologies.
  • Develop real-time features using WebSockets, SignalR, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), or push notification services.
  • Optimize application startup time, rendering performance, memory utilization, and battery efficiency.
  • Integrate native platform capabilities including camera, GPS, Bluetooth, NFC, biometrics, file storage, and device sensors.
  • Implement offline data synchronization, local storage, caching, and background synchronization capabilities.
  • Build scalable navigation architectures and state management solutions using Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or Context API.
  • Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure application quality.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate mobile build pipelines, testing, and application deployment.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, sprint planning, and production support activities.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across multiple mobile platforms while maintaining high application availability.

Required Skills
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience.
  • Three or more years of hands-on React Native development experience delivering production mobile applications.
  • Strong proficiency in React Native, React, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Hooks, Functional Components, Context API, and component lifecycle.
  • Experience implementing state management using Redux Toolkit, Redux, MobX, Zustand, or Context API.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and cloud backend services.
  • Strong understanding of iOS and Android application lifecycle, navigation, permissions, and platform-specific behaviors.
  • Experience with native modules and bridging between React Native and Swift, Objective-C, Java, or Kotlin.
  • Familiarity with Expo and React Native CLI development environments.
  • Experience implementing secure authentication using JWT, OAuth2, Azure AD, Auth0, Okta, or Firebase Authentication.
  • Experience integrating Firebase services including Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging, and Remote Config.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Bitrise.
  • Strong understanding of mobile performance optimization, debugging, and memory profiling.
  • Experience with local databases such as SQLite, Realm, or AsyncStorage.
  • Knowledge of mobile security best practices including secure storage, encryption, certificate pinning, and secure API communication.
  • Experience working within Agile Scrum teams.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building enterprise mobile applications within healthcare, financial services, retail, logistics, or insurance industries.
  • Familiarity with React Navigation, React Query, TanStack Query, and modern mobile architecture patterns.
  • Experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe, Apple Pay, or Google Pay.
  • Knowledge of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), NFC, QR code scanning, barcode scanning, and IoT device integration.
  • Experience implementing biometric authentication including Face ID, Touch ID, and Android Biometric Authentication.
  • Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud mobile backend services.
  • Experience with automated testing using Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox, Appium, or Maestro.
  • Experience publishing and maintaining applications in Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Familiarity with mobile analytics platforms including Firebase Analytics, AppCenter, or New Relic.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native microservice environments supporting enterprise mobile applications.

Project Environment
You will be joining a mobile engineering team responsible for building next-generation enterprise applications supporting millions of users across iOS and Android platforms. Current initiatives include:
  • Digital banking and financial services mobile platforms
  • Healthcare patient engagement and telemedicine applications
  • Field service and workforce management solutions
  • Enterprise sales enablement and CRM mobile applications
  • Logistics, fleet tracking, and warehouse management solutions
  • Real-time customer communication and notification platforms
  • Secure mobile identity and authentication solutions
  • Cloud-native backend services deployed on Azure and AWS supporting high-volume mobile transactions

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will contribute to mobile application architecture, UI development, API integration, performance optimization, testing, deployment, and ongoing operational excellence for mission-critical enterprise mobile solutions.

Overview:

At Strategic Financial Reporting, Inc. (SFR), our mission is to provide clients with superior personalized bookkeeping, tax, accounting, and consulting services by implementing practical solutions for our clients’ diverse needs. Bookkeepers that work for SFR are entitled to create their Perfect Job Position. As a bookkeeper, you will have the right to change your schedule, number of assigned clients, and other duties so that we can ensure you are always working your Perfect Position. We are looking to hire an ambitious bookkeeper and great communicator who wants to work full-time and support small to mid-size businesses.

Basic Functions:

The bookkeeper would use their expertise to remotely assist small businesses with their monthly, weekly, or daily bookkeeping needs so that the client can focus on running their business. They will manage day-to-day relationships with clients while performing within established processes and budget parameters per the client's bookkeeping engagement. They will complete bookkeeping tasks per the specific client's business needs for support.

These tasks vary depending on the client and their individual needs for bookkeeping services. Possible tasks may include but are not limited to the following:

  • Provide exceptional bookkeeping services to your clients via QuickBooks Online.
  • Demonstrate a thorough understanding of professional accounting and bookkeeping practices.
  • Meet with your clients via virtual meetings as needed to answer questions and support their business ventures.
  • Close the books monthly & send monthly email reports of work to date to the client.
  • Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
  • Manage bookkeeping & accounting journal entries.
  • Maintain the chart of accounts.
  • Create the company's financial statements to prepare for analysis and annual tax preparation.
  • Conduct periodic reconciliations of all accounts to ensure their accuracy.
  • Process payroll per client needs (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, etc).
  • Provide clerical and administrative support as requested.
  • Issue invoices to customers.
  • Pay supplier invoices in a timely manner.
  • Pay any debt as it comes due for payment.
  • Ensure that receivables are collected promptly.
  • Record cash receipts and make bank deposits.
  • Collect sales taxes from customers and remit them to the government.
  • Tag and monitor fixed assets.
  • Ensure that the client is compliant with local, state, and federal government reporting requirements.
  • Support client onboarding process for all assigned client engagements in accordance with defined processes.

As a fully remote telecommuting position, communication is one of the most important and valued skills at Strategic Financial Reporting, Inc. All team members are expected to communicate powerfully in all aspects of client support and internal services.

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Procurement Department

The Procurement team is responsible for securing the equipment Vantage’s data centers require to function. The team leads these efforts from conception through commissioning, working with Sales, Operations, New Site Development, and Engineering along the way. Procurement also works closely with vendor partners to come up with a vertically integrated design, and we manage these partners to deliver the projects on schedule and budget. Vantage is unique in that our technical staff is given the responsibility and authority to directly drive the process. Our internal team can align long-term operational sustainability with value engineering and cost metrics to deliver products aligned with corporate goals. This approach empowers each member of the team to drive high- impact decisions and even more impactful results.

Position Overview

This role can be remote or based in any of our US locations: Denver, CO; Phoenix, AZ; Santa Clara, CA; or Ashburn, VA.

This role owns the global mechanical category strategy and supplier ecosystem for advanced thermal management systems supporting data center infrastructure. Scope includes chillers, cooling towers, heat exchangers, pumps, valves, piping systems, and emerging liquid cooling technologies such as CDUs and skids. The role is responsible for ensuring cost, quality, delivery, and reliability outcomes, while enabling scalable deployment across regions and reducing supply chain and technical risks.

The Director partners closely with Mechanical Engineering, Product, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and Reliability teams to ensure alignment with design standards, capacity expansion plans, and evolving cooling technologies. This role also drives global supplier strategy, performance governance, and total cost of ownership improvements, while proactively managing risks such as long-lead equipment constraints, regulatory exposure, and technology transitions.

  • Build and execute global category strategy for air and liquid cooling infrastructure aligned to capacity growth, reliability targets, and engineering standards

  • Map global supply base by technology and region, establishing preferred supplier frameworks and regional execution models

  • Lead sourcing and negotiations for mechanical equipment, including chillers, cooling towers, CDUs, pumps, and heat exchangers, as well as spares and service agreements

  • Develop contracting strategies including indexed commodities, bundled equipment and installation, time-and-material vs fixed-price structures, warranties, and performance guarantees

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to drive specification alignment, design-to-cost initiatives, and development of standard equipment building blocks and approved equipment libraries

  • Coordinate with Quality and Commissioning to define acceptance criteria (FAT/SAT), documentation requirements, and change control processes

  • Ensure supplier capacity planning for long-lead equipment and manage expediting, escalation, and recovery plans to mitigate schedule risk

  • Lead supplier performance management including scorecards, QBRs, reliability tracking, corrective action programs, and continuous improvement initiatives

  • Manage risks associated with cooling systems, including single-source exposure, regulatory impacts, extreme-weather resilience, and controls obsolescence

  • Drive total cost of ownership improvements across energy efficiency, water usage, maintenance strategies, and lifecycle performance

  • Develop cost models, should-cost benchmarks, and pricing frameworks for equipment, installation, and commissioning

  • Maintain contract portfolios including framework agreements, service/maintenance agreements, warranty terms, and spares strategies

  • Deliver supplier performance dashboards, risk registers, and executive-level insights on category performance and supply risks

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field; equivalent experience considered

  • 5+ years of experience in category management or sourcing within mechanical systems, HVAC, or capital equipment

  • Working knowledge of advanced cooling technologies including air-cooled and water-cooled systems, pumping/hydronics, and liquid cooling architectures

  • Experience with capital equipment procurement, contracting, and lifecycle cost analysis

  • Strong negotiation, cost modeling, and supplier management expertise

  • Ability to partner cross-functionally with engineering, construction, commissioning, and operations teams

  • Experience managing supplier performance, reliability metrics, and risk mitigation strategies

  • Understanding of commissioning, acceptance testing, and product lifecycle requirements for mechanical infrastructure

Our Product organisation is entering an exciting new chapter at Rapid7. About the Team

Our Product Management team bridges the gap between vision and execution, driving the strategy behind our award-winning solutions to help over 11,000 organizations assess risk, detect threats, and automate their security programs. Utilizing best-in-class technology, leading-edge research, and broad market expertise, our PMs champion the customer's voice. We collaborate across engineering and UX to develop groundbreaking new features and maximize value for security teams worldwide.


In the age of AI the stakes for creating a safer digital world are greater than ever. At Rapid7, we believe it’s our responsibility to show up every day and innovate on behalf of the entire security community. Our global Product Management team is at the center of this mission, defining the roadmap for a cohesive, industry-leading platform that spans vulnerability management, cloud security, and automation.


Join our Product Management team to own the product lifecycle, drive strategic innovation on our Insight platform, and help shape the future of a safer digital space for everyone.


About the Role

As a Manager of Product Management, your primary responsibility will be to help shape the future of our cutting-edge platform solutions by guiding team execution and aligning cross-functional strategies. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Directly manage a team of Product Managers with responsibility for coaching, mentoring, and supporting them in scoping work and prioritizing tasks
  • Mentor your PMs and help grow their skills, identify growth areas, set expectations and provide feedback
  • Lead cross-team collaboration with Product, Engineering, and UX for product planning, prioritization, development, launch and on-going enhancements that balance responsiveness to customer needs with strategic market impact.
  • Work with executive leadership, product, and engineering teams to develop product plans aligned with market requirements and opportunities for growth.
  • Collaborate with customers and cloud ecosystem partners, leveraging market research to develop functional and technical requirements in partnership with engineering.
  • Encourage data-driven product decisions by leveraging utilization metrics, user feedback, and customer partnerships.
  • Work with product and marketing leadership to develop content, messaging, and competitive positioning based on solid value propositions.
  • Integrate AI into day-to-day product management practices to increase efficiency, insight, and customer value.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • 7+ years of experience in product management roles with a demonstrated track record of shipping meaningful product in complex or ambiguous environments preferably within Cyber Security or an AI driven SDLC. With 3+ years experience in product team leadership
  • AI Fluency – Demonstrate the ability to select and use AI appropriately to solve problems, make better decisions, and increase productivity and and foster these practices across your team
  • Previous experience in managing engaged and high performing Product Management teams with a track record in developing and mentoring PMs at all levels
  • A customer-first mindset with the ability to drive that throughout your teams, solid understanding of customer needs, and integration of this customer impact into your team’s everyday decision making
  • You hold yourself and your team responsible for driving outcomes and owning both successes and failures.
  • You think big but act small, helping your PMs break down massive visions into actionable, high-impact components.
  • Establish clear credibility and the ability to build trust fast with engineering, design, data, and senior stakeholders.
  • Formulate a strong point of view and clear opinions about what good product looks like, using crisp communication skills to land them and foster commitment from others.
  • Display professional resilience and immense comfort working through organizational change, turning restructures or pivots into opportunities to come out sharper and focused forward.
  • Make efficient, transparent decisions that resolve roadmap challenges and maintain development momentum.
  • Build a strong global network and work across boundaries to deliver sustainable improvements that create business value.
  • Embrace difficult conversations, actively listening, asking questions, and checking for understanding to find common ground when driving consensus across disparate product cohorts.
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

Established in 1985, First Nations Technical Institute (FNTI) is an Indigenous-owned and governed post-secondary institution accredited by the Indigenous Advanced Education and Skills Council (IAESC). Operating from Tyendinaga on the Bay of Quinte and virtually, FNTI delivers community-driven programs grounded in Indigenous knowledge, connecting learners to their communities while pursuing meaningful education.

Position Summary

Under the direction of the Dean, FNTI Programs, the Faculty Member plays a key role in teaching and knowledge dissemination; providing cultural support to learners; and contributing to administration, coordination, research, and community engagement. In all aspects of program development and delivery, the Faculty Member will privilege Indigenous Knowledge, Indigenous languages, and Indigenous ways of knowing and being.

The Faculty Member is responsible for meeting expectations across all phases of delivery, including orientation, preparation, instruction, learner support, assessment, and program evaluation. The successful candidate will support the preparation and development of Indigenous language teachers and language revitalization initiatives while ensuring culturally grounded and learner-centered educational experiences.

The Faculty Member supports the Institute's strategic priorities and adheres to the Values, Mission, and Vision of FNTI.

Key Responsibilities

Teaching, Program Development & Quality Assurance

Curriculum & Outcomes

  • Develop curriculum that supports vocational, course, and Indigenous learning outcomes and responds to learner needs.
  • Support learners in developing competencies related to Indigenous language acquisition, language teaching methodologies, curriculum development, and language revitalization.
  • Design and implement teaching and assessment strategies that align with program outcomes.
  • Ensure Indigenous language, culture, knowledge systems, and community perspectives are appropriately integrated throughout program delivery.

Instruction & Delivery

  • Prepare, instruct, and deliver courses within a cultural framework, adhering to FNTI's "braided healing with learning" approach.
  • Incorporate Indigenous pedagogies, worldviews, and ways of knowing and being into course planning and delivery.
  • Deliver 45 total contact hours over the course cycle, ensuring learner engagement through a mix of synchronous and asynchronous activities.
  • Provide academic support and mentorship to learners throughout their studies.
  • Evaluate learner progress and achievement and maintain
    accurate academic records.
  • Be responsible for the overall assessment of learner work within assigned courses

Cultural Framework & Protocols

  • Facilitate space for Indigenous language use, cultural teachings, medicines, and traditional practices within the learning environment.
  • Collaborate with Cultural Advisors, Elders, Knowledge Keepers, and community members to support Indigenous learning outcomes.
  • Implement appropriate Indigenous protocols and cultural practices within the classroom.
  • Ensure Indigenous Pedagogy and Andragogy practices are integrated wherever possible.

Learner Support

  • Provide culturally responsive academic support and mentorship.
  • Monitor learner progress and connect learners with appropriate supports and resources.
  • Provide ongoing support throughout the 4-week cycle, including up to 6 office hours over the 45-hour course (outside instructional hours) for additional academic assistance.
  • Foster a positive learning environment that promotes learner engagement, success, and well-being.
  • Participate in learner follow-up and retention initiatives as required.

Administration & Coordination

  • Support program implementation planning, admissions processes, and program evaluations.
  • Utilize the Learning Management System (LMS) for course delivery, learner communication, and instructional materials.
  • Participate in program development, delivery, assessment, and revision activities with faculty, staff, students, alumni, community organizations, and Knowledge Keepers.
  • Attend faculty meetings, program meetings, and cross-functional team meetings as required.
  • Debriefing/Program Evaluation: Following instructional activities and/or throughout the semester/academic year, participate in debriefing/program evaluation sessions with the teaching team and program leadership to review outcomes, address challenges, and contribute to ongoing course and program development.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in education, Indigenous Education, Language Education, Linguistics, Indigenous Studies, or a closely related field.
  • Member in good standing with the Ontario College of Teachers (OCT), or eligible for OCT membership.
  • Minimum five (5) years of successful teaching experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Indigenous learners, communities, and/or language revitalization initiatives.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of Indigenous histories, cultures, languages, and communities.
  • Experience in delivering high-quality teaching and curriculum development at the post-secondary level is considered an asset.
  • Knowledge of Indigenous language acquisition, immersion methodologies, language revitalization practices, and culturally responsive teaching approaches is preferred.

Other Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to perform in a complex, fast-paced environment while maintaining a high degree of confidentiality.
  • Strong leadership skills in educational settings.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with Indigenous communities and organizations.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships in cross-cultural settings.
  • Familiarity with online learning platforms and educational technology.
  • Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours when required.

Conditions of Employment

  • Participation in FNTI orientation and faculty onboarding activities.
  • Participation in mandatory faculty and program meetings.
  • Participation in FNTI's Wise Practices training and other required professional learning opportunities.
  • Willing and able to travel occasionally and work overtime as required.
  • Successful candidates must provide a satisfactory Vulnerable Sector Check
  • Must be legally entitled to work in Ontario, Canada

Equity, Inclusion & Accessibility

FNTI is an inclusive employer. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and the Ontario Human Rights Code (OHRC), applicants may request accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process.

To request accommodation during the application process, please contact with the job title and accommodation details.

FNTI provides preference to qualified applicants of Indigenous ancestry who self-identify.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to apply by submitting:

  • A cover letter outlining interest and qualification
  • A current resume

jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Customer experience:

Customer experience at Nebius AI Cloud involves tackling customers’ challenges and directly impacting their success by solving real-world AI and ML problems at massive GPU cloud scale. You’ll not only resolve issues, but play a key role in shaping clients’ business success by optimizing their AI solutions. Working with advanced GPUs such as H200, B200 and GB200, as well as modern ML frameworks, you’ll influence the development of the Nebius AI Cloud and gain experience at the intersection of infrastructure and AI. With minimal bureaucracy, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, take ownership and drive change. Opportunities for growth are abundant in this vibrant and supportive professional community.

The role

We are looking for a Partner Solutions Architect to serve as the technical interface between Nebius and our strategic technology partners, ranging from data platforms and MLOps vendors to AI frameworks and ISVs that build on GPU infrastructure.

This is a hands-on engineering and integration role. You will design and develop integrated solutions, build reference implementations, enable partner engineering teams, and ensure joint customers succeed with combined offerings. You will influence Nebius’ product roadmap and drive deep technical collaboration across partner ecosystems.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the Canada.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the technical relationship with strategic partners as the primary interface to Nebius engineering and product
  • Design and architect high-impact integration solutions, delivering clear joint customer value
  • Build and maintain reference implementations and production-grade integrations
  • Define enterprise-ready integration patterns (networking, security, compliance, observability)
  • Translate partner and customer feedback into actionable product and roadmap requirements
  • Enable partner teams through technical documentation, training, and demo environments
  • Provide technical leadership in joint customer deployments, architecture reviews, and complex troubleshooting

We expect you to have:

  • 5 - 10 + years in solutions architecture, partner engineering, or technical pre-sales at cloud or data platform companies
  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Deep cloud infrastructure expertise, with specialist experience in large-scale Kubernetes deployments and containerized environments
  • Strong hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform
  • Hands-on experience deploying production AI workloads, particularly inference, and architecting or implementing agentic solutions
  • Proven background in integration architecture, including API design, data pipelines, security, and observability, with experience in Python
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage technical and non-technical

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with HPC environments and large-scale GPU clusters
  • Hands-on experience across the ML lifecycle, including training, fine-tuning, and RAG
  • Practical experience building AI agents, particularly with LangChain
  • Experience with partner technical programs, major cloud or data platforms, or enterprise compliance standards
  • Deep understanding of advanced Kubernetes infrastructure concepts beyond the abstraction of managed Kubernetes services.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

On Target Earnings Range

$235k - $300k CAD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

As the top partner for creating the new industry benchmarks in the ERP Services, Appficiency is an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner with over 7 different industry and partner awards. We are a leader in both construction and manufacturing and as a top 5 Alliance Partner, we go to work each day solving the hardest industry problems and sharing these news-worthy achievements to set a higher bar for the professional services and software industry.

The Value

At Appficiency, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We invest in continuous learning, career development, and opportunities to innovate and lead. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and growth, empowering individuals to contribute meaningfully while expanding their expertise.

As part of our global organization, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with international teams and clients, supporting initiatives that drive both regional and global success.

We operate at the intersection of business and technology, requiring curiosity, analytical thinking, and a strong sense of ownership. As a Sales Operations Analyst, you will play a critical role in enabling the sales organization through data, process optimization, and operational support.

You will work across sales, marketing, and delivery teams, supporting opportunities of varying sizes and complexity while helping drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability in our sales processes.

The Talent

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Sales Operations Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

You bring strong organizational skills, a passion for improving processes, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights that support revenue growth and operational excellence.

The Commitment

  • Provide actionable insights on sales performance, pipeline health, and conversion trends to drive revenue growth.
  • Track and report monthly conversion rates, pipeline progression, and key sales metrics.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support Sales, Marketing, and Delivery teams.
  • Serve as the primary administrator for NetSuite CRM, ensuring data accuracy, system integrity, and process adherence.
  • Design and enhance NetSuite dashboards and reporting frameworks to improve visibility and decision-making.
  • Implement and maintain lead tracking systems to measure marketing performance and campaign effectiveness.
  • Monitor sales pipeline activity and forecast accuracy, ensuring proper stage progression and data hygiene.
  • Track 100% of inbound inquiries and sales activities, ensuring accurate data capture and reporting.
  • Support knowledge transfer from sales to delivery teams, ensuring smooth transitions and complete documentation.
  • Assist in the preparation of proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and client-facing materials, ensuring accuracy and alignment with client requirements.
  • Support the creation and validation of “As Sold” documentation, ensuring completeness of scope, pricing, and supporting analysis where required.

  • Accurately calculate and manage sales commissions and incentive programs, including bonuses for the Software Strategy team.
  • Ensure timely and transparent reporting of compensation metrics and payouts.
  • Support sales enablement initiatives, tools, and content to improve team effectiveness.
  • Assist in managing client testimonials and reviews, targeting consistent monthly acquisition.
  • Collaborate with marketing to analyze campaign performance and optimize lead generation efforts

The Essentials

  • Bachelor's degree in business, data analytics, finance, marketing or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal teams, external partners, and customers.
  • Possess strong skills in critical thinking, analytical thinking, problem-solving, data analysis, and strategic planning.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluency with Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel) and Google Sheets
  • Proficiency with CRM, ERP, and database software
  • Knowledge of NetSuite products and services is a plus.

The Add-Ons

  • Experience with NetSuite or within the NetSuite partner community
  • We are a global company, so international experience is a plus
  • Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where personal drive and judgment need to be exercised daily
  • Experience working closely with C-suite and executive leadership
  • Bonus points: enjoys hard work and harder play

jobs.description:
Description

We're looking for a Social Media Manager who plays guitar and lives and breathes music culture to own our voice across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook, and Reddit — turning Ultimate Guitar's massive, passionate community of players and fans into an even bigger, louder one.

We are actively integrating AI automation into relevant areas of the business and expect candidates with mindset focused on improving efficiency and deliver a better user experience. Regarding this role, we encourage AI-use to ideate or refine final pieces, but not generate content from scratch.

﻿What's in it for you?

You'll be the voice of one of the world's biggest platforms for guitarists and musicians, working directly with product owners on campaigns that reach a global community of players. It's a role built for someone who wants to shape culture, not just schedule posts — with an AI-native toolkit designed to speed up the busywork so you can spend more time on strategy and creative.

Key responsibilities

  • Own Ultimate Guitar social strategy and execution across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook and Reddit
  • Create, adapt and schedule content per platform, in Ultimate Guitar brand voice
  • Build and maintain channel strategy per platform, in collaboration with the Ultimate Guitar Product Owner, continuing the Q3/Q4 IG + TikTok growth plan
  • Support GTM campaigns with Product Owner's and stakeholders, from brief to published social
  • Manage community engagement and moderation across Ultimate Guitar channels; escalate sensitive issues
  • Secure music licensing and rights clearance before publishing
  • Run social listening and react to trends and community sentiment in real time
  • Report on engagement, channel growth and campaign ROI; establish UTM tracking + keep it clean and consistent
  • Provide interim AU/ social coverage until the net-new SoMe Manager is hired
  • Use the team's AI stack (Claude, Coda, Jitter, Metricool, Later) to speed ideation, scheduling and reporting

Requirements

  • 4–5 years managing brand social across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook and Reddit
  • Short-form video literacy (concepting and light editing); full video production if we keep that scope
  • Strong copywriting and the ability to flex tone by platform and product
  • Community management, including moderation and de-escalation
  • Fluency in music, guitar and creator culture (the UG audience is players and fans, not a generic consumer)
  • Analytics: native platform analytics plus Metricool / Later; comfortable with UTM tracking
  • AI-native workflow: Claude, Coda or equivalent as a default, not an occasional tool
  • Awareness of music licensing and rights clearance
  • Fluent written and spoken English (B2+)

Nice to have:

  • Paid Social experience
  • Video production/editing experience

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. An overview of this role

As Regional Director, Enterprise Sales for the Southeastern United States, you'll lead a team of Strategic Account Executives and own software sales, bookings, and revenue across the region. You'll help new and existing customers adopt GitLab's AI-powered platform for software development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk.

Reporting to the AVP, East, you'll hire and develop sales talent, set territory and industry strategies, and align your team's sales plans with GitLab's growth goals. In your first year, you'll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening customer relationships across the Southeast, and meeting or exceeding performance objectives.

This role is fully remote and will be based in the Southeast, US.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and develop Strategic Account Executives serving the Southeastern US to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results.
  • Build and execute territory and industry plans based on market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends.
  • Establish a sales operating rhythm with clear qualification standards, pipeline hygiene, deal inspection, and accurate forecasts.

  • Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies, with a willingness to lead your team and participate directly in selling.
  • Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance, market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics, and use those insights to improve regional plans.

  • Interest in open source and a commitment to GitLab's values of collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency.
  • Ability to travel as needed and comply with GitLab's travel policy.

You'll join our Enterprise Sales organization in the US. As an all-remote team, we collaborate across time zones using asynchronous workflows. We drive new and expansion revenue and partner with Renewals, Marketing, and Sales Operations to serve customers across the US.

jobs.excerpt: About UsFanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform.
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Job Summary

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is building the industry’s most trusted, scalable, and fan-centric sportsbook experience. Our Internal Platforms power critical systems that support customer operations, marketing, support, risk, and data—through a combination of Java backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, and Salesforce platform capabilities.

We are seeking a Senior Java Software Engineer to build and maintain scalable services that power our internal platforms. This role is full stack focused, with opportunities to contribute to user-facing internal tools as needed.

Experience with Salesforce development and integrations is a strong plus, as many of our systems interface directly with Salesforce for CRM, workflow automation, and customer operations. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys owning features end-to-end, solving complex integration problems, and working closely with cross-functional partners.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Engineering (Primary Focus)

Holman is looking for a Security Engineer to work where cloud infrastructure and software development meet. You will review and design security architecture for our cloud environments, maintain our application security tooling, and work directly with development teams to threat model applications and find and fix vulnerabilities. You will also perform third-party vendor security reviews, support our work with external penetration testing partners, help secure our growing use of AI, and take part in incident response as part of the broader security team.


Principal Purpose of Position

Security Engineering

  • Review cloud security solutions and contribute to secure architecture designs for Azure and AWS environments, turning business requirements into practical security controls.
  • Provide security architecture guidance and design patterns to Infrastructure, Cloud, and Development teams.
  • Build, deploy, and maintain security infrastructure as code with Terraform, Terragrunt, ARM, and Bicep, so that controls stay consistent, version-controlled, and repeatable.
  • Perform third-party vendor security reviews: assess vendor architecture, controls, and risk, document findings, and recommend mitigations or acceptance criteria.
  • Contribute to the security architecture and operation of enterprise AI platforms, including MCP gateways, LLM routers, and AI gateways. This covers access control and tool permissions, prompt injection and data leakage risks, AI usage and cost governance (FinOps), and observability and logging of AI activity.
  • Keep documentation of security controls, configurations, architecture decisions, and procedures accurate and current.

Software Security

  • Perform threat modeling with development teams on new and existing applications, and work with developers to understand vulnerabilities and architectural security issues, supporting remediation through to verified closure.
  • Support the IAM team on cloud and application identity security, including workload and managed identities, service principals, least-privilege role design, secrets handling, and application authentication and authorization patterns.
  • Administer and maintain application and cloud security tooling, including cloud security posture, runtime application security, and API security testing platforms. This covers configuration, tuning, integrations, and keeping findings accurate.
  • Help integrate security controls and testing into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows.
  • Work with third-party penetration testing providers to support scoping, ongoing attack surface assessment, results triage, and remediation tracking.
  • Report vulnerability exposure, remediation status, and risk to application owners and management.

Incident Response & General

  • Participate in incident response activities, contributing cloud and application security expertise to investigation, containment, and remediation.
  • Lead specific initiatives or workstreams when delegated.
  • Share knowledge with peers and developers on secure design and coding practices.
  • Stay current on cloud and application threats, attack techniques, and security technologies, and recommend improvements to Holman's security posture.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

Relevant Work Experience

  • 5–7 years of combined information security and technical engineering experience, with significant time in cloud security, application security, or both.
  • Strong experience securing Microsoft Azure and Amazon AWS environments in cloud-native and hybrid architectures.
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform (Terragrunt a plus), ARM, and/or Bicep.
  • Ability to read and reason about application code in at least one of .NET, Python, Ruby, or Node.js, well enough to explain a vulnerability and its fix to a developer.
  • Strong working knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, threat modeling methodologies (e.g., STRIDE), and secure software development practices.
  • Working knowledge of cloud and application identity: Entra ID and AWS IAM, managed identities and service principals, RBAC and least privilege, and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect.
  • Experience operating application and cloud security tooling, such as CNAPP/CSPM (e.g., Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca Security, CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security), application security testing (e.g., Contrast Security, Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, Black Duck Seeker), and API security (e.g., APISec, Salt Security, Traceable, 42Crunch, StackHawk).
  • Experience with manual application testing tools such as Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP.
  • Experience performing third-party vendor security assessments.
  • Familiarity with edge, WAF, and CDN platforms such as Cloudflare, Akamai, Fastly, or Imperva.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and the Microsoft 365 suite, including Entra ID and Intune.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, and ISO 27001/27002.
  • Strong scripting ability in Python or PowerShell.
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical risk to developers, vendors, and management.

Preferred

  • Defensive security experience: incident response, EDR, SIEM investigation and query languages (e.g., KQL, SPL), or detection engineering.
  • AI security experience: securing LLM-based applications and agents, MCP servers and gateways, or LLM routers, with familiarity in OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or NIST AI RMF.
  • Experience with cloud FinOps practices and observability platforms (logging, metrics, tracing), particularly as applied to AI and security workloads.
  • Container and Kubernetes security experience (e.g., AKS, EKS), including image scanning and runtime protection.
  • Experience working with penetration testing, PTaaS, or crowdsourced security testing providers.
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS, ISO 27001, GDPR, NYDFS Part 500, and TISAX. Compliance is owned by a dedicated GRC team; this role supports implementing the technical controls behind it.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, GIAC (GCSA, GWEB, GCIH, or similar), OSCP, AWS Security Specialty, or Azure Security Engineer (AZ-500).

Education and/or Training

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • Scalable operations: Identify gaps, test new approaches, and build the processes, systems, and organizational structure needed to scale efficiently

  • A successful revenue leader with experience managing complex, consultative B2B sales and account-growth motions particularly with the systematic end-market
  • A track record of building and scaling teams, consistently delivering against ambitious revenue targets, and developing high-performing talent
  • Experience selling data, research, technology, feeds or other sophisticated products to quantitative investors & researchers
  • The ability to establish credibility with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, data strategy teams, and senior investment leaders
  • Exceptional intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to understand customers, markets, products, and the technical details behind them
  • Strong strategic judgment paired with the operational discipline to turn ideas into measurable execution

  • A commitment to perfecting the craft of selling and raising the standard for the broader team
  • A highly receptive approach to feedback and a demonstrated commitment to continuous self-improvement
  • The initiative, urgency, and stamina to operate at the pace of a rapidly growing business
  • Strong executive communication and the ability to build trust across functions and levels of leadership

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities through proactive outreach and your existing network

  • Manage the complete sales process — from prospecting to contract execution — ensuring exceptional client experience
  • Represent YipitData at relevant conferences, industry events, and client meetings to strengthen our presence in the quant community

  • You have 10+ years of leadership experience selling complex products into the quant end-market
  • You have 6+ years of experience in quota-carrying roles

  • You have experience selling into quant funds, negotiating contracts with sophisticated procurement teams, and liaising with various stakeholders
  • Have a deep understanding of how to sell into this end market, the different personas and buying criteria
  • You have a track record of not only meeting but exceeding sales goals

  • You invest deeply in developing others while building a culture of accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement
  • You know how to take a business with demonstrated traction and build the strategy, team, and operating engine required to scale it

What We Offer:

See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

Description

About Us

Gambit is the AI-native resilience platform that ensures digital continuity never expires. It unifies governance across cloud, backups, security tools, and IaC, mapping applications, identifying gaps, and validating recovery paths in real time. Gambit turns resilience assumptions into business certainty before an incident ever occurs.

﻿The Opportunity

As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you own a book of roughly 9 to 15 enterprise accounts end to end, from kickoff through renewal, and you do it independently: your work does not get reviewed before it reaches a customer. You make sure each customer actually gets more resilient with Gambit, can prove it to their board and regulators, and renews and grows.

The difference from the level below is judgment. You handle multi-cloud estates, regulated customers, difficult executive conversations, and ambiguous findings without a safety net, and you mentor newer TAMs while making the team's playbooks better. You do not carry a quota; you carry retention, adoption, posture improvement, and the trust of the accounts you own.

About the Role

  • Onboarding. Confirm success criteria in writing, drive the implementation plan, and validate business application mapping, criticality tiering, and RTO and RPO targets with the customer.
  • Posture advisory. Translate Gambit findings into prioritized remediation plans tied to business impact, engineering effort, and risk retired, and advise on backup policy, immutability, isolation, and clean recovery paths.
  • Compliance evidence. Build control-level evidence packages for internal audit, external auditors, and regulators across DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Executive reviews. Own the quarterly business review with executive sponsors, and produce posture assessments and cost-of-remediation analyses verified against real data.
  • Escalations and renewal risk. Own escalations end to end, including severity-one events; maintain a risk register and renewal readiness assessment for every account; and hand expansion signals to the Account Executive with the technical justification already built.
  • Team and product. Mentor newer TAMs, improve the team's playbooks and templates, and represent customers to Product and R&D with evidence-backed demand.

Requirements

  • 7+ years in technical account management, customer success engineering, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or post-sale technical delivery, with at least 3 years owning enterprise accounts directly.
  • Deep working knowledge of at least one major cloud, with hands-on experience across backup and disaster recovery: retention, immutability and WORM, replication, restore point hygiene, and RTO and RPO planning, applied to real enterprise environments rather than in theory.
  • Experience supporting an enterprise customer through an audit or compliance review, producing evidence mapped to controls under at least one of DORA, NIS2, SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST, plus a working understanding of infrastructure as code and how drift happens in practice.
  • Comfortable querying APIs, working with JSON, and building your own analyses without waiting on someone else, with growing use of AI tooling to speed up customer-facing work.
  • A track record of retention and expansion across a book of enterprise accounts, including at least one at-risk account you stabilized.
  • Credible in front of CISOs and infrastructure leaders without support from leadership, with executive-facing deliverables you personally built.
  • Experience mentoring or reviewing the work of peers, and contributing improvements that others on your team adopted.
  • Comfort operating without established process, four years of college-level courses in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, and openness to up to 20% travel.

  • Experience at a cyber resilience, backup and recovery, data protection, CSPM, or observability vendor, or with platforms such as Veeam, Rubrik, Cohesity, or Commvault
  • Prior hands-on experience as a cloud, infrastructure, SRE, or security engineer

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Cloud Platform Engineer to join our Runway team. In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain the infrastructure and developer tooling that powers our engineering organization. You will play a key role in advancing our Kubernetes-based platform, maturing our GitOps practices, and driving infrastructure-as-code adoption across the business.

This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure, automation, and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Kubernetes Platform Management — Operate, maintain, and improve production-grade Kubernetes clusters across cloud environments; manage cluster lifecycle including upgrades, scaling, and reliability.
  • GitOps & Continuous Delivery — Own and extend our ArgoCD-based GitOps workflows; develop and maintain Application Sets, manage sync policies, and enforce deployment standards across environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code — Write, review, and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage cloud infrastructure; enforce IaC best practices including module reuse, state management, and drift detection.
  • Platform Reliability — Monitor platform health, respond to incidents, conduct post-mortems, and drive improvements to availability, performance, and observability.
  • Developer Enablement — Collaborate with application teams to onboard services onto the platform; create documentation, runbooks, and self-service tooling that improves developer productivity.
  • Security & Compliance — Implement RBAC, network policies, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator), and ensure infrastructure meets security and compliance requirements.
  • CI/CD Integration — Integrate platform capabilities with CI pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Tekton) to support end-to-end delivery workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in a platform, infrastructure, DevOps, or SRE role
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments (EKS, GKE, or AKS preferred)
  • Demonstrable experience with ArgoCD or comparable GitOps tooling (Flux, etc.)
  • Proficiency in Terraform for cloud infrastructure provisioning; familiarity with remote state, workspaces, and module design
  • Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Comfortable writing scripts and automation in Python, Bash, or Go
  • Familiarity with Helm for Kubernetes package management
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, ingress, service mesh concepts
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to document systems clearly and collaborate across teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, Cilium)
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code tools such as OPA/Gatekeeper or Kyverno
  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki)
  • Knowledge of Crossplane or other Kubernetes-native IaC approaches
  • Contributions to open-source projects or internal platform tooling
  • Experience with multi-cluster or multi-region Kubernetes architectures
  • Relevant certifications: CKA, CKAD, AWS Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate
