jobs.description:
In the United States, one in five adults experience a mental health illness and over 12 million people have thoughts of suicide. Mental health crises can be some of the most difficult times in a person’s life, and over 17 million people seeking behavioral health care experience a delay in accessing care. Willow Health is on a mission to significantly improve this experience by expanding affordable access to high-quality, evidence-based intensive behavioral health care.

In order to make this mission a reality, we are building a virtual crisis care program that provides personalized, recovery-oriented care for people experiencing behavioral health crises. Willow Health offers patients immediate access to evidence-based virtual crisis psychotherapy, medication management, certified peer coaching, care management, and around the clock crisis coverage, while working to connect patients to the most appropriate next level of care. Our co-founding team of Cityblock and Oscar alums has two decades of collective experience working in healthcare and healthcare tech, and we are backed by Andreessen Horowitz.

As Willow Health continues to grow and expand into new markets, we are seeking an experienced Billing Specialist to support accurate, timely, and compliant billing across our payor mix.

This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day billing activities across the revenue cycle, including claim submission, claim follow-up, denial resolution, payment review, and accounts receivable management. The Billing Specialist will work closely with Revenue Cycle leadership to identify billing issues, resolve payor-related barriers, and ensure services are appropriately reimbursed.

The ideal candidate is an experienced medical biller who can work independently, investigate complex billing issues, understand payor requirements, and take ownership of claims through final resolution.

Day to Day Responsibilities

  • Review claims for accuracy and completeness prior to submission, including patient demographics, insurance information, provider information, coding, modifiers, place of service, and other billing requirements.

  • Submit clean claims to commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payors.

  • Monitor claim status and proactively follow up on unpaid, underpaid, rejected, and denied claims.

  • Research and resolve claim denials and rejections, including identifying root causes, making necessary corrections, submitting reconsiderations or appeals, and tracking claims through resolution.

  • Work accounts receivable and aging reports according to established follow-up timelines and priorities.

  • Review payor remittances and Explanation of Benefits/Explanation of Payment documentation to identify payment discrepancies, denials, recoupments, and other issues requiring follow-up.

  • Identify underpayments and reimbursement discrepancies and escalate or pursue resolution as appropriate.

  • Correct and resubmit claims when billing errors or payor requirements are identified.

  • Communicate with insurance companies regarding eligibility, claim status, authorization, reimbursement, and other billing-related issues.

  • Maintain clear and complete documentation of billing follow-up and actions taken.

  • Identify recurring denial patterns, payor issues, or workflow problems and communicate trends to Revenue Cycle leadership.

  • Collaborate with clinical, operations, credentialing, and revenue cycle teams to resolve issues affecting claim submission or reimbursement.

  • Maintain working knowledge of payor billing requirements and changes impacting reimbursement.

  • Support billing-related audits, reconciliations, and other revenue cycle initiatives as needed.

Success in this Role Will Be Measured By:

  • Timely and accurate submission of clean claims.

  • Effective follow-up and resolution of outstanding accounts receivable.

  • Reduction and timely resolution of claim denials and rejections.

  • Accurate identification and recovery of underpayments.

  • Thorough and consistent documentation of billing activity.

  • Ability to independently research and resolve payor and claim issues.

  • Identification of recurring billing trends and opportunities to improve revenue cycle processes.

Our Ideal Candidate Has:

  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on medical billing and accounts receivable experience.

  • Strong experience working claims across the full billing lifecycle, from initial submission through final payment or resolution.

  • Experience billing commercial insurance, Medicare, and Medicaid.

  • Strong knowledge of claim submission, rejection resolution, denial management, appeals, accounts receivable follow-up, and payor reimbursement.

  • Working knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, place-of-service requirements, and standard healthcare billing terminology.

  • Experience using payor portals, clearinghouses, and electronic health record/practice management systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to research complex billing issues and independently determine appropriate next steps.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies or errors that may impact reimbursement.

  • Ability to prioritize a high-volume workload and consistently follow claims through resolution.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.

  • An openness to and ability to respond to constructive feedback.

  • A desire to improve mental health care delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Medical billing experience within behavioral health, psychiatry, or mental health services strongly preferred.

  • Experience billing psychotherapy, psychiatric evaluation, crisis services, and evaluation and management services.

  • Experience working within a multi-state healthcare or telehealth organization.

  • Experience with both fee-for-service Medicaid and Medicaid managed care.

  • Experience identifying denial trends and contributing to process improvements that improve clean claim rates and reimbursement.

  • CPC, CPB, or other relevant billing/coding certification is a plus, but not required with equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Be a cultural carrier who embodies our values:

  • Safety above all else. We operate in a space with life and death repercussions, and every member of our team takes that responsibility seriously. We all look for and call out patient safety concerns.

  • Maximize measurable impact. We put our patients first. We are tenacious about doing good, and we have the outcomes to prove it. Our work is guided by measurable hypotheses that we test and re-evaluate.

  • Build inclusively and equitably. We are committed to decreasing the systemic inequalities in healthcare and to building an organization where a diverse group of patients and employees can thrive. We seek to understand and learn from differences rather than minimize them.

  • Stakes determine speed. Where the stakes are low, we optimize for quick learnings and progress. Where the stakes are higher, we are more thoughtful and methodical. Where safety is a concern, we optimize for zero errors.

  • Constellations, not stars. We believe a well functioning team is worth much more than a collection of individuals, and we invest in bringing out the best in each other. We are kind, loyal, and direct.

  • Honor commitments; honor yourself. We do our best work when we are fulfilled, our core needs are met, and there is joy along the way. We are clear about what we can and can’t do so that we can honor our commitments and fulfill them excellently.

  • Empowerment and empathy. Wherever possible, we empower others rather than decide for them. When we make decisions that affect others, we seek their perspective and minimize harm done.

Benefits

  • PTO includes sick leave, certain federal holidays, and vacation

  • Wellness and Internet stipend

  • 401K

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

This role requires permanent residence in the United States.

jobs.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation

  • Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
  • Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
  • Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.

Partner & Marketplace Operations

  • Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
  • Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
  • Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
  • Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
  • Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.

Reporting & Process

  • Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
  • Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.

What We Look For

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
  • Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
  • Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
  • Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
  • Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches.
  • Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
  • Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

You will be working with an Australian financial services and technology-driven organisation that delivers outsourced finance operations to businesses across the construction, trades, professional services, and broader services sectors.

The organisation combines accounting expertise with technology-enabled financial processes to provide comprehensive financial management services, including accounts payable, reconciliations, month-end reporting, and financial oversight.

About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for a top-performing Programmatic Sales Director to work a specified list of agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across Washington and the greater DC area. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of revenue growth and has a book of healthy, strong relationships across the Washington region.

Day In The Life:

As a Programmatic Sales Director you will drive demand for Wunderkind display & video ad inventory from agencies & advertisers across DC agency and brand accounts, ultimately meeting/exceeding revenue goals by:

  • Developing a holistic understanding of the Wunderkind product offering and how its differentiation can best serve your clients' needs
  • Building relationships with multiple layers of decision makers in the programmatic buying cycle (in-house marketers, agencies, and trading desks)
  • Developing and executing effective sales strategies to qualified targets
  • Working hand-in-hand with account managers to ensure accounts are being serviced properly and revenue is maximized
  • Acting as liaison between the market and our internal team to ensure our product continues to evolve with buyers' needs

As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually.
jobs.description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Manager, Member Journey & Knowledge Management owns two primary outcomes: the health of the Member Services knowledge base, and a complete, accurate picture of the end-to-end member journey — its processes, policies, and pain points. The ability to own and influence both, are paramount to the role.

This role documents and maps how the member journey actually works today, keeps the knowledge base that describes it accurate and trustworthy, and uses both to identify where Product can meaningfully improve the member experience, from the perspective of efficiency/effectiveness as well as automation where possible.

This is a deep, focused ownership role. Success means the knowledge base is clean and trusted for both human and AI agents, the journey is fully mapped and understood end-to-end, and Product team has a clear, evidence-based view into where to invest next.

What you'll do:

Knowledge Base Health & Governance

  • Own the OneImaging knowledge base as the single source of truth.
  • Own knowledge content lifecycle: identify and remediate outdated, duplicate, conflicting, or orphaned content.
  • Establish and maintain the governance framework for content ownership, review cycles, approvals, and retirement.
  • Define and maintain knowledge architecture: taxonomy, tagging, and organization to keep content findable.
  • Monitor knowledge health: accuracy, freshness, duplication, content gaps, and search effectiveness.
  • Ensure content is structured to support both human agents and AI-enabled support tools.
  • Build reporting and dashboards that give leadership ongoing visibility into knowledge base health.

End-to-End Member Journey Processes & Policies

  • Own documentation of the full member journey encompassing every process and policy a member touches from first contact through resolution.
  • Partner with Business Owners and Product SMEs to validate that documented processes reflect actual practice.
  • Ensure that when a process or policy changes, it's reflected consistently across all documentation and the knowledge base.
  • Build and maintain visual, end-to-end process maps of the member journey across systems, teams, and handoffs.

Product Enablement for Member Journey Improvement

  • Serve as the Member Services voice into Product: translate journey pain points, knowledge gaps, and operational friction into clear product opportunities.
  • Analyze journey data, member feedback, and knowledge base usage to identify where product changes would most improve the member experience.
  • Maintain visibility into upcoming product changes that affect the member journey and assess their downstream impact on processes and knowledge.
  • Partner with Product to validate that shipped changes improve the member experience as intended.

About you:

Required Experience

  • 5+ years in knowledge management, business process management, or journey/process mapping — preferably within Digital Health, Health Insurance, Radiology, or Tech-Enabled Healthcare Services.
  • Proven experience owning a knowledge base end-to-end, including governance practices (ownership, review cycles, accuracy standards, retirement).
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining process maps (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) for complex, cross-functional workflows.
  • Experience partnering with Product teams to translate operational or process insights into clear requirements or opportunities.
  • Comfortable working without direct reports — able to drive outcomes by influencing SMEs, Product, and Operations partners.
  • Experience with knowledge base and CRM/support platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce, Notion).
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to build governance and mapping standards from first principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in radiology, medical imaging, or diagnostic services — clinical coordination, patient access, or operations.
  • Familiarity with radiology workflows: prior authorization, imaging order management, payer-specific protocols, provider network coordination.
  • Experience structuring knowledge content for AI-enabled support tools.

Who You Are

A systems thinker who instinctively maps how work actually flows before trying to fix it.

  • Treats a messy knowledge base or an undocumented process as something to solve, not just flag.
  • Keeps the member at the center of every process, policy, and product conversation — always asking “what does this feel like for the person on the other end?”
  • Believes affordable, transparent healthcare access matters, and wants their work to be part of how OneImaging delivers on that promise.
  • Data-driven but human-centered: uses journey and knowledge data to find problems, and judgment to prioritize fixes.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 - $115,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

jobs.description:
Standort: München, remote innerhalb Deutschlands

Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft

Warum diese Rolle

Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion.

Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status.

Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026

Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert.

Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen?

Aufgaben

Was du machst

  • Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion.

  • Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können.

  • Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie.

  • Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos.

Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise

  • Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie

  • Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare

  • KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung

  • Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird.

Anforderungen

Was wir suchen

Must-haves

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung.

  • Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team.

  • Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert.

  • Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo.

  • Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen.

  • Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise.

Nice-to-haves

  • Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik.

  • Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams.

  • Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects).

Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs.

Benefits

So arbeiten wir

  • Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an.

  • Flexibel: remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Standort München. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten.

  • Wenig Bürokratie: klare Verantwortlichkeiten, schnelles Feedback, keine endlosen Abstimmungsrunden.

Was wir bieten

  • Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, je nachdem, was besser zu dir passt.

  • Eine Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung entspricht, als Gehalt oder als Tages- bzw. Stundensatz.

  • Die langfristige Perspektive, unseren Produktkern zu verantworten.

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und unmittelbare Wirkung auf ein echtes Produkt, das von aktiven Unternehmen genutzt wird.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns eine kurze Nachricht über dich, deinen Hintergrund und deine Verfügbarkeit, dazu deine Gehaltsvorstellung oder deinen Tagessatz sowie dein LinkedIn-Profil oder Portfolio. Erzähl uns von einem komplexen Produkt oder Projekt, das du erfolgreich vom Chaos zur Klarheit geführt hast.

Kein Aufsatz nötig. Wir sehen uns jede Bewerbung an und antworten allen.

Included in this role is responsibility for assuring compliance with all pricing and reporting requirements legislated by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), the Department of Veterans Affairs and any state legislation required price reporting. This includes a full understanding of all current legislation and staying abreast of pending legislation. Government Pricing Calculations include: Medicaid, Medicare Part B, Public Health Service (PHS)/340B, and Federal Supply Schedule (FSS), which includes: TriCare and the Industrial Funding Fee (IFF). The Associate Director will work collaboratively with Contracting Strategy supporting the overall strategy, contracting and/or payment activities.

A typical day may include the following:

  • Ability to calculate, validate and report accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual government pricing.

  • Submit and monitor State Price Transparency regulations.

  • Complete understanding of calculation reasonable assumptions and methodologies and ability to research and communicate cause of variances of results when comparing current period to prior periods.

  • Perform all necessary processes needed to ensure compliant submissions including, but not limited to G/L reconciliations, Class of Trade (COT) review, and PHS/340b eligibility review.

  • Associate Director will review calculations with Senior Management and obtain approval signoff (and executes any other required Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)) before communicating prices to the appropriate government agencies (Center for Medicare and Medicare (CMS), Veterans Affairs (VA)/Department of Defense (DOD), etc.) or internally.

  • Responsible for maintaining and updating SOP’s and reasonable assumptions, on a quarterly basis, as related to Government Programs/Pricing.

  • Monitor policies, procedures and processes supporting Government Pricing submissions and related areas to ensure ongoing compliance with external and internal requirements and guidance.

  • Understand and estimate impact of pricing and policy changes regarding government pricing.

  • Perform pricing research and analysis on special projects as assigned.

  • Ability to review and understand commercial contract language as pertaining to Best Price (BP), Average Sales Price (ASP) and FSS Tracking Customers.

As a Senior Software Engineer on NVIDIA’s Global Network Visibility (GNV) team within NVIDIA's Global Network Infrastructure (GNI) organization, you will lead the platform that turns network topology, configuration, telemetry, and direct measurement into trusted, self-service insight. Your work will help teams understand network health and customer impact, accelerate incident triage, and bring AI, storage, backbone, and edge infrastructure online with confidence.


You will set direction across authoritative network data, scalable measurement, and customer-facing visibility products. You will define durable interfaces, lead cross-domain decisions, and guide build-versus-buy choices. Success means the platform is credible, adopted, and trusted.


What you'll be doing:

  • Set the architecture for a unified platform spanning topology, configuration, telemetry, active measurement, change intelligence, and self-service experiences
  • Build an authoritative network model connecting physical topology, logical overlays, configurations, and service dependencies across systems of record, and use it to catch physical and logical configuration errors during cluster bring-up
  • Define a telemetry & measurement strategy combining reachability tests, streaming signals, traffic & capacity data, and change & maintenance events
  • Deliver intuitive health, path, blast-radius, and self-service exploration products that help customers answer network questions independently
  • Establish interfaces, data contracts, quality standards, and operating mechanisms that let teams contribute without fragmenting the experience
  • Drive cross-functional roadmaps; make clear tradeoffs among speed, cost, reliability, and maintainability; and mentor engineers through critical designs

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, plus 10+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Record of architecting and operating large-scale software or infrastructure platforms, with strong proficiency in Python, Go, or a comparable systems language
  • Deep expertise in one area—with breadth across the others: network topology and sources of truth, telemetry and active measurement, or observability products
  • Strong data center and backbone networking fundamentals across physical connectivity, routing, overlays, services, and customer-visible failures
  • Hands-on experience across an observability stack such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry, including active or synthetic monitoring and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
  • Experience with large-scale graph, relational, time-series, streaming, API, or event-driven systems that reconcile multiple sources
  • Technical leadership across teams, with strong product and operational judgment and clear tradeoffs among performance, resiliency, usability, and cost

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Led a network visibility or infrastructure intelligence platform spanning thousands of devices or hosts
  • Experience with AI or HPC networks, including RDMA, RoCE over Spectrum-X, or InfiniBand
  • Experience with network sources of truth such as NetBox or Nautobot, streaming telemetry (gRPC/gNMI), graph databases, or front-end development in TypeScript and React
  • SRE or network operations experience, plus a record of setting standards, making build-versus-buy decisions, or contributing to open source

NVIDIA is widely considered one of the world's most desirable employers in technology. We have some of the world's most forward-thinking and passionate people working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!


NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent.

jobs.title: Principal Architect, System Software - Orbital Data Center
jobs.excerpt: Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission.
jobs.description:
Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. It is the first step in a multi-generation orbital roadmap to speed up AI adoption. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space.

  • Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions.

  • Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack.

  • Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes.

  • Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit.

  • Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground.

  • Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering.

  • Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture.

  • Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies.

  • Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers.

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability

  • BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience).

  • Working experience in building AI infrastructure and systems in space. Proven record of architecting and delivering platform software for large-scale data centers or mission-critical embedded systems.

  • Strong knowledge of server architecture, data center manageability, and full-stack integration of firmware with OS and accelerator software. Hands-on experience with data center health management workflows, telemetry, and fault management at scale.

  • Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM.

  • Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python.

  • Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments.

  • Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day.

  • You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers.

  • Hands-on experience with autonomous, remote, or unreachable data center operations — in-orbit or in-field firmware update, dual-module redundancy, and recovery without physical access. Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS).

  • Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002).

  • Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams.

  • Skilled in reviewing hardware schematics and PCB layouts for debugging, design verification, and collaboration with hardware engineers.

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern deep learning — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 272,000 USD - 431,250 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.excerpt: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Streams UI team, where you'll have the chance to shape and enhance our user interface, making it more intuitive and engaging for our users. In this role, you'll work on Fleet. Fleet is the central management experience for Elastic Agent in Kibana. You'll also work on Streams. Streams is our new tool for handling log data. This includes ingesting, organizing, parsing, enriching, and setting retention for the data. You will be part of a skilled group of engineers and designers. You will contribute your expertise and learn from others. If you enjoy tackling complex challenges and want to make a meaningful impact on our product, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design and implement intuitive user interface components that enhance user commitment, using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Integrate front-end elements seamlessly with back-end services to ensure a smooth user experience. Conduct usability testing and gather user feedback to drive continuous improvements.
  • Own complex, loosely-defined problems end-to-end: shape the approach, split the work if needed, make the key technical decisions, and deliver.
  • Lead discussions on architecture and system design. During these discussions, consider trade-offs. Also, think about backwards compatibility, performance, and scale.
  • Establish coding standards and ensure the team adheres to them throughout the development process. Promote reusable components to improve efficiency and implement automated testing and deployment to maintain code quality. Evaluate new technologies for potential integration and document best practices to facilitate team-wide knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Offer constructive feedback and identify potential security vulnerabilities in the codebase. Focus on maintaining code readability and facilitate discussions with team members to address any findings from the code review.
  • Collaborate async across timezones with a fully-distributed team, working in the open on GitHub and in Slack.
  • Partner closely with designers and product managers to apprehend user experience goals and translate their mockups into functional UI components. Ensure a consistent visual design across all UI elements. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative ideas for enhancing the user interface.

What You Bring

  • Solid production experience with full-stack JavaScript, preferably TypeScript ; React on the front end and Node.js on the back end. Some experience with Reactflow is a plus.
  • A track record of leading non-trivial projects end-to-end, with real design ownership and minimal guidance.
  • Proficient architecture and system-design judgment, including in large, existing codebases.
  • Successfully designed and launched multiple user interface components that significantly increased user commitment
  • You should have experience using AI-assisted development tools. These tools can help you develop features faster, fix complex systems, and improve existing codebases.
  • Exemplary written and verbal communication, and a genuine excitement for async collaboration and knowledge-sharing.
  • A multiplier mindset ! you make the engineers around you better.
  • A generalist streak and a user-focused mindset, with consideration for the people using your software.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the Elastic stack, observability tooling, or log/data-ingestion pipelines.
  • Go, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development experience.
  • Experience building large user interfaces that manage a lot of data. This includes skills in search, filtering, and tables. You should also have experience working with streaming or real-time data.
  • Prior open-source / working-in-the-open experience, or time on a developer-facing platform team.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations

  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service

Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.
The Head of Investor Relations will lead Entrata’s investor relations function and serve as a key partner to the CFO, CEO and executive team. This leader will prepare the company for investor engagement, and establish the communications, market intelligence and operating practices needed for a successful public-company IR program.

Responsibilities

  • Build investor and analyst relationships: Establish a thoughtful engagement program with current and prospective investors and sell-side analysts, and help cultivate a long-term shareholder base aligned with Entrata’s strategy.

  • Manage investor communications: Coordinate quarterly earnings materials, earnings calls, investor presentations, the IR website and other external communications in partnership with Finance, Legal, Communications and executive leadership.

  • Support disclosure and governance processes: Work with Legal and Finance to support accurate, consistent and timely public disclosures and ensure investor communications follow applicable securities laws and company policies.

  • Deliver market intelligence: Monitor investor feedback, analyst perspectives, valuation trends, peer performance and market developments; summarize relevant insights for the executive team and board.

  • Coordinate cross-functional IR activities: Build strong working relationships across Finance, Legal, Accounting, Sales, Product and Communications to ensure the company’s external messaging is well-supported and consistent.

  • Establish the IR function: Develop the calendar, processes, materials and internal controls needed to run an effective investor relations program

Minimum Qualifications

  • Significant experience in investor relations, including prior work within or advising a publicly traded company.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate guidance, valuation methodologies, capital markets, and public-company reporting.

  • Proven ability to clearly articulate complex business models, strategic initiatives, and financial performance to buy-side investors and sell-side analysts.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills suited for senior leadership, board-level interactions, and public messaging.

  • Sound judgment and strict discretion when handling Material Nonpublic Information (MNPI) and sensitive corporate disclosures.

  • Strong project-management skills with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment across Finance, Legal, Accounting, Product, and executive leadership teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience supporting or leading a company through a public-market transition.

  • Master of Business Administration (MBA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation, or equivalent professional credentials.

  • Experience handling SaaS or high-growth technology valuation metrics in investor communications.

  • Experience leveraging modern GenAI workflows to accelerate messaging deliverables, competitive intelligence, and investor feedback analysis while maintaining data governance.

HSA/FSA options and employer-paid disability benefits provided for eligible employees.

Overview

Elvoro is seeking an experienced sponsorship sales professional to secure corporate sponsors for our exclusive, private AI event in Davos in January 2027, taking place alongside the WEF.

You will take ownership of the sponsorship acquisition process, from identifying potential sponsors and reaching decision-makers to pitching opportunities, negotiating terms, and securing signed agreements and payments.

We are looking for a commercially driven, independent sales professional with a proven track record of closing corporate sponsorship deals and ideally an established network of relevant decision-makers.

This is a short-term, results-driven opportunity with significant commission potential, flexible working arrangements, and the possibility of continued collaboration. Our team will provide the necessary event information, sponsorship packages, and support with final negotiations where needed.

  • Pipeline Management: Build and manage a qualified sponsorship pipeline, maintain consistent follow-ups, and prioritize opportunities with the highest conversion potential.

  • Sales & Negotiation: Understand prospective sponsors' objectives, communicate the commercial value of the event, present sponsorship packages, and negotiate agreements. Our founder may assist with final discussions involving serious prospects.

  • Closing: Convert qualified prospects into paying sponsors, coordinating signed agreements and completed payments with our team.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of successfully securing paid corporate sponsorships, preferably for business events, conferences, or exclusive private events.

  • Ability to independently manage the full sales cycle and deliver results within a limited timeframe.

  • Excellent professional English communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Self-driven, independent, and commercially focused.

  • Strongly preferred: An established network of relevant corporate decision-makers and previous experience securing high-value sponsorship agreements.

Compensation & Benefits

Earn up to $25,000 in sponsorship sales commission, depending on the number and value of successfully secured sponsorship agreements. The event has a limited allocation of four event partner positions. A lower, fixed, one-time base payment for the engagement might also be negotiated.

The opportunity offers substantial independence, growing your sales experience and network, and direct involvement in securing commercial partnerships for a high-profile private event in Davos. Successful collaboration may also lead to an ongoing sales engagement. An invitation to attend the event in Davos, potentially including covered expenses, may be offered based on performance and is not guaranteed.

jobs.description:
DIRECTOR, AI & DATA SCIENCE

Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science | Full-Time, Salaried | Player-Coach | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company

Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location

Remote, anywhere in the USA

Team

Six to seven individual contributors across data engineering, analytics, data science, ML, and MLOps

Education

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field required. Master’s or PhD preferred.

Compensation

$175,000 to $225,000 base

Schedule

Collaboration across time zones. Regular working-hour overlap with our Singapore Dev team and partners is required.

Travel

Required for team weeks and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a lean company of about 60 people, so every leader here builds.

You will lead our combined Data Engineering & Analytics, AI, and Data Science team of six to seven individual contributors and report directly to the Co-CEOs. This team is Seeking's central AI capability: the models, infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, and continuous-learning systems the whole company runs on. Expect about half your time leading and half writing code, building models, and debugging production systems yourself.

Your first mandate is to achieve 100% AI automation of routine user-uploaded content moderation, with accuracy proven superior to our human moderators and at a lower total cost. Next is AI customer support that resolves member tickets end to end. You own both outcomes completely, from policy and data through production results.

Over time, the team will extend AI to fraud prevention, matching, member onboarding and success, marketing, monetization, retention, and product development, in partnership with the leaders who own those areas. Every initiative carries a measurable target, a named owner, and a mechanism for continuous learning. The immediate problems come first, and this role exists to solve them.

This role is for someone who manages a hands-on team today and still ships code. If your recent roles had managers reporting to you, or you plan to delegate the technical work and manage through status meetings, this is the wrong role. If you walk into ambiguity and know exactly what to do, keep reading.

What You Will Do

1. Set the foundation in your first 30 days

  • Bring Product, Support, and Operations to one written moderation policy with a single owner. When teams disagree, you run the process that settles it.
  • Inventory every production AI system with a named owner, backup, dependencies, and monitoring gaps.
  • Trace every upload from receipt through model decision, enforcement, and any human review. Quantify every path that still needs a human, with its root cause, cost, and fix.

2. Prove AI beats our human moderators, then reach 100%

  • Test the AI and our moderators on the same held-out cases, with reference decisions set by independent, policy-qualified reviewers. Report missed violations and wrongful rejections separately, with sample sizes and confidence intervals.
  • Close every gap: missing coverage, uncertain model outputs, system failures, unenforced decisions, and duplicate human review. Expand automation in controlled stages, each with a tested rollback.

3. Build systems that keep getting better

  • Every production system improves through verified feedback, independent evaluation, and controlled releases. Run a monthly learning cycle in which a new model ships only when it beats production on the same independent test.
  • Version every dataset, policy, prompt, and model so every gain can be proven and every change can be rolled back.

4. Run production AI like a business

  • Give every production AI system monitoring, alerts to a named owner, documented recovery, and regular failure drills.
  • Report results in business terms: quality, cost per outcome, revenue, efficiency, and member experience, with savings reconciled with Finance. Keep one executive dashboard and run a weekly review with the Co-CEOs.

5. Automate support, then partner across Seeking

  • Own AI customer support end to end: agents that resolve tickets and execute approved actions, such as subscription changes and eligible refunds, held to the same evaluation, rollout, and monitoring standards as moderation.
  • Once moderation and support are delivered, partner with the leaders of Marketing, Product, and other departments on fraud, matching, onboarding, monetization, and retention. Bring the Co-CEOs a ranked list of opportunities by impact on cost, revenue, efficiency, and member experience.
  • In those partnerships, department leaders own their business outcomes. Your team owns the models, infrastructure, evaluation, and learning systems, and is accountable for their performance.

6. Lead and grow the team

  • Review each person's work line by line, pair on hard problems, and give direct feedback every week. Build a growth plan for everyone, recruit strong talent, and address performance gaps early.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for the function and each direct report, with leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result. Run the work in Jira, Confluence, and Monday.

What You Must Bring

  • A Bachelor’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field. A Master’s or Ph.D. in CS, AI, ML, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
  • Seven or more years delivering production data or ML systems, including three or more years managing teams of individual contributors. You manage a hands-on team today, or did so recently.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with production code you personally wrote in the past year. You will code in the interview.
  • Production ML and architecture judgment. You have designed, built, and operated ML and LLM systems end to end, from data pipelines through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, on a major cloud platform.
  • You have done this before. You led an AI automation program in moderation, trust and safety, support, or a comparable decision system, from a measured human baseline to automated decisions at scale.
  • Evaluation rigor and continuous learning. You measure false negatives and false positives separately, report uncertainty, keep test data clean, and have built systems that improve through feedback and controlled updates.
  • Measurable business impact. You can name the cost, revenue, efficiency, or member outcomes your work moved, with the numbers.
  • Cross-functional influence. You have found AI opportunities in other departments, won over their leaders, and taken the solution from concept into production.
  • A record of mentoring engineers and scientists into stronger, more senior contributors.
  • Daily use of Claude, Claude Code, Cowork, or comparable AI tools. If someone has to explain to you why AI matters, this role is not for you.

Nice to Have

  • Production work in multi-modal or computer vision moderation, fraud detection, recommender systems, or marketing and monetization models such as propensity, pricing, and lifetime value.
  • Our stack: AWS (S3, Redshift, SageMaker, Bedrock), Looker, and Kubernetes.

Compensation

  • $175,000 to $225,000 base, commensurate with experience. Full-time, salaried, remote within the US.
  • 99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision. 50% 401(k) match up to 6%. Flexible Spending Account and flexible paid time off.

How We Hire

  • Recruiter screen: code you wrote in the last 90 days, the team you manage, and logistics.
  • Practical round: live SQL and Python, plus a production architecture discussion.
  • Systems round: work through a simplified moderation workflow. Find where items fall back to humans, define an honest automation rate, and design the evaluation against human moderators.
  • Co-CEO round: treat it as a pitch. Study the product, ask sharp questions, and bring your 90-day plan for moderation and customer support.
  • References, including a former direct report.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.
