jobs.description:
Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

We unify IT operations and cybersecurity into a single, accountable operating model that reduces risk, accelerates response, and strengthens resilience across the systems businesses depend on. With shared visibility, integrated workflows, and clear ownership, organizations gain greater control, fewer blind spots, and more confidence in their technology.

Our approach is cyber-first by design, embedding protection into every layer, from end user to edge to cloud. By combining AI-assisted monitoring with human-led expertise, we deliver faster insight, smarter decisions, and more effective outcomes without the complexity of siloed tools.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement
  • Make a real impact by helping organizations reduce risk and build resilience

Job Summary:

The Financial Planning & Analysis Director acts as a strategic partner to the business, helping drive growth and optimal financial outcomes. The Director of FP&A will play a vital role in assisting with the company’s short-term and long-term financial forecasting, capital planning, pricing and process optimization, and key strategic initiatives. This role will lead the department’s strategic direction and be charged with ensuring business operations align with Logically’s vision, mission, and values.

This role requires a highly motivated professional, who will make a significant impact and is comfortable working with senior leaders and cross-functional teams. This is a highly visible role and will be a key asset in the future growth of the company. 

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

Financial Planning & Reporting

  • Strategically lead the FP&A process, including partnering across the business to support Logically’s vision
  • Own the enterprise-wide annual budgeting process, rolling forecasts, and long-range strategic and capital planning
  • Maintain and develop detailed financial models that track and analyze key metrics and their impact on the company's overall performance
  • Analyze current and past trends in KPIs including all areas of revenue, expenses, and other business drivers
  • Assume responsibility for delivery of monthly consolidated financial reporting package to private-equity investors
  • Conduct scenario analysis and sensitivity modeling to support agile decision-making in a dynamic environment

Business Partnering & Strategy

  • Partner with senior management in the coordination and completion of the planning process including annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-term strategic financial planning
  • Serve as a strategic finance partner to commercial, operational and functional leaders – translating financial data into actionable insight on cost, margin, investment and growth
  • Assist in leading & creating partnerships with Accounting, HR, IT, and other cross-functional business units to report monthly expenses and headcount planning and reporting across the organization
  • Support the development of executive communications for high-level presentations for senior management, including the company executive team, board of directors, private equity investors, lenders, and other stakeholders
  • Monitor business performance against internal KPI targets and external benchmarks, and partner with leaders on corrective actions

M&A & Integration

  • Support financial due diligence, including the creation/review of financial models for any potential M&A transactions
  • Lead integration efforts for financial reporting and financial planning for acquired entities

Sales Compensation

  • Partner with Sales and HR leadership on the design, modeling and implementation of sales compensation plans that align seller incentives with company growth targets
  • Analyze the financial impact of compensation structures and provide data-driven recommendations to senior leadership
  • Assist with and manage frequent ad hoc projects to support management and business decisions

Technology, Automation & AI

  • Champion the adoption of AI-enabled tools and approaches to enhance analysis quality, accelerate reporting cycles, and improve decision support
  • Lead and support finance process automation initiatives – identifying opportunities to eliminate manual, repetitive workflows and replace them with scalable, technology-driven solutions
  • Serve as a responsible steward of AI-generated outputs, ensuring accuracy, integrity and alignment with business strategy before presenting to leadership or investors
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial systems, planning tools, and reporting automation to scale with company growth

Qualifications:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline required (MBA or CPA preferred)

Experience

  • 9-11 years of experience in Financial Planning and Analysis, Finance, or Accounting
  • Proven experience working in a private equity-backed environment, including familiarity with PE reporting cadences, investor packages, and value-creation frameworks
  • Experience in a services industry business; experience with a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or Managed Security Service Provider (MSSP) is a strong plus but not required
  • Experience working with recurring revenue business models (e.g. SaaS, managed services, subscription-based businesses), including fluency with metrics such as ARR, Churn, NRR and LTV
  • Proven ability in financial modeling (NPV, ROI, Accretion/Dilution, etc.)
  • Experience supporting M&A due diligence, financial integration of entities and synergy analysis
  • Experience with sales compensation plan design and implementation preferred
  • Proven track record of building and leading financial planning processes in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

Technical Skills

  • Superior skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Proficiency in SQL; ability to independently write and execute SQL queries against financial and operational databases
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI and automation tools in a finance context – including AI-assisted forecasting, variance analysis, narrative generation, or workflow automation; ability to validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and strategic alignment
  • Experience with Salesforce (CRM) and Microsoft Business Central (ERP) a plus
  • Experience with ConnectWise (PSA system) is a strong plus, but not required
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI) preferred

Core Competencies

  • Strategic insight into the market and ability to ideate and translate customer requirements, organizational challenges, and market trends into actionable strategy
  • Success designing and implementing a strategic and operating approach, infrastructure, cadence, plan, and process – with key metrics - created to increase organizational clarity, accountability, pace, and delivery
  • Thorough understanding of methods of systems analysis and the principles, design, and procedural methods used in big data analysis
  • Ability to present financial information to a non-financial audience
  • Excellent communicator – written, verbal, and in presentations- with the ability to actively listen, navigate difficult conversations, and translate complex financial concepts for non-financial audiences
  • Builds trust-based relationships across teams and internal/external stakeholders; fosters a collaborative, team-first culture and willingly shares knowledge to develop others
  • Strong analytical and business judgment, with the ability to translate complex business requirements into actionable solutions and persistently work through competing options to reach the best outcome
  • Flexible and composed under pressure, managing multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Unquestionable ethics, discretion, and sound judgment in handling sensitive and confidential financial information

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration
jobs.excerpt: Job Purpose: The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration is a senior, customer-facing technical contributor responsible for ensuring customers successfully integrate and get value from IMS's mobile SDKs, which power telematics, mobility, and insurance technology solutions.
jobs.description:
Job Purpose:

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - SDK Integration is a senior, customer-facing technical contributor responsible for ensuring customers successfully integrate and get value from IMS's mobile SDKs, which power telematics, mobility, and insurance technology solutions. Working primarily post-sales, this role acts as the technical bridge between IMS and its customers' mobile development teams, owning SDK integrations from kick-off through go-live and beyond across native iOS and Android and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). The role is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, making independent technical and customer-facing decisions, and to proactively shape how IMS supports and delivers SDK integrations.

This position is ideal for an experienced mobile SDK developer, or an experienced app developer with strong SDK integration experience, who also brings consultative, customer-facing experience who enjoys a balance of hands-on coding and advising others. The successful candidate will be comfortable working inside customer codebases to diagnose and resolve integration issues, explaining complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and using real-world customer insight to drive improvements to IMS's SDK, support model, and delivery processes.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer SDK Integration & Delivery

  • Independently own the technical delivery of IMS SDK integrations for customers, from technical kick-off and environment setup through testing, go-live, and early-life support.
  • Guide customer engineering teams through integrating the IMS SDK into native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) apps, including SDK components built with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP).
  • Advise customers on SDK configuration for trip detection, crash detection, and related features, including the appropriate setup for phone-only, Bluetooth-enabled device, and OBD-based use cases.
  • Support customers in implementing SDK authentication and user session management, including token-based (e.g. JWT) authentication flows.
  • Build sample code, reference implementations, and proof-of-concept apps to help customers adopt SDK features quickly and correctly.
  • Ensure customers correctly implement platform permissions and background behaviour (location, motion, Bluetooth, notifications) required for reliable data capture.

Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation Support

  • Independently diagnose and resolve complex customer integration issues by reviewing customer code, SDK logs, device behaviour, and backend data.
  • Reproduce customer-reported issues across devices, OS versions, and frameworks, and determine whether the root cause sits in the customer app, the SDK, or the platform.
  • Act as the senior technical point of contact for customer escalations relating to SDK integrations, working with the Service Desk and engineering teams to drive issues to resolution.
  • Raise clear, well-evidenced defect reports and feature requests for the SDK engineering teams, including reproduction steps and supporting data.
  • Contribute fixes or improvements to SDK wrappers, sample apps, and integration tooling where appropriate.

Customer Consultation & Enablement

  • Build trusted technical relationships with customer engineering teams, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Run technical workshops, integration reviews, and onboarding sessions to help customers understand SDK capabilities, best practices, and trade-offs.
  • Advise customers on mobile best practices that affect telematics data quality, such as battery optimisation, background execution limits, and OS-specific restrictions.
  • Translate customer business requirements into practical technical integration approaches.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, setting realistic expectations on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Process Improvement & Technical Leadership

  • Proactively identify gaps and inefficiencies in SDK support and delivery processes, and propose and drive practical improvements.
  • Make independent decisions on integration approaches, issue prioritisation, and customer recommendations, escalating only where business or product impact requires it.
  • Define and evolve repeatable integration playbooks, onboarding checklists, and support standards that scale across customers.
  • Recommend measures of integration and support effectiveness, such as time-to-integrate and escalation volumes, and use them to guide improvements.
  • Share knowledge and mentor colleagues across Engineering, Service Desk, and Customer Success on SDK integration and troubleshooting.
  • Influence the SDK roadmap by presenting evidence-based recommendations to Engineering and Product leadership.

Product Feedback & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with SDK Engineering, Product, QA, Customer Success, and Account Management to ensure a smooth customer integration experience.
  • Capture recurring integration challenges and customer needs, and feed them back into the SDK roadmap and product decisions.
  • Partner with engineering teams to validate new SDK releases with customers and support customers through version upgrades and migrations.

Documentation, Tooling & Continuous Improvement

  • Create and maintain integration guides, FAQs, troubleshooting playbooks, and knowledge base content for customers and internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the SDK integration experience and reduce time-to-integrate for new customers.
  • Help improve internal processes for customer onboarding, issue triage, and knowledge sharing, including the use of AI-assisted tools where they add value.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile application development for iOS and/or Android in production environments.
  • Strong proficiency in Swift (iOS) and/or Kotlin (Android), with a solid understanding of app lifecycle, permissions, and background processing.
  • Experience developing mobile SDKs or libraries for use by other developers (ideal), or substantial experience integrating third-party SDKs into mobile applications.
  • Experience working with Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) in production iOS and/or Android projects.
  • Proven experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, integration support, or professional services.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs and authentication mechanisms such as OAuth or JWT.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including analysing logs and reproducing issues across devices and OS versions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to varied audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, make sound independent decisions, and manage multiple customer integrations and priorities at once.
  • A track record of proactively improving technical support, delivery, or customer onboarding processes.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with React Native, including native modules and bridges to iOS and Android code.
  • Familiarity with Flutter and platform channels.
  • Experience in telematics, IoT, insurance technology, fleet management, or connected mobility applications.
  • Familiarity with location services, motion sensors, Bluetooth, and other device sensors used for data capture.
  • Experience supporting B2B customers or partners integrating a developer platform, SDK, or API product.
  • Experience creating developer documentation, sample apps, or technical training materials.
  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms, and with tools for log analysis and monitoring.
  • Experience working with global, distributed teams and customers across different time zones.

Other Contextual Information:

  • Remote role based in the United Kingdom or Canada (Ontario).
  • Primarily post-sales, with occasional involvement in pre-sales technical discussions where needed.
  • Occasional travel to IMS offices or customer sites may be required for onboarding, workshops, and stakeholder meetings.
  • Some flexibility in working hours may be needed to support customers in different time zones and during critical customer go-lives.

jobs.title: Vice President, International Partnership Sales
jobs.excerpt: RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands.
jobs.description:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.

As the parent company of Evo, the world’s premier fighting game tournament and community platform, RTS operates a growing global portfolio of live events, media, creator, and talent-driven experiences, including a fast-growing slate of international Evo events across Europe and Asia.

As the company expands its international footprint, we are continuing to invest in the commercial infrastructure, partnerships, and senior leadership needed to scale our revenue engine beyond the US.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a senior, well-connected, and solutions-oriented Vice President of International Partnership Sales to drive new business for Evo’s international events and the broader RTS portfolio across Europe, Asia-Pacific, LATAM, and other non-US markets.

This is not a transactional sponsorship sales role. We’re looking for an experienced seller who arrives with an active network of brand and agency relationships, leads with a marketing mindset, understands how brands and agencies define success across different markets, and can translate business objectives and KPIs into compelling, integrated partnership solutions.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of live event sponsorship sales, intellectual property, and integrated marketing across digital, media, content, experiential, creators, and event production, with direct experience selling into multiple international markets.

They will be equally comfortable opening doors, diagnosing a client challenge, building a strategic narrative, and leading a sophisticated pitch from first conversation through negotiation and close. This person will have a respectful understanding and engaged desire to learn about different cultures and their respective business norms. Given the size and pace of the international business, they must also be a genuine multi-tasker who can run a full pipeline while contributing to market strategy, partner delivery, and the continued growth of RTS’s international commercial footprint.

Reporting Structure

You will report directly to the Global Head of Sales and work closely with the International Sales Operations team, the US Partnership Sales team, and the broader Global Partnership Sales & Marketing organization.

Key Responsibilities
New Business & Revenue Growth
  • Own and grow a high-quality pipeline of brand and agency opportunities for Evo’s live international events and the broader RTS portfolio across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other priority non-US markets.
  • Prospect proactively and build relationships with senior decision-makers across regional and global brands, agency networks, media buyers, and marketing organizations outside the US.
  • Develop new partnership opportunities across live event sponsorship, media, content, experiential, live events, creators, gaming programs, production, consulting, and other RTS capabilities.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through proposal development, negotiation, contracting, and handoff across multiple markets and commercial frameworks.
  • Consistently deliver against individual revenue targets while contributing to broader team goals and commercial priorities.
  • Identify whitespace across categories, markets, and client portfolios, including regional category sponsors, endemic gaming and hardware brands, and global brands with region-specific budgets, and turn those opportunities into actionable sales strategies.
  • Partner with the US Partnership Sales team to unlock international budgets from global clients already active with RTS in the US and bring international clients into Evo’s US events where relevant.
  • Leverage an existing network of brand, agency, and rights-holder relationships across international markets to generate opportunities from day one.
  • Collaborate with external sales agencies and event production partners within the respective markets to identify, build, and execute sponsor opportunities.
Client Strategy & Solution-Oriented Selling
  • Lead discovery with a strong understanding of the client’s business, marketing objectives, audience priorities, challenges, and KPIs.
  • Break down client and agency KPIs, recognizing that these may vary by market and region, to identify the role RTS, Evo, and our capabilities can play in delivering against those goals.
  • Move beyond asset-led selling by developing customized, insight-driven solutions that connect client objectives to the right combination of IP, audience, platforms, and experiences.
  • Build compelling sales narratives that clearly articulate the strategic “why,” the consumer opportunity, the activation idea, and measurable business value.
  • Challenge traditional event sponsorship thinking and proactively bring clients ideas they may not have asked for but that solve a meaningful marketing or business need.
  • Balance creativity with commercial discipline, ensuring recommendations are differentiated, executable, scalable, and aligned with client budgets.
  • Maintain senior ownership of the client relationship beyond the close, staying actively engaged throughout the partnership lifecycle to support growth, renewal, and expansion opportunities.
Integrated Partnerships & IP Commercialization
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of how to commercialize intellectual property and translate rights and assets into meaningful brand programs.
  • Develop integrated partnership programs spanning digital, social, content, media, experiential, creators, talent, hospitality, live events, and branded activations.
  • Understand the role of media, content, and experiential extensions in increasing the reach and value of a core sponsorship platform.
  • Identify opportunities to connect Evo’s international events with Evo’s flagship US event and the broader RTS ecosystem to create larger, multi-market, more strategic partnerships.
  • Work with internal teams to develop new commercial products, packages, and scalable offerings based on market demand and client needs.
Agency & Client Leadership
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client and agency stakeholders and establish RTS as a strategic marketing partner, not simply an inventory provider.
  • Navigate complex agency and client structures across regions, including brand teams, regional and global media agencies, creative agencies, experiential agencies, and sponsorship decision-makers.
  • Lead senior-level presentations, strategic workshops, negotiations, and partnership discussions with confidence and credibility.
  • Maintain an informed point of view on client categories, competitive landscapes, consumer trends, and broader business priorities.
  • Build long-term relationships that generate repeat business, renewals, upsells, and introductions across additional brands and business units.
International Market Leadership & Multi-Market Operations
  • Serve as RTS’s senior commercial lead in priority international markets, developing a clear point of view on each market’s brand and agency landscape, buying cycles, and sponsorship norms.
  • Work effectively across time zones and cultures with clients, agencies, local event partners, and internal teams in the US, Europe, and Asia.
  • Balance multiple priorities simultaneously, including live pipeline, event-cycle deadlines across several international Evo events, partner delivery support, and internal reporting.
  • Provide input on international pricing, packaging, and rate cards that reflect local market conditions and client expectations.
  • Represent RTS at international Evo events, industry conferences, and client meetings, with regular travel across Europe and Asia.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Partner closely with International Sales Operations, Partnership Marketing, Strategy, Creative, Production, Operations, Finance, Legal, Talent, and other internal teams to develop strong and executable solutions.
  • Bring internal subject-matter experts into the sales process at the right moments while maintaining clear ownership of the client relationship and commercial opportunity.
  • Provide clear, thoughtful handoffs to Partnership Marketing and International Sales Operations following the close of a deal, including client objectives, KPIs, commitments, expectations, and renewal opportunities.
  • Share market intelligence, client feedback, category trends, and competitive insights to help evolve RTS’s commercial story and product offering.
  • Help shape and build RTS’s international commercial strategy and sales capability, mentoring team members and contributing to a collaborative, accountable, high-performance sales culture.
Commercial Leadership & Sales Discipline
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity stages, and next steps within the company’s CRM.
  • Build thoughtful account plans for priority prospects and identify the stakeholders, timing, budgets, and business triggers required to advance opportunities.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on revenue potential, strategic fit, probability, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with the Global Head of Sales on pricing, packaging, deal structure, and negotiation strategy.
  • Use data, insights, and performance learnings to continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of the sales process.
Qualifications
  • 10–12+ years of experience in live event sponsorship sales, partnerships, integrated media sales, entertainment, sports, gaming, experiential, or a related commercial discipline, with meaningful experience operating across international markets or leading multi-market initiatives.
  • Proven track record of generating significant new business revenue and closing complex, integrated partnerships, including seven-figure opportunities.
  • Established, active network of relationships with major brands, agency networks, and senior marketing decision-makers across at least one of RTS’s priority international regions, including Europe or Asia-Pacific.
  • Demonstrated ability to self-source new business, open doors quickly, and build a high-quality pipeline from the ground up.
  • Strong understanding of sponsorship, intellectual property, integrated marketing, digital media, experiential marketing, content, and live-event sales.
  • Demonstrated ability to uncover client needs, understand KPIs, and translate marketing objectives into strategic partnership solutions.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, negotiation, and consultative selling skills, with the ability to lead senior-level client and agency conversations.
  • Ability to think like a marketer while operating with the urgency, commercial discipline, and accountability of a seller.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance strategic thinking with execution.
  • Proven ability to operate with autonomy in a lean, distributed organization while managing multiple markets, deadlines, and stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally across sales, marketing, creative, production, operations, finance, and legal.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, remote-first, multi-time-zone environment.
  • Based in the UK, ideally London, with the ability to travel regularly to international Evo events and client markets.
  • Fluent business English.
Bonus Points
  • Experience selling within live events, gaming, esports, sports, entertainment, media, creator, or enthusiast-culture businesses.
  • Experience representing or commercializing major events, leagues, properties, or entertainment IP.
  • Experience developing seven-figure, multi-year, multi-market integrated partnerships.
  • Deep relationships across the regional offices of major agency holding companies, independent agencies, and the regional marketing teams of global brands.
  • Experience selling into or operating within EMEA, APAC, LATAM. Working proficiency in French, Japanese, or other languages relevant to RTS’s international markets.
  • Passion for gaming, fighting games, live events, and the communities RTS serves.
Our Culture

We’re very proud of the culture we’ve nurtured within RTS. We enjoy a high retention rate and value the relationships our employees build with one another, even in a fully remote, globally distributed environment.

As a senior member of the commercial organization, we want you to embody and perpetuate the following values:

  • Lead with empathy - Ensure clients and colleagues feel heard, especially when navigating difficult decisions or competing priorities.
  • Challenge everything - Bring critical thinking to ideas in their earliest stages, help shape them into stronger concepts, and encourage creative experimentation in a safe and supportive environment.
Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
  • 401k plan available for employee contributions
  • Flexible work schedule
  • Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
  • Remote-first culture

jobs.title: Laravel/IoT Developer
jobs.excerpt: DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day – and for our alarm signalling customers, that promise depends on hardware and software working together flawlessly.
jobs.description:
DeterTech's purpose is giving greater peace of mind to people and communities, every day – and for our alarm signalling customers, that promise depends on hardware and software working together flawlessly. This role owns IoT and alarm signalling hardware integrations and device connectivity for DT ARC, bridging the gap between hardware and software to support new engineering requests as well as repair and manufacturing workflows.
Given the safety-critical nature of alarm signalling, this role needs a security-conscious approach and the confidence to troubleshoot issues that span both hardware and software.
As a specialist within the ARC development team who brings dedicated IoT experience, you will bridge the gap between physical hardware engineering and our operational monitoring platforms. Working alongside embedded firmware engineers, product managers, and software peers, you will ingest and map device telemetry, sensor feeds, and remote MQTT commands into our central Alarm Receiving Centre (ARC) platform and DTCommand client portal.
You will translate device-level hardware capabilities (such as geolocation) into intuitive, dependable controls and visual states for our 24/7 ARC operators. Furthermore, you will drive the iterative evolution of device features—progressing capabilities from basic on/off toggles and timed schedules through to smart, telemetry-driven automations and workflows.
ABOUT DETERTECH
DeterTech is a security technology company operating across six countries, with principal UK sites in Prestwick and Telford. We predict, deter and detect risk on behalf of the people and communities we serve. Our values – Committed, Inclusive and Ambitious – shape how we work every day: we are accountable and deliver excellence; we collaborate and build trust; and we never stop learning while winning in the right way.

This is a remote role, with the flexibility to work from home. We also value face-to-face collaboration and would ask for some flexibility to attend occasional in-person meetings or team sessions.

Key Responsibilities

1. IoT and hardware integration
• Build and maintain software integrations with IoT and hardware devices, including alarm signalling equipment, sensors and gateways.
• Apply relevant signalling protocols and standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).
• Ingest, decode, and process device telemetry and command topics (via MQTT, WebSockets, and TCP/UDP sockets) published by embedded hardware and firmware engineering teams.
• Map raw device states, diagnostic health metrics, and sensor data into operational database schemas and real-time ARC monitoring views.
• Implement resilient bidirectional messaging pipelines to dispatch remote control commands, configuration updates, and firmware state synchronisations over cellular and IoT networks.
2. Application development & iterative feature engineering
• Build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring using strong Laravel/PHP skills.
• Use MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity where appropriate.
• Implement responsive operator interfaces and control panels within the ARC platform and DTCommand, translating UI/UX wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design specs provided by the Lead Digital Product Designer into functional frontend components and backend APIs
• Drive the phased, iterative evolution of hardware features in close alignment with the Head of Product and Lead Digital Product Designer—progressing device commands from simple manual toggles to rule-based timed intervals, telemetry-driven thresholds, and machine-learning assisted automations.
• Architect and scale background queue consumers to process high-frequency device heartbeats, pings, and alarm events with minimal latency.
• Build and maintain secure RESTful and event-driven APIs connecting device management services with the core ARC platform, DTCommand client portal, and mobile applications.
3. Troubleshooting and support
• Troubleshoot issues across the hardware/software boundary, working with engineering, repair and manufacturing colleagues as needed.
• Partner closely with hardware and embedded firmware engineers to define clear interface contracts, payload schemas, and MQTT topic structures for emerging device revisions and product features.

• Develop diagnostic utilities and device provisioning scripts to empower manufacturing and repair technicians to test, flash, configure, and certify equipment efficiently.
• Investigate complex telemetry anomalies, packet dropouts, and handshake timeouts in collaboration with relevant teams.

• Provide tier-3 technical escalation support for live signalling faults, identifying whether root causes stem from firmware bugs, cellular network carriers, protocol decoding, or backend application logic and work with relevant teams to support and fix.
4. Security, compliance and reliability
• Apply a security-conscious approach to device connectivity, reflecting the critical, safety-related nature of alarm signalling.

• Implement strict security standards across all device communications, including transport encryption (TLS/mTLS), secure token/credential rotation, and mutual authentication.
• Ensure signalling architectures comply with alarm industry standards (such as BS EN 50131 / BS 5979 / PD 6662) and data privacy regulations (GDPR).
• Establish monitoring, synthetic health checks, and alerting on device listener sockets and broker connections to detect dropouts or network degradation proactively.

5. Sprint delivery and platform collaboration
• Participate actively in Agile sprint meeting with the Technical Delivery Manager, delivering predictable milestones on product engineering initiatives.
• Partner with the Lead Full Stack Developer for architectural guidance, code reviews, and API schema design to ensure IoT components integrate cleanly into the wider Laravel ecosystem.
• Collaborate closely with the Lead Digital Product Designer to review user interaction models, technical feasibility of UI components, and stateful feedback loops.
• Liaise with the MuleSoft / Integration team to ensure device information from manufacturing and repair configurations can be synchronised.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential
• Experience integrating software with IoT/hardware devices (for example alarm signalling equipment, sensors, gateways).
• Understanding of relevant signalling protocols/standards used in the alarm/ARC industry (for example SIA, Contact ID, IP signalling).
• Strong Laravel/PHP skills to build the software side of device integrations, APIs and monitoring.
• Comfortable troubleshooting issues across the hardware/software boundary.
• A security-conscious approach to device connectivity, given the critical nature of alarm signalling.
• Background developing web applications, microservices, or daemons in modern PHP/Laravel (including queue workers, and event broadcasting).
• Practical experience working with MQTT, WebSockets, or publish/subscribe messaging architectures for device connectivity and telemetry ingestion.
• Demonstrated ability to translate raw hardware sensor data (telemetry, environmental inputs, battery budgets) into functional software applications and clear visual states.
• Familiarity with appropriate databases and caching/queue technologies for high-volume event processing.

• Collaborative team player, comfortable working across disciplines with embedded firmware engineers, product managers, digital designers, and manufacturing/repair technicians.

Desirable
• Experience with MQTT or similar messaging protocols for device connectivity.
• Experience in the security, alarm or IoT hardware industry.
• Familiarity with frontend technologies commonly used in the Laravel ecosystem (such as Livewire or React).
• Familiarity with cellular IoT connectivity (e.g. roaming M2M SIMs, APNs, bandwidth budgets, and AT commands).
• Practical experience using hardware diagnostic tools to debug issues.
• Familiarity with AWS cloud services (such as EC2, ECS, Lambda, or IoT Core).
• Exposure to manufacturing workflows, hardware provisioning tools.

jobs.description:
Our Journey

The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific’s leading shopping, rewards, and payments platform, serving over 20 million active members across 13 markets. In 2025, the Group continued its global growth with its expansion into North America. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack is dedicated to saving members money and time, and delivering delight every day. The platform also enables merchants and brands to engage with their members in a cost-effective manner. Founded in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales for over 20,000 online and in-store partners, and has rewarded shoppers with more than US$900 million (over S$1 billion) in Cashback to date. Through its innovative offerings, ShopBack continues to create value for both members and merchants. Notably, its payment solution, ShopBack Pay, offers members a convenient and rewarding payment option at checkout.
As a ShopBack intern, you do real work and deliver real impact. You ship code that goes to production and is used by millions of members all over the world. AI agents are part of how we build every day, so you will orchestrate and build with them from day one.

What You'll Own

  • Ship real features. You own a scoped project, from design to production, with a mentor who supports you.
  • Build with AI as a teammate. You use coding agents to move fast, and you learn to review, test, and verify what they produce.
  • Make AI tools for others. You build a skill, a tool, or an agent workflow that your team keeps using after your internship ends.
  • Measure, don't guess. You write evals and tests so you can prove that your AI-powered work is good.

Essentials to Succeed

  • You have good fundamentals. You can write clean code, you are familiar with design patterns, and you understand data structures, APIs, and testing.
  • You have built things outside of class. Side projects, hackathons, open source, and freelance work all count.
  • You have applied AI, not only chatted with it. What have you built? Tell us about an app on an LLM API, a custom agent or MCP server, a boring task you automated end to end, or a simple eval you used to compare prompts or models.
  • You stay curious and sceptical. You ask why the AI gave an answer, and you check it before you trust it.
  • You learn fast. You are excited to learn new things. You are comfortable when you do not know something yet, and you ask good questions.

Show Us What You Built with AI

    Tell us about:

  • The coolest one: the thing you are most proud of, or the thing that made people say "wait, how?"
  • Or the hardest one: the thing that broke many times before it worked.

    • For each one, tell us:

  • The problem: what you wanted to solve, and why it mattered to you.
  • What you built: what you built, compared to what the AI did.
  • What broke: where the AI failed, and how you found and fixed the problem.
  • The result: a link to a repo, a demo, a video, or a write-up. A result that works with rough edges is better than slides that look polished.

    • Start where the problem is real. A personal agent that saves your time 10 minutes every day is better than a big idea that nobody built. Build it, ship it, and let people use it.

Bonus Points

  • Agents: you built an agent that uses tools, keeps memory, or runs many steps without a human.
  • Evals: you wrote evals or tests to measure whether your AI output improved.
  • Real users: you shipped something that people other than you actually use.
  • Cloud: you deployed your project to a cloud platform.
    • We are looking for builders who are curious about AI and make a real impact with it.

Technologies You'll Touch

  • TypeScript / Node.js
  • Postgres
  • Kafka
  • Kubernetes
  • GitLab
  • Datadog
  • Claude Code
  • MCP

ShopBacker Traits

  • Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
  • Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
  • Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
  • Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

What's in it for ShopBackers

  • Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
  • Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale.
  • Competitive compensation based on performance.
  • Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

We're hiring an experienced Controller to own accounting and financial operations at Metabase. It's a broad startup controller role: you'll own core accounting and audit, along with tax, payments, and expense management. Today we run as a small, high-leverage team that delivers much of this through external firms - accountants and tax professionals - so your initial focus will be on managing those partners. Over time, there's scope to bring accounting in-house.

This is a role for someone who's an expert in their domain but comfortable in a fluid, ambiguous environment - and energized by building out our financial operations as well as running them.

Responsibilities

  • General ledger & close — manage and review the month-end close (run today through external accountants); investigate and resolve discrepancies
  • Audit — own the external auditor relationship; coordinate information requests internally; investigate and resolve issues that surface
  • Tax — manage external tax accountants; handle direct execution like new-state registrations and payments
  • Accounts payable & expenses — run the payment cycle; own and troubleshoot the corporate card / expense system
  • Over time — lead implementation of new systems (ERP, rev rec, payments); potentially build an in-house close process

  • Seasoned accountant with an active CPA
  • Expertise with US GAAP, SaaS revenue recognition, stock based compensation, multi-entity / international accounting
  • Owned full-cycle month end close / quarter end close processes and managed audits end-to-end
  • Prior experience in a startup and / or big 4 audit a plus
  • Undergraduate qualification in accounting, finance, or a rigorous quantitative field
  • Strong investigative skills - you spot when something is off and can reconstruct what happened

  • Low ego attitude - you’re ready to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in

jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
We’re looking for regional ambassadors to help grow and strengthen local communities while expanding Espresso's global presence. As an ambassador, you'll introduce Espresso to new audiences and energize our existing local communities.

  • Be the primary ambassador for Espresso in your country
  • Managing local channels, such as local TG and X channels
  • Establish and grow the local Espresso community of builders and supporters
  • Identify local app, distribution, and partnership opportunities
  • Help organize meetups to bolster the local Espresso community
  • Share market intel, community, and product feedback with the Espresso team
  • Ensure adherence of your community to Espresso’s norms, culture, and community guidelines

What our ideal ambassador looks like:

  • Experience in running communities in crypto

  • A driven, solutions-oriented individual
  • Excellent communication skills in both native language and English
  • A real hands-on mentality

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.

We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency

Job Title: Principal, Restoration and Remediation

Location: Remote (USA)

Role: Full time

What Makes You Stand Out

You are a senior technical leader in cybersecurity and incident response, known for restoring order and confidence during high-severity events. You’ve led the full lifecycle of post-incident recovery efforts, from strategic planning and stakeholder advising, to hands-on systems restoration and network reconfiguration.

You bring not only deep technical skills across enterprise IT infrastructure but also the confidence and clarity to lead clients, coach teammates, and evolve internal capabilities. You thrive in high-pressure environments, take initiative, and are passionate about growing the next generation of cyber responders.

How You’llMake An Impact

As a Principal Consultant on the Restoration and Remediation team, you’ll lead Surefire Cyber’s most complex and sensitive post-incident recovery engagements. You’ll advise clients on restoration strategy, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and oversee technical execution across diverse environments.

You’ll also play a key role in maturing SurefireCyber’s internal R&R capabilities; mentoring consultants, improving playbooks and tooling, and shaping how we scale recovery operations.

Your Role In Action

  • Lead end-to-end recovery operations for complex cyber incidents, including ransomware outbreaks, large-scale breaches, and targeted compromises
  • Architect and manage technical remediation plans across hybrid infrastructure (on-prem, cloud, and SaaS), including user recovery, server rebuilds, reconfiguration, and hardening
  • Oversee restoration of identity services (Active Directory, Azure AD), messaging systems (Exchange, M365), VPNs, firewalls, MFA, and enterprise backup solutions
  • Advise client executives (CIOs, CISOs, legal, insurers) on remediation strategy, recovery timelines, and long-term resilience improvements
  • Coordinate recovery workstreams across DFIR, IT, legal, and insurance stakeholders, ensuring alignment and technical integrity
  • Act as technical escalation point during recovery engagements, solving roadblocks with precision and speed
  • Mentor senior and junior consultants on real-time client work and long-term development, including technical coaching, feedback, and project guidance
  • Document and review client-facing technical reports, timelines, and lessons learned to ensure completeness and clarity
  • Contribute to the evolution of SurefireCyber’s recovery methodologies, including internal tooling, knowledge bases, and training paths
  • Lead or support proactive services including tabletop exercises, remediation readiness assessments, and executive advisory engagements
  • Participate in after-hours response rotations during major incident events (on-call availability expected)

Your Expertise 

  • 10+ years of professional experience in cybersecurity, incident response, systems/network administration, or IT infrastructure engineering
  • Proven leadership in guiding enterprise-scale recovery efforts during cyber incidents, ideally in a client-facing or consulting capacity
  • Deep hands-on experience with Active Directory, Azure AD, M365, Exchange, Group Policy, virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix), and backup tools (e.g., Veeam, Zerto, Unitrends)
  • Expert understanding of infrastructure reconfiguration, network segmentation, identity access recovery, and endpoint security post-compromise
  • Ability to architect and execute remediation plans in coordination with DFIR, SOC, and cloud teams
  • Comfortable advising senior business and legal stakeholders during high-pressure engagements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing and presenting executive-level remediation updates
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring and growing technical talent within a team
  • Familiarity with attacker TTPs, threat actor behaviors, and their implications for recovery sequencing and infrastructure redesign
  • Demonstrated expertise in cybersecurity, systems engineering, or incident response, whether gained through professional experience, certifications, or equivalent technical training.
  • Advanced certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCFA, MCSE, OSCP) are strongly preferred.

Expertise in all these areas is not required, but you should be excited by the opportunity to learn new things and comfortable with working with other team members to expand your knowledge base and experience. We at Surefire Cyber invite you to apply even if you do not feel you have mastery in all the requirements listed on the job description and welcome a further discussion.

  • Assist Genetic Counseling and Customer Experience teams in identification and procurement of optimal additional samples, as necessary.
  • Provide professional support for the Clinical Trial team through accurate and organized data transfer.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or higher, with certification by the American Society of Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent board, is required.

  • Ability to accurately understand and convey information found in anatomic pathology reports to team members for a wide variety of solid tumors, including but not limited to lung, colon, and breast cancer.

About the Role
We’re seeking a Lead Application Security Engineer to help advance Zeta Global’s application and platform security posture through AI-native security practices, intelligent automation, and scalable security engineering. You’ll play a critical role in embedding security throughout the software development lifecycle by using AI-driven tools, automated controls, and data-informed risk prioritization to ensure our systems, applications, and AI-powered platforms are built securely from the ground up.

Zeta operates at massive scale, powering billions of consumer profiles and petabytes of data across real-time, AI-powered marketing platforms. In this role, you’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and AI platform teams to identify risks, design secure-by-default patterns, and build automated security capabilities that enable secure innovation at speed.

This position offers significant technical scope, cross-functional visibility, and the opportunity to directly influence the company’s security maturity through AI-enabled threat modeling, automated validation, intelligent vulnerability management, and proactive defense.

Key Responsibilities

AI-Driven Threat Modeling & Security Validation

  • Use AI-assisted threat modeling capabilities to identify application, platform, API, cloud, data, and AI/ML security risks early in the design and development process.
  • Leverage automated security review tools to evaluate architecture, design documents, code changes, APIs, and data flows for security gaps and control weaknesses.
  • Drive AI-assisted code security reviews using SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, IaC scanning, container scanning, and contextual risk analysis.
  • Use automation and intelligent correlation to assess third-party libraries, APIs, vendor integrations, and open-source dependencies for security, compliance, and supply-chain risk.
  • Support AI-enabled red team, blue team, and incident response simulations to validate detection, prevention, and response capabilities.

Embedding AI-Native Security into the SDLC

  • Partner with developers and QA engineers to embed AI-driven security testing and automated risk detection into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Build and improve security automation that provides real-time feedback to developers during design, coding, testing, release, and deployment.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis to review architecture and design artifacts, identify risks earlier, and recommend secure implementation patterns.
  • Contribute to intelligent security checkpoints that reduce manual review effort while improving consistency, traceability, and developer velocity.
  • Help design scalable guardrails, reusable security controls, and policy-as-code capabilities across application and platform teams.

Emerging Threat Monitoring & Proactive Defense

  • Monitor evolving application, cloud, API, AI/ML, and data security risks using AI-assisted threat intelligence, vulnerability intelligence, and attack-pattern analysis.
  • Identify and evaluate AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, model abuse, model leakage, insecure tool use, and sensitive data exposure.
  • Assist in designing and deploying proactive defense mechanisms across applications, APIs, data platforms, and AI-powered systems.
  • Use automated signals, telemetry, and risk scoring to support investigations, post-incident analysis, and continuous improvement of prevention and detection capabilities.
  • Translate recurring vulnerabilities and incidents into feedback loops that improve threat models, secure design patterns, and SDLC controls.

Security Awareness, Standards & Scalable Enablement

  • Promote secure coding and secure design practices through AI-assisted guidance, reusable playbooks, automated recommendations, and developer-friendly documentation.
  • Contribute to internal security standards, secure engineering patterns, and AI-native security playbooks.
  • Help teams adopt security self-service capabilities that reduce dependency on manual AppSec review.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, DevOps, QA, Product, and AI platform teams to foster a security-first and automation-first culture.
  • Use metrics and insights to measure control effectiveness, remediation trends, developer adoption, and overall security maturity.

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Application Security, DevSecOps, Secure Software Development, or Security Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, SANS CWE Top 25, secure design principles, and application threat modeling.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security concepts such as prompt injection, data poisoning, adversarial testing, model integrity, model abuse, and AI supply-chain risks.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-assisted security workflows, security bots, automated triage systems, or risk scoring models.
  • Experience using AI-assisted or automation-driven approaches to improve security testing, vulnerability analysis, code review, or risk prioritization.
  • Experience with modern application frameworks and architectures such as React, Node.js, Django, FastAPI, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of securing APIs, microservices, authentication, and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, and service-to-service authentication.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and containerized environments such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Working knowledge of security testing and automation tools such as Semgrep, SonarQube, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Trivy, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, or similar tools.
  • Ability to analyze security findings, correlate risk context, and drive practical remediation guidance for engineering teams.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Product, QA, DevOps, and Security teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code security, CI/CD security controls, and automated governance.

  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, CSSLP, cloud security certifications, or AI/ML-specific security certifications.

Job Summary

The Bugcrowd RL and Reasoning Team focuses on pushing the boundaries of autonomous cybersecurity by building authentic reinforcement learning environments for foundational model companies. As a Reinforcement Learning Engineer you will advance the frontier of AI Reinforcement Learning development and delivery. You will build the infrastructure and tooling that transforms real-world vulnerability research into large-scale reinforcement learning environments used to train next-generation AI systems.

This role is unique. You will help create the training environments that teach AI systems how to hack and defend software. Your work will directly influence the capabilities of the next generation of AI models. Instead of building a single application, you will build the infrastructure that generates thousands of environments used to train frontier AI systems.

Our team works at the intersection of AI, security research, and systems engineering, building environments that allow models to learn skills such as vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and remediation.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

If you enjoy building high-performance systems that power cutting-edge AI research, this role is for you.

This role focuses on building the systems that generate RL environments, not just the environments themselves. You will design pipelines that ingest software projects, analyze them with Bugcrowd’s Mayhem platform, and automatically construct training environments used by frontier AI labs including Anthropic, OpenAI, and Cohere.

The ideal candidate is a strong systems engineer who understands:

  • Reinforcement learning workflows
  • Building clean, reproducible Linux ML environments (containers, MCP, etc)
  • System security background in binary exploitation, such as buffer overflows, fuzzing, exploitation, and x86/64.
  • Experience developing applications in Python and C, with Rust a plus.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Understanding of RL training workflows used by modern LLM systems

  • Experience with DevOps pipelines (e.g., github actions), reproducible builds (docker, buildkit, nix).
  • Proficiency in Python and C. Other languages (especially Rust) are a plus.
  • Understanding of software vulnerabilities, fuzzing, or program analysis
  • Experience with build systems and large open-source codebases
  • Comfort working with Linux systems and low-level debugging

Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Opportunity

Twin’s Contact Center is the front door for our members and our Member Services Lead ensures our team delivers an exceptional experience on every interaction. You will lead a team of Member Service Representatives who support members wherever they are in their journey, from a first eligibility question through enrollment, device setup, and everything in between, with the goal of resolving each need in a single interaction.

  • Serve as the first escalation point for members and Representatives, resolving issues quickly and routing anything that needs clinical, product, or client partnership to the right owner.

  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA and all regulatory and documentation standards across the team.

Mylan Inc.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

This posting supports ongoing hiring needs and may be used to consider candidates for upcoming opportunities.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the R&D and Regulatory Systems Lead will make an impact:

R&D and Regulatory Systems Lead position works with Regulatory Affairs and other R&D functions to understand technology needs, ensure global processes and systems are compliant and representative of cross functional needs. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong Veeva RIM architecture and development experience including hands on experience of Registrations & Submissions Vault configurations, integrations and data migrations. Business process knowledge is required for requirements elicitation as well as good communication and project management experience to lead technical implementations and take on system ownership.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Provide strong working knowledge of the digital capabilities used to support global R&D business processes
  • Monitor emerging global health authority requirements to assess system impact including developing and implementing requirements to ensure compliance
  • Collaborate with key business users to identify business needs and translate to requirements. Translate user requirements into technical requirements and implement solutions to meet requirements according to industry best practices
  • Provide analysis techniques including functional requirements gathering, process modeling, interviewing, user stories, prototyping, data flows, and root cause analysis
  • Provide Veeva RIM Vault administration and development expertise including all facets of package software, application implementation and integrate systems using Vault API calls
  • Lead administration, enhancements, fixes, configurations of RIM Vaults and migrate new code fixes in a regular deployment schedule
  • Leads technical design for assigned projects and enhance integrations between systems
  • Designs, architects, and leads development of complex applications
  • Successfully manage assigned projects to implementation ensuring projects successfully deliver in scope, on schedule and within budget.
  • Work with teams globally for end-to-end implementation of various R&D solutions and ensure compliance with regulations by FDA, EMA and other health agencies.
  • Drive compliance with IT Quality processes and Viatris SDLC processes, including IT change management and quality/testing procedures.
  • Collaborate with solutions lead and business partners to ensure technologies are meeting business requirements
  • Support vendor relationships for assigned R&D systems, ensuring that system issues are promptly escalated

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

  • Bachelor's degree in science, IT, or a relatable field. Advanced degrees are a plus.
  • Veeva RIM Vault certification preferred.
  • 10 years’ of Regulatory business process knowledge and strong hands-on technical experiences configuring, migrating and integrating Veeva RIM Vaults and other R&D solutions required.
  • 10 years’ hands on experience with software design and development, system integrations, analytics report builds required.
  • Prior experience in the pharmaceutical industry and a solid understanding of R&D & Regulatory business processes.
  • Experience with validated GxP environments, including Implementation, documentation, and change management is necessary.
  • Hands on experience implementing, configuring, migrating and integrating Veeva Vault RIM platform including Registrations, Submissions & Archive Vaults (Required). Veeva certification desired.
  • Broad technical knowledge, including hands on experience designing and implementing system integrations as well as working with migrations and SaaS in a regulated environment.
  • Hands on experience designing and building solutions with Java, python, creating AI agents and working with analytics tools including building Power BI reports
  • Proven track record of defining technology strategy aligned with business objectives
  • Previous experience as IT system owner supporting R&D
  • Experience in business processes for regulatory submission planning and tracking, registration management, commitment management and content management
  • Knowledge of GCP, EMA + FDA regulations and other regulatory compliance standards
  • Experience with project management methodologies such as Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid approaches
  • Strong analysis and project management skills as well as attention to detail
  • Ability to challenge requirements with key stakeholders to ensure requirements are detailed and properly defined
  • Ability to solve highly complex enterprise-wide technical challenges
  • Ability to operate in a dynamic challenging environment and manage multiple activities, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Works well in and appreciates the value of a global diverse work environment.
  • Is able to see the larger picture and able to identify and successfully communicate key issues in complex situations.
  • This role has remote flexibility and will work with Global business in IT teams in US EST, EU and IST time zones.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The salary range for this position is $95,000.00 - $193,000.00 USD.
