jobs.title: Audio Annotation Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll do

As an Audio Annotation Analyst on the Research team, you will review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data to support the development, evaluation, and improvement of Pindrop's fraud detection, authentication, and deepfake detection technologies. Your assignments will span audio and video annotation projects based on evolving Research priorities and team needs.

Your primary responsibility will be to produce accurate, consistent, and high-quality annotations across a variety of Research projects. You will also support targeted investigations by reviewing interactions, identifying anomalies, and documenting observations that help Research Scientists better understand model performance and real-world customer interactions.

You will…

  • Review and annotate audio recordings, video content, and associated interaction data, assigning accurate labels based on project-specific guidelines and classification criteria.
  • Apply established classification criteria to identify potential fraud indicators, authentication outcomes, characteristics of human-generated versus synthetic content, and other attributes relevant to Research projects, including intent recognition when applicable.
  • Apply annotation guidelines consistently across large datasets, review existing labels for discrepancies, and help maintain high-quality datasets for model development and evaluation.
  • Flag interactions that are difficult to classify or fall outside established guidelines, document observations, and collaborate with Research Scientists to resolve edge cases.
  • Support Research investigations by reviewing audio and video interactions to identify potential issues such as background noise, audio quality degradation, IVR process gaps, or unexpected model behavior.
  • Conduct targeted interaction and metadata reviews to support customer inquiries, model evaluations, and evolving Research priorities.
  • Maintain accurate annotation records and summarize findings, recurring patterns, and classification inconsistencies to support Research analysis and model improvements.
  • Handle sensitive audio, video, and interaction data responsibly, following established privacy, security, and confidentiality guidelines.

Who you are

You are…

  • Exceptionally attentive to detail, with strong listening and observational skills to identify subtle differences in audio, video, and interactions.
  • Comfortable with focused, repetitive review work and able to maintain accuracy and consistency across large volumes of data.
  • Able to follow detailed guidelines while exercising sound judgment when encountering ambiguous or unfamiliar situations.
  • Organized, self-driven, and able to document classification decisions and observations clearly while managing assigned workloads.
  • Curious about new technologies, forms of fraud, and synthetic or manipulated media.
  • Adaptable and comfortable transitioning between audio and video annotation projects, learning new tools, and applying different classification standards as Research priorities evolve.

Your skill-set

Must have…

  • Excellent listening and observational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to apply defined annotation and classification guidelines accurately to audio and video content.
  • Ability to perform high-volume, repetitive annotation and review tasks while maintaining quality and consistency.
  • Ability to recognize inconsistencies and ambiguous cases, document findings clearly, and escalate questions appropriately.
  • Familiarity with spreadsheets (Excel, Google Sheets) or comparable tools for organizing, categorizing, and reviewing data.
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet timelines in a remote environment.

Nice to have…

  • Experience with data annotation, audio or video labeling, transcription, quality assurance, or qualitative data review.
  • Familiarity with fraud detection, authentication, voice biometrics, trust and safety, or contact center and IVR workflows.
  • Understanding of synthetic speech, replay attacks, deepfakes, or machine learning labeling tasks such as intent recognition or speech analysis.
  • Experience with annotation platforms, structured review tools, or basic data-querying concepts such as SQL

What’s in it for you

At Pindrop, Research sits at the intersection of AI, voice, fraud, identity, and customer experience. This is an opportunity to work with real-world interaction data and contribute directly to the development and evaluation of technologies that protect enterprises and their customers from increasingly sophisticated fraud and identity threats.

Your annotations and analytical findings will help Research teams build more reliable datasets, evaluate model performance, identify emerging attack patterns, and continuously improve Pindrop's technologies.

You'll have the opportunity to…

  • Develop firsthand knowledge of voice intelligence, fraud prevention, authentication, and deepfake detection.
  • Support high-quality datasets that improve machine learning models and research methods.
  • Review audio, video, and interaction data across different customer environments, use cases, and projects.
  • Partner with Research Scientists and other stakeholders to connect annotation findings to model reliability, product decisions, and better customer experiences.
  • Develop critical thinking, data analysis, written communication, and problem-solving skills while gaining exposure to emerging technologies.

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$60,000—$80,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.description:
About HumanSignal

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

About the OpportunityWe're looking for graphic design professionals to rate the quality of design work, helping AI models learn what makes a design effective.

Key Details

  • Type: Freelance, project-based opportunity
  • Project length: 6 weeks, with new projects launching regularly
  • Compensation: Paid per accepted task. On this project, you can earn the equivalent of up to $12 per hour, with pay rates varying by country of residence.

What You'll Do

  • Rate design samples for typography, visual hierarchy, design execution, color, layout, and overall polish
  • Follow detailed rubrics to keep your ratings consistent across high volumes of design samples
  • Identify flaws in one slide within the overall design, from minor issues like font size to major ones that require a full reconstruction of the slide
  • Edit the flawed slide using the other slides in the design as a reference, to build more cohesion across the entire design
  • Flag edge cases and unclear examples

Please note: you won’t create your own designs. You’ll rate and edit the samples we provide, following our guidelines.

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

  • Education in design or arts (degree or certificate)
  • 2+ years of experience as a graphic designer, SMM specialist, or marketing professional
  • Strong grasp of composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy, and overall design effectiveness
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to maintain focus during repetitive tasks
  • Openness to feedback and recalibration

Nice to have

  • Design review, art direction or QA experience, with the ability to critique design objectively against industry standards
  • Experience with Figma, Sketch, or other modern design tools
  • Prior data annotation or AI training experience

How It Works

  1. Apply
  2. Register on our platform
  3. Confirm your identity
  4. Validate your skills
  5. Start earning on projects

Why Join Us

  • Work from anywhere: fully remote, with just a laptop and a stable internet connection.
  • Set your own schedule: work whenever suits you, alongside your current job, studies, or other commitments.
  • Get paid every week: weekly payouts for the work you deliver.
  • Shape the future of AI: your expertise helps train the AI tools people use every day.
  • More projects ahead: once you're validated, get access to new projects that match your skills.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Databases Tempo | US | Remote
jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

We build Tempo, the open-source distributed tracing backend behind Grafana Cloud Traces and Grafana Enterprise Traces (GET). Tempo makes it easy to search traces, generate metrics from spans, and connect tracing data with logs, metrics, and profiles across the Grafana stack.

2026 is an inflection point for Tempo. After a major architectural upgrade and the launch of TraceQL metrics, we are shifting from foundational work to product and operational excellence, and evolving Tempo from a SaaS database into a platform that powers Grafana’s next generation of observability products (App Observability, Asserts, Traces Drilldown, and AI-driven assistants).

Over the next year, you will help us:

  • Make Grafana Cloud Traces “just work” for customers by eliminating rough edges, confusing limits, and hidden failure modes.
  • Achieve operational excellence at scale as we grow from close to 50 cells today into triple digits this year, with autoscaling, parameterized rollouts, and aggressive toil reduction.
  • Evolve Tempo into a platform enabler: higher-density APIs, trace aggregation, TraceQL metrics math, and machine/LLM-friendly interfaces that downstream products and agents can build on.
  • Push performance further: faster query latency at hundreds of MB/s ingestion and performant 30-day query ranges to match competitors.
  • Prepare Tempo for an agent-driven world: larger, burstier, higher-cardinality workloads, and new categories of AI-powered workflows, such as assistant-driven triage and “why is this slow?”- style investigations.

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Engineer on Tempo, you will own technical direction on the hardest problems in our roadmap and raise the bar across the team.

  • Deliver significant technical projects. Take well-scoped, multi-month initiatives from problem framing through rollout, e.g., trace aggregation APIs, Limitless Tempo, autoscaling cells and customer limits, or query engine improvements. Partner with Staff engineers and the tech lead on broader, cross-team direction.
  • Own major components of Tempo. Contribute to and own parts of ingestion, storage, query, and metrics generation. Write and present design docs, participate in design reviews, make sound trade-offs on performance, cost, and complexity, and document the “why” for the team.
  • Build APIs for humans and agents. Help shape the next generation of Tempo’s interfaces (structured, deterministic, discoverable) so that Act 3 products, LLM-driven assistants, and external integrators can build on Tempo reliably.
  • Contribute to operational excellence. Own outcomes for the areas you build against concrete SLOs (P99 write latency, incident recurrence, TCO per ingested GB), and help move the team toward Zero Ops through automation, parameterized rollouts, and actionable alerts.
  • Collaborate with Product and sibling teams. Work with PMs and with App Observability, Asserts, Drilldown, and Grafana Assistant teams to understand how Tempo gets consumed and to ship what unblocks them.
  • Mentor and support engineers. Raise the bar through thorough code review, constructive design feedback, and pairing, especially with junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Participate in on-call for the services you help build, and contribute to incident response and post-incident learning.
  • Contribute to open source. Tempo is OSS. You will engage the community, review external contributions, and contribute to the project in the open.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Example problems you could work on

These are the kinds of projects landing in 2026:

  • Trace aggregation and higher-density APIs: extend TraceQL metrics, design LLM-friendly response types, and make Tempo a first-class data source for Grafana’s AI assistant.
  • Autoscaling end-to-end: customer limits and Tempo cells, with hysteresis, predictive scaling for spikes, and safe scale-down.
  • Agent-scale ingestion and query: guardrails for bursty, high-cardinality, agent-generated workloads.
  • Query performance: new data formats, smarter query pipelines, targeted optimizations for common Drilldown and Traces workflows, and 30-day query ranges.
  • Rollouts and multi-cell operations: parameterized rollouts, push-button deploys, and the tooling to grow safely into triple-digit cell counts without a proportional increase in alert noise.
  • Limits and self-service: drive customer-facing configuration and observability so escalations trend toward zero.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Technical ownership. A track record of delivering complex, multi-month projects that spanned design, delivery, and operations, and of helping the teammates around you grow.
  • Solid systems experience. Significant hands-on experience building and operating distributed data systems in production: ingestion pipelines, storage engines, query execution, or similar.
  • Strong software craftsmanship. You write clean, robust, performant software that others can maintain, and you know when to optimize vs. when to ship.
  • Strong Go, or a path to it. We write Tempo in Go. Solid experience in other systems languages (Rust, C, C++) translates well.
  • Operational mindset. You’ve owned production services, carried a pager, reduced toil, and treated SLOs as a product feature, not a chore.
  • Customer focus and pragmatism. You break complex problems into short feedback loops: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate.
  • Collaboration and clear writing. You contribute through design docs, reviews, and shipped code, and you communicate clearly in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with tracing, OpenTelemetry, or large-scale observability systems.
  • Experience designing query languages, SQL/TraceQL-like engines, or APIs intended to be consumed programmatically (by services or agents).
  • Experience with columnar storage formats (e.g., Parquet) or purpose-built on-disk formats for analytical workloads.
  • Experience operating multi-tenant, multi-cell SaaS infrastructure at scale on Kubernetes.
  • Experience building for AI/LLM consumers: structured APIs, metadata/discovery endpoints, deterministic outputs, evaluation harnesses.
  • Open-source contribution or maintainership, and comfort engaging a community in the open.
  • Experience as an on-call user of Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Tempo in a previous role (or on a homelab).
  • Experience in a fully remote, globally distributed team.

How we work

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our senior engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

In US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is USD $154,445 - $185.334. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.description:
Job Title - Specialist, Performance Marketing

This position is also known as: Paid Search Manager, Paid Search Specialist; SEM Specialist; Performance Marketing Specialist; Digital Marketing Specialist

Position Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Specialist, Performance Marketing to support paid search campaigns driving adoption of educational products and new student enrollment. This role will be responsible for the day-to-day execution, monitoring, optimization support, and reporting of paid search campaigns across multiple markets.

Reporting to the Principal, Performance Marketing, this position will work closely with internal stakeholders and agency partners to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently, performance goals are achieved, and optimization opportunities are identified. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in paid search, a passion for data-driven marketing, and a desire to continue developing expertise across performance marketing disciplines.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Execution & Management

  • Support the execution and ongoing management of paid search campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and SA360.
  • Implement campaign updates, ad copy changes, audience targeting adjustments, budget modifications, and other optimization recommendations.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and identify performance trends, issues, or opportunities.
  • Conduct keyword research, search query analysis, and competitive monitoring.
  • Support campaign launches, promotions, enrollment season initiatives, and market-specific programs.
  • Ensure campaign settings, budgets, and targeting configurations are accurately maintained.

Optimization & Testing

  • Assist in the execution of testing initiatives across ad copy, bidding strategies, audiences, landing pages, and campaign structures.
  • Proactively analyze campaign data and provide recommendations to improve enrollment volume, conversion rates, and efficiency.
  • Support ongoing optimization efforts to improve Cost per Enrollment (CPE) and overall return on investment.
  • Stay informed on search platform updates, new features, AI-driven capabilities, and industry best practices.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare recurring campaign reports and performance summaries.
  • Analyze campaign performance and communicate key insights to team members and stakeholders.
  • Monitor pacing and budget delivery to ensure media investments remain aligned with enrollment goals.
  • Validate campaign tracking and reporting accuracy.
  • Assist with forecasting, trend analysis, and performance investigations.

Agency & Cross-Functional Support

  • Collaborate with agency partners to ensure timely implementation of campaign updates and optimizations.
  • Participate in campaign reviews and performance discussions.
  • Partner with Analytics, Enrollment, Marketing, and Digital teams to support business objectives.
  • Coordinate campaign assets, creative approvals, and implementation requirements across stakeholders.

Operational Excellence

  • Perform quality assurance checks to ensure campaigns, tracking, and reporting are functioning correctly.
  • Maintain organized campaign documentation, testing logs, and performance records.
  • Support process improvement initiatives that increase efficiency and campaign effectiveness.
  • Assist in identifying automation opportunities that improve workflows and reporting.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-6 years of hands-on experience managing Paid Search (SEM) campaigns.
  • In-depth experience with Google Ads and Google Analytics.
  • Familiarity with bid management platforms such as SA360 is preferred.
  • Experience analyzing campaign performance data and making optimization recommendations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Proficiency with Excel and performance reporting tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Ads.
  • Exposure to Paid Social, Display, Programmatic, or other digital media channels.
  • Experience in lead generation, education, healthcare, financial services, or other performance-driven industries.
  • Familiarity with tagging, tracking, and attribution concepts.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to improve marketing workflows and campaign performance.

Key Competencies

  • Paid Search Fundamentals
  • Campaign Management
  • Performance Analysis
  • Data Interpretation
  • Quality Assurance
  • Problem Solving
  • Attention to Detail
  • Time Management
  • Communication
  • Collaboration
  • Continuous Learning
  • Digital Marketing

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. jobs.excerpt: Job OverviewIQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle.
jobs.description:
Job Overview

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle.ThePatient Centered Solutions (PCS) team leads the industry ingenerating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions.We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to design scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative (e.g. interviews, focus groups), quantitative (e.g. clinical outcome assessments (COAs)/patient-reported outcomes (PROS), preference research) and passive (e.g. digital health technology tools) approaches to understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment.

To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time the IQVIA PCS team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have bothconsulting skills and life science skills that can be applied to PCS research activities. Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity toaddress challenging client issues, across multiple geographies with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering solutions. We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth.

Role & Responsibilities

The role-holder will need to be a committed individual, who combineshigh emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment and be comfortable managing conflicting priorities. The environment is dynamic and ever-changing, moving at the pace of our clients’ needs and the candidate will be expected to understand the sense of urgency that is synonymous with the business.

As a Consultant, ClinRO Services within the PCS team at IQVIA, you will directlyadminister assessments to participants in a clinical trial, or evaluate the quality of assessments performed by others and provide feedback regarding interview technique and scoring.Responsibilities include:

  • Review of scalesadministered by raters in a clinical trial to ensure that assessments are being conducted in a standardized manner to ensure data reliability.
  • Evaluation the quality of assessments, conducting live interactions with raters to discuss assessment methodology, scoring technique, and to provide guidance, as necessary.
  • Evaluate case dataand appropriately prepare for discussions with raters (e.g., prepared to discuss relevant issues and scale items, and have necessary documents available).
  • Complete rater interactions and assigned tasks as scheduled.
  • Responsible for timely submission of all documentation associated with assigned tasks.
  • Participate in all orientation, training and calibration activities as required.
  • Functional assessments of rater performance (e.g., mock interview) and assistance in preparing and disseminating communications.
  • Contacting clinical trial participants remotely (e.g., via proprietary app, Engage) to administer assessments, and will appropriately document resultant information (e.g., notes, scores)

What do you need to apply?

  • Minimum of aMaster’s degree(MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric, Nursing or Social Work, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience working with schizophrenia and major depressive disorder populations.
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience working administering psychiatric assessments including the PANSS, to these populations is also required.
  • Clinical Trials experience preferred (central nervous system (CNS) trials experience would be a plus).
  • Advanced level ofEnglish.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interact with all levels of personnel and clientele in a professional manner.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, time management and problem solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications [solid excel/power point knowledge].

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

jobs.excerpt: About VeryVery is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.
jobs.description:
About Very

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind, working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

About this role

The Engagement Lead is a distinct career track at Very — separate from engineering and program management — built around a single accountability: the outcome of the client engagement.

PMs run the machine. Engagement Leads own the outcome.

This is a client-facing, commercially-minded role. You will personally own 1–3 active client relationships at a time, ensuring that Very is delivering real business value, that engagements are healthy and profitable, and that clients are growing with us. You will operate at high billability (60–80%), meaning you are not overhead — you are contributing directly to the work while simultaneously holding the altitude of the overall engagement.

You will sit at the intersection of client trust, technical delivery, and business development. The best Engagement Leads are builders who have learned to sell, or sellers who have learned to build — people who are as comfortable writing a Statement of Work as they are reviewing a sprint report.

What you’ll own

Client Relationship & Outcomes

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for 1–3 client engagements simultaneously
  • Maintain client trust at the working level — know your stakeholders, understand their business, and be the person they call when something feels off
  • Drive alignment between client expectations and what Very can actually deliver
  • Escalate early and with a recommendation — never let a problem become a surprise
  • We're remote-first, but travel within the US is part of the job — show up in person when it strengthens client relationships & deliverables

Commercial Ownership

  • Own the profitability of your engagements — understand margin, monitor burn, and proactively flag risk
  • Write and negotiate Statements of Work for new phases and follow-on engagements
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and close them
  • Participate in the sales process for new opportunities — Very's best Engagement Leads are part of the commercial motion

Delivery Health

  • Accountable for the health of delivery on your engagements — scope, schedule, and quality
  • Make tradeoff calls with confidence; bring options, not just problems
  • On smaller engagements (≤ $250–400K, single workstream, small team): run the cadence yourself — standups, sprint planning, milestone reviews
  • On larger engagements: partner with a PM who runs execution; you shift altitude to steering, scope management, and client strategy

Team & Culture

  • Coach team members on what it means to work in a client services organization — communication, expectation management, escalation
  • Model the standard for how Very engages with clients

What success looks like

In the first 90 days:

  • Named as engagement owner on at least one active client; client and internal team know you own it
  • Strong working relationships established with key client stakeholders
  • Reporting consistently in Program Tactical; no surprises to leadership

In year one:

  • 80%+ of clients renew or expand under your ownership
  • At least one new SOW written and closed without direct leadership involvement
  • Engagements you own are consistently at or below budget with healthy margins
  • Your clients would call you first — not Very leadership — when they have a concern or an idea

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (or equivalent hands-on experience) and time spent working as a practicing engineer earlier in your career
  • Technical fluency sufficient to earn the respect of engineering teams and translate client needs into actionable scope
  • 5+ years of experience in client services, technical program management, or a delivery-facing role at a technology consulting or product company
  • Demonstrated experience owning client relationships — not just supporting them
  • Ability to write and negotiate Statements of Work independently
  • Experience managing project budgets and financial indicators
  • Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and in the room; able to present to executives and lead difficult conversations
  • Experience with IoT, connected hardware, or complex technical product development strongly preferred

Strongly Preferred

  • Background in electronics hardware, firmware, or embedded systems product development
  • History of working directly with contract manufacturers
  • Experience in a pre-sales or solutions engineering capacity
  • 3+ years in a consultancy or client services environment

Skills We Look For in Every Lead-Level Role

  • Communicates Effectively: Expert-level communication across audiences. Can negotiate for positive outcomes on projects of any complexity. Leans into hard conversations.
  • Owns the Room: Independently resets tone when engagements drift. Decisive, direct, and respectful when recommending a different path.
  • Builds Others Up: Teaches best practices; grows the capabilities of the team around them.
  • Estimates Well: Produces accurate scoping and SOW estimates. Uses experience to pressure-test team estimates.
  • Runs Agile Cleanly: Knows how to break work into tickets, sprints, and epics. Holds teams to rhythm without being bureaucratic.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Compensation: $145,000 – $175,000 commensurate with experience.

Variable Compensation: Up to 20% performance bonus in year one

Perks & Benefits:

  • 401(k) match
  • $200-$250/month cell phone + internet stipend (monthly amount based on level)
  • $600/year home office stipend
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave (95th percentile in the U.S.)
  • Professional development stipend
  • Loaned MacBook Pro
  • Annual team retreat
Why Work for Very

We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work.

We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well.

If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very.

Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously.

**Note: To qualify for this role, you must reside within the region posted.
**Note: This role requires the ability to travel within the US as needed for client engagements.

**We do not provide visa sponsorship.**

Capture and manage customer requirements through the Consulting System Engineering Team to Product Management.

jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a Security Engineering Lead on our team, you'll be leading the security and auditing efforts for Espresso's codebase leading up to, and beyond, launch. We are looking for an experienced security engineering and software auditing professional who can lead review processes of our design and codebase. Experience in the domains of EVM smart contracts and/or Rust distributed systems is preferred for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Lead security audits of (a subset of) the Espresso codebase
  • As a project leader, you will have mobility in how you choose to organize security and audit efforts
  • Dive into the code of a fairly complex distributed system, learning and developing an understanding of the system on the fly (with help from the engineering team that built it, of course)
  • Coordinate with several engineering teams to aid in your audit, raise concerns and communicate results, and guide the effort to harden the system based on your findings
  • Coordinate with, manage, and review the work of external security auditing teams, in certain cases
  • Suggest improvements to testing and engineering practices to promote more secure and maintainable code

Requirements

  • Solid grasp of software engineering principles, both low-level (e.g. language-specific best practices) and high-level (e.g. reliable software architecture, particularly in distributed systems)
  • If focused on Rust: ≥ 1 year experience writing Rust, particularly with async Rust.
  • If focused on Solidity: Multiple years experience writing smart contracts; experience with smart contract security audits or formal verification of smart contracts
  • Experience as an engineer or software architect in a security-critical industry
  • Be capable of describing the stakes, the challenges you've faced in building secure software, and the steps/processes you've taken to mitigate risk
  • Experience as an auditor, pentester, QA tester, etc.
  • Have a well thought-out approach to testing software and designing it to be testable/auditable
  • Ability to think adversarially, and identify potential reliability or security vulnerabilities even in software that is correct in common or “happy path” scenarios
  • Experience on the design and/or testing of distributed systems
  • Comfort diving into unknowns and asking questions

Preferred

  • Knowledge of relevant testing and static analysis tools (e.g. Foundry, Slither) is a plus
  • Blockchain knowledge/experience is preferred, but could also be include IoT, automotive, finance, etc.
  • Ideally, the candidate should have a general philosophy of software design that has been molded by experience working on security-critical systems

Benefits

  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package
  • Regular team off-sites to international locations
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees

With the evolving landscape of digital threats and an increasing volume of sophisticated attacks by malicious actors, we have a security policy mandating all new hires complete an in-person onboarding process - no exceptions. Security is our foundation and we prioritize physical identity verification and secure IT setup. While our security and IT logistics require physical presence to protect our infrastructure from sophisticated global threats, this move is equally about our Village culture. As a Member of People Experience, you're the anchor behind every employee's journey at Anchorage Digital, from the moment they accept their offer to their next chapter after Anchorage. Your work is often someone's first and lasting impression of what it's like to work here.
You'll run onboarding, offboarding, and internal mobility day to day, resolve employee casework and route what belongs elsewhere, and manage immigration case logistics.
You'll also partner closely with our Infrastructure, Analytics, & AI team, bringing operational context to help identify and test automation that removes manual work from People Experience workflows, so the team can spend more time on the people in front of them.

Technical Skills:

  • Spot patterns across casework and feedback that point to friction in the employee experience, and know when to escalate them.

  • Adapt communication style to the audience, whether that's an employee, a People Business Partner, or a technical partner.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Description

We're looking for a hands-on Commodity Buyer to own US purchasing for two of Hal Leonard's core direct-material categories: Sheet Music and Musical Instruments. This is a newly structured seat under our Global Purchasing function — the first of a new model where each buyer owns a defined set of commodities end-to-end, rather than a single narrow category.

We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and expect candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency and delivering a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own US Sheet Music and Musical Instruments direct-material purchasing end-to-end — supplier landscape, sourcing, POs, order confirmations, master data and price files for both categories.
  • Document and stabilise the inherited MI category first — rebuild supplier contacts, open POs, terms and product knowledge into a clean, shared record (not one person's head).
  • Bring Sheet Music buying (paper, print, binding) into the same structure — one owned category with documented suppliers and terms.
  • Protect US direct-material supply into the holiday peak — no availability gaps on either category attributable to the handover.
  • Work AI-first — operate the tiered approval model, feed the spend cube, use automated PO/confirmation workflows rather than manual handling.
  • Negotiate and consolidate — standard terms, framework agreements and a tidier supplier base; support the Global Purchasing Manager's savings target on these commodities.
  • Feed the ERP transition (NetSuite track) so US direct-material procurement requirements are captured, not bolted on later.
  • Report performance into the Global Purchasing Manager / operations leadership.

Requirements

  • 4–7+ years in direct-material purchasing / buying / commodity management, ideally across more than one commodity — this role runs two (Sheet Music and Musical Instruments).
  • Hands-on ownership of the full buy cycle: sourcing, PO management, order confirmation, supplier communication, master-data hygiene.
  • AI-comfort as a must, not a footnote — sees AI-assisted approval and automated PO workflows as leverage; can judge what to automate vs. keep human.
  • Strong supplier-negotiation instinct; a track record of documented savings or supplier consolidation.
  • Discipline with data — clean records, accurate price files, no "it's all in my head" working.

Nice to have:

  • Direct-material category experience in paper / print, publishing, or musical instruments.
  • Prior purchasing inside an ERP migration (NetSuite a plus).
  • Bachelor's in Business, Supply Chain or related; CPSM / CPM.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement IAM solutions using Okta, including SSO, MFA, and lifecycle management.

  • Monitor and respond to IAM-related incidents and vulnerabilities.
  • Define and enforce access policies and role-based access controls (RBAC) within Okta as well as maintain our existing IdP instances.
  • Contribute to the development of IAM roadmaps and strategic initiatives.

Qualifications:

  • 3–5 years of experience in IAM engineering or related security roles.

  • Strong background experience with SAML and OIDC federation protocols and working with various federated Identity Providers such as Okta.

  • Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., PowerShell, Python).
  • Knowledge of regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, ISO27001, SOC2).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.

jobs.title: Deputy Chief Executive Officer (Deputy CEO)
jobs.excerpt: ROLE PURPOSEThe Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.
jobs.description:
ROLE PURPOSE

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer serves as the principal execution leader of the company and acts as the Chief Executive Officer's primary partner in the management and delivery of the Company's strategic, operational, commercial, and financial objectives.

The role is responsible for overseeing the Company's core revenue-generating businesses, driving organizational performance, ensuring effective execution of strategic initiatives, fostering alignment across business units, and maintaining accountability for the achievement of approved business plans and financial targets.

The Deputy CEO provides day-to-day leadership and coordination across the enterprise, ensuring that strategic priorities approved by the Board and Executive Management are translated into measurable outcomes. The role is specifically intended to create organizational capacity for the CEO to focus on strategic growth initiatives, business development, capital management, enterprise risk oversight, stakeholder engagement, funding activities, acquisitions, and long-term transformation initiatives.

The Deputy CEO will serve as Acting Chief Executive Officer when required and will represent the Company internally and externally as delegated by the CEO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Leadership & Business Performance

  • Support the CEO in the overall leadership and management of the company.
  • Drive execution of the Company's strategic plan and annual business objectives.
  • Ensure alignment between corporate strategy, departmental priorities, and individual performance objectives.
  • Lead the execution of initiatives designed to enhance profitability, efficiency, productivity, and shareholder value.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, performance excellence, collaboration, innovation, and client-centricity.
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of operational, commercial, and organizational challenges.
  • Act as the primary executive responsible for translating strategy into execution.

Commercial Leadership & Revenue Management

Provide executive oversight for the Company's core client-facing and revenue-generating businesses, including:

  • Investment Banking
  • Sales & Services
  • Wealth Management
  • Trading & Brokerage
  • Treasury & Financial Institutions

Responsibilities include:

  • Driving revenue growth and market share expansion.
  • Monitoring business performance against approved budgets and targets.
  • Identifying opportunities for revenue enhancement and business development.
  • Ensuring effective cross-selling and collaboration across business lines.
  • Supporting the development and execution of commercial strategies.
  • Monitoring client acquisition, retention, and relationship management initiatives.
  • Ensuring business units operate efficiently and profitably.

Strategic Execution & Transformation

  • Lead enterprise-wide implementation of strategic initiatives approved by the Board and Executive Committee.
  • Establish and maintain mechanisms to monitor strategic initiative delivery.
  • Ensure strategic projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with approved objectives.
  • Coordinate execution across business units and support functions.
  • Identify and escalate barriers to execution and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support organizational transformation initiatives and business process improvements.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and execution excellence.

Executive Management & Organizational Coordination

  • Serve as a key member of the Executive Management Team.
  • Coordinate management activities across business lines and support functions.
  • Chair executive and management meetings as delegated by the CEO.
  • Monitor execution of management action items and strategic priorities.
  • Drive accountability across the leadership team.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across departments.
  • Ensure alignment of resources with strategic priorities.

Financial Performance & Resource Management

  • Partner with the CEO and CFO to achieve approved financial objectives.
  • Monitor financial performance across business units.
  • Drive disciplined expense management and resource optimization.
  • Ensure business units operate within approved budgets.
  • Monitor key financial indicators and recommend corrective actions where required.
  • Support the preparation and execution of annual business plans and budgets.
  • Ensure efficient deployment of financial and operational resources.

Operational Oversight & Service Excellence

Through direct leadership and collaboration with operational stakeholders:

  • Promote operational excellence across the organization.
  • Maintain oversight of critical operational performance metrics.
  • Work closely with the VP Operations and VP Information Technology to ensure effective execution of operational and technology priorities.
  • Support service delivery improvements and client experience initiatives.
  • Ensure business continuity and operational resilience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
  • Support implementation of technology-enabled solutions to improve organizational effectiveness.

Risk, Governance & Regulatory Oversight

  • Support the CEO in maintaining a strong governance and control environment.
  • Ensure effective implementation of Board and Executive Committee decisions.
  • Monitor the status of regulatory, audit, compliance, and risk management initiatives.
  • Support the remediation of operational, regulatory, and governance issues.
  • Promote adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Foster a culture of ethical conduct and accountability throughout the organization.
  • Ensure significant issues are escalated appropriately and addressed promptly.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Represent the Company in meetings with clients, regulators, industry bodies, and business partners as delegated.
  • Support initiatives designed to enhance the Company's reputation and market position.
  • Collaborate with senior management to strengthen client and stakeholder relationships.

Acting Chief Executive Officer

  • Serve as Acting CEO in the absence of the Chief Executive Officer.
  • Exercise delegated authority as assigned by the CEO and Board of Directors.
  • Represent the Company in executive-level engagements when required.
  • Provide leadership continuity during periods of CEO absence.

ETHICS, CONDUCT & SECURITY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Uphold the highest standards of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and governance standards.
  • Safeguard confidential, proprietary, and client information.
  • Promote a culture of transparency, accountability, and responsible corporate citizenship.
  • Support cybersecurity, information security, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Report and address any identified ethical, regulatory, or operational concerns.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

  • Master's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management, Accounting, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Professional designation such as CFA®, FRM®, CAIA®, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent.

Experience

  • Minimum twelve (12) years of progressively senior leadership experience within financial services, banking, capital markets, investment management, wealth management, or a related industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple business units and senior leaders.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth, operational performance, and organizational transformation.
  • Experience leading strategic initiatives and complex organizational projects.
  • Strong understanding of financial services regulation and governance frameworks.
  • Experience operating at Executive Committee or Board level would be considered a strong asset.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Leadership & Management

  • Strategic leadership
  • Executive presence
  • Team leadership and talent development
  • Change leadership
  • Performance management
  • Decision-making and judgment

Commercial & Financial Acumen

  • Business strategy execution
  • Revenue growth and profitability management
  • Financial analysis and performance management
  • Budgeting and resource allocation
  • Capital markets and financial services knowledge

Operational Excellence

  • Enterprise execution
  • Process improvement
  • Organizational effectiveness
  • Technology enablement
  • Risk-based decision making

Relationship Management

  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Negotiation and influence
  • Conflict resolution
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Client relationship management

Personal Attributes

  • High integrity and professionalism
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Resilience and adaptability
  • Sound judgment
  • Results-driven mindset
  • Exceptional communication skills

KEY RELATIONSHIPS

Internal

  • Chief Executive Officer
  • Executive Management Team
  • Board of Directors
  • Investment Banking
  • Sales & Services
  • Wealth Management
  • Trading & Brokerage
  • Treasury & Financial Institutions
  • Asset Management & Research
  • Finance
  • Operations
  • Information Technology
  • Risk Management
  • Compliance
  • Legal
  • Human Resources

External

  • Clients
  • Regulators
  • Industry Associations
  • Financial Institutions
  • Business Partners
  • Professional Advisors
  • Vendors and Service Providers

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Financial Performance

  • Achievement of annual revenue targets.
  • Achievement of profitability objectives.
  • Cost-to-income ratio performance.
  • Business line budget achievement.

Strategic Execution

  • Percentage of strategic initiatives delivered on time.
  • Achievement of annual corporate objectives.
  • Successful implementation of transformation initiatives.
  • Closure of executive action items.

Operational Excellence

  • Service delivery performance.
  • Operational efficiency improvements.
  • Technology and operational project execution.
  • Client experience metrics.

Leadership & Culture

  • Employee engagement and leadership effectiveness.
  • Talent retention and succession readiness.
  • Cross-functional collaboration effectiveness.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction.

Governance & Risk

  • Regulatory and audit issue remediation.
  • Compliance with governance standards.
  • Timely implementation of Board and Executive directives.
  • Reduction in operational risk events.

SPECIAL WORKING CONDITIONS

  • The position operates in a fast-paced executive environment requiring significant interaction with internal and external stakeholders.
  • The role will require flexibility beyond normal business hours, including occasional evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
  • The role may involve domestic and international travel.
  • The incumbent will regularly participate in Board meetings, Executive Committee meetings, regulatory engagements, client meetings, and strategic planning sessions.

WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

The Deputy Chief Executive Officer role has been established to strengthen organizational execution, enhance management capacity, and ensure disciplined delivery of the company's strategic, commercial, and operational objectives. The position serves as the Company's principal internal leader, enabling the Chief Executive Officer to focus on growth, business development, capital management, stakeholder engagement, enterprise risk oversight, and long-term transformation initiatives.

jobs.title: German Language Specialist – AI Trainer
jobs.excerpt: Are you a German language expert eager to shape the future of AI?
jobs.description:
Are you a German language expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of linguistic discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline communication for German speakers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We’re looking for German language specialists who live and breathe German grammar, syntax, morphology, phonology, semantics, and pragmatics. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics like verb conjugation, case system (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive), word order, declensions, gender, and stylistic variation—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on language scenarios, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A master’s or PhD in German language, linguistics, or a closely related field is ideal; peer‑reviewed publications, teaching experience, or hands-on linguistic analysis projects signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your German language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Field Engineering Manager

Location

Remote (U.S.) with periodic travel to customer sites, TurbineOne facilities, demonstrations, and operational events as required.

About TurbineOne

TurbineOne is building Mission-AI for the Frontlines. Our Frontline Perception System (FPS) helps military and national security operators detect threats, accelerate decision-making, and unlock the power of AI at the tactical edge. We endeavor to build mission-valuable products in command and control, autonomy, and AI-enabled mission systems. We partner directly with frontline users to deliver mission-ready capabilities that work in real-world environments where speed, trust, reliability, and operational resilience matter most.

Our team is composed of experienced technologists, veterans, and operators committed to advancing national security through responsible innovation.

The Role

TurbineOne is seeking a Field Engineering Manager to lead our Field Engineering function, responsible for the technical leadership of field integrations, helping shape how TurbineOne deploys, scales, and supports our Frontline Perception System (FPS) in diverse operational environments.

This is a player-coach leadership role. You will manage a talented team of Field Engineers while remaining technically engaged in integration architecture, tooling development, and on-site deployment execution. You'll help the team prioritize integration efforts, remove obstacles, and ensure field teams and customers can execute missions reliably and repeatedly.

Unlike traditional SaaS organizations, TurbineOne delivers mission-critical AI software into customer-owned environments ranging from enterprise cloud infrastructure to tactical edge systems supporting U.S. national security missions. Success requires balancing engineering velocity with operational reliability, cybersecurity, and government compliance.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Engineering Operations, you will work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, and Mission Operations to ensure our field deployment capabilities continue to scale alongside our rapidly growing customer base.

What You'll Do

Lead the Field Engineering Team

  • Manage and mentor a high-performing team of field engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and technical excellence.
  • Define and standardize deployment workflows and integration playbooks to improve repeatability and reliability.
  • Ensure the operational readiness of field personnel through continuous training, robust documentation, and deployment guides.

Provide Technical Leadership

  • Set the technical strategy for field integrations, identifying gaps in current processes and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Lead the implementation and improvement of field engineering tooling, scripts (Python, Go, Bash), and automation workflows.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical integration challenges and troubleshoot high-stakes mission issues.

Build Secure Mission Infrastructure

  • Oversee the provisioning and configuration of FPS deployments within customer-owned tactical edge systems.
  • Ensure secure software delivery into comms-contested environments where speed and operational resilience are paramount.
  • Partner with Security and Product teams to align field implementation patterns with government compliance and mission requirements.

Partner Across the Company

  • Work closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Mission Operations, Field Engineering, and executive leadership.
  • Translate business priorities into actionable Field Engineering initiatives.
  • Clearly communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, timelines, and technical tradeoffs.
  • Support customer deployments, demonstrations, exercises, and mission events as needed.

Drive Mission Readiness

  • Ensure every Field Engineer is fully prepared before customer deployments, including technical readiness, certifications, and required training.
  • Maintain readiness tracking for personnel, specialized technical skills, software versions, deployment kits, and customer-specific requirements.

Build Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures supporting field operations.
  • Establish metrics and dashboards for deployment readiness, utilization, customer support, and operational performance.
  • Conduct post-deployment reviews to capture and implement operational lessons learned.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe.

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

This role is remote but requires candidates to be located in the Mountain or Pacific time zones.

Minimum requirements

The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

Preferred qualifications

  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts
  • Experience teaching or coaching developers

jobs.excerpt: As long as there have been buildings, there has been scaffolding.
jobs.description:
As long as there have been buildings, there has been scaffolding. In the caves of Lascaux, sockets in the cave wall were used to build scaffolds, allowing its Paleolithic inhabitants to craft their majestic cave-paintings, which survive to the modern day. From that time onward, every edifice has had its scaffold— from the bamboo poles that held the craftsmen of the Great Wall of China, to the steel trusses that held aloft the ironworkers who raised the Empire State Building.

Mercury is growing rapidly. As our product expands, we’re evolving the frontend foundations that support it. We have strong scaffolding in place today, but the expansion, renovation, and exploration that come next will require us to strengthen and refine it. We’re looking for an engineer to help build the battens and transoms that lift frontend work at Mercury. To put it differently, our job is to make our engineers as excited about the frontend as our customers are about our product.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Strengthen the frontend foundations every Mercury engineer builds on. Evolve our React, TypeScript, and Vite infrastructure to support teams in shipping ambitious product work with speed and confidence.
  • Help engineers move efficiently with automation. Use static analysis, local tools, and LLM coding tools to help engineers quickly resolve the schlep so they can focus on what matters.
  • Optimize our testing platform for fast feedback loops and high confidence. From unit tests to visual snapshots, you’ll provide the QA tools product teams need to move both quickly and safely.
  • Make our CI/CD pipelines stable, ergonomic, and fast. Mercury ships fast— dozens of deploys to prod per day, and hundreds more commits on PR branches. You’ll keep the pipeline humming so Mercury’s engineers stay in flow and customers see fixes faster.
  • Make our systems and organization observable. Drive decisions by unifying technical metrics from our tools with sentiment metrics from developer surveys. When that data doesn’t exist yet, you’ll build the observability that lets the team move with confidence.
  • Foster enthusiasm about frontend work at Mercury by making the good path the easy path, and by representing our work in larger venues.

The ideal candidate:

  • Has 6-8+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on the frontend and deep experience with React and Typescript.
  • Has experience leading complex engineering projects, such as projects that cut across multiple teams and functions, have multi-stage rollouts, or require research and consensus-building before action.
  • Is a confident communicator, adept at communicating across organization boundaries, and driving discussions to productive ends.
  • Has maintained internal libraries or platform tooling that other engineers depend on.
  • Prioritizes being helpful, taking initiative to make other developers' lives easier.
  • Has a thorough understanding of modern frontend developer tooling and workflows, including build systems, CI/CD, web hosting, and testing.
  • Dives into the gnarly side of the web platform— when it matters, happy to dig into Vite internals, upstream a fix, or bring a broken deploy pipeline back to life.
  • Balances practicality with ideals, pushing the team to reach an ambitious North Star while charting a course there that matches our reality.
