We’re looking for our next Overnight Client Support Specialist (Equity, Option, Crypto). Could It Be You? The Overnight Client Support Specialist (Equity, Option, Crypto) is a high-tier subject matter expert dedicated to achieving First Contact Resolution (FCR) across the full breadth of client trading activity during Questrade’s overnight and extended market hours — spanning digital assets, leveraged derivatives, equities, and options. By adopting the “You touch it, you own it” mantra, this role eliminates siloed, hand-off-heavy support, empowering the specialist to independently own the client journey across spot crypto markets, derivatives pipelines, equity and options order flow and routing, and integrated venue custody — at a time of day when day-shift trading and support resources are limited. As Questrade extends coverage beyond standard market hours, this position serves as the overnight technical authority for advanced market instruments and traditional securities alike — bridging the gap between our internal core ledger, decentralized oracle networks, global institutional liquidity providers, and the exchanges and ECNs that remain active during the overnight session.

Need more details? Keep reading… In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Serving as the primary overnight contact for complex digital asset, equity, and options inquiries, dedicated to independently resolving technical, trade, and margin issues on first contact.
  • Monitoring trading activity, multi-venue order flow, and spot/derivatives liquidity overnight to ensure seamless operational continuity between market shifts.
  • Investigating and executing trades, routing orders across ECNs/exchanges, and resolving execution or slippage issues by auditing transaction logs in OEMS and liquidity engines.
  • Diagnosing complex inquiries for perpetual and fixed-expiry futures, including troubleshooting margin maintenance, forced liquidations, funding rates, and mark-to-market pricing.
  • Managing support workflows for event contracts, validating resolution logic against decentralized oracle networks, and auditing binary outcome payouts.
  • Overseeing asset custody across exchange sub-custody vaults and using blockchain network explorers to track network congestion, gas fees, and protocol updates.
  • Resolving domestic and international fiat funding delays across virtual accounts, as well as auditing ledger breaks between core client bookkeeping, margin accounts, and external reports.
  • Monitoring KYC/AML flags, investigating security/liveness check anomalies, and documenting systemic incidents or API drops with market makers.
  • Partnering with Trade Desk, Risk, and QTG teams for clear shift handoffs while designing, updating, and maintaining internal runbooks and operational procedures.
  • Staying current on Questrade products, policies, and cross-asset market developments to proactively propose improvements to procedures and platform scaling.

So are YOU our next Overnight Client Support Specialist (Equity, Option, Crypto)? You are if you…

Position Summary

The AI Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor who builds, trains, and evaluates machine learning models. The role combines knowledge engineering and data analysis with applied reinforcement learning, and owns work end to end, from data and experiment design through training, evaluation, and reporting.

The ideal candidate brings practical reinforcement learning experience, strong engineering discipline, and the ability to collaborate closely with domain experts and communicate results to technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with domain experts to capture specialized knowledge and represent it in structured, usable form.
  • Analyze source material and datasets for quality, consistency, and coverage, and resolve issues with the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Perform exploratory and statistical analysis to inform data, modeling, and evaluation decisions.
  • Create and curate training and evaluation datasets, using both automated and human validation.
  • Design reinforcement learning environments, reward functions, and verifiers.
  • Train and fine-tune language models using supervised and reinforcement learning methods such as PPO, DPO, and GRPO.
  • Establish baselines, run ablations, and diagnose training issues such as reward hacking, instability, and data leakage.
  • Follow the research literature and bring promising techniques into practice.
  • Manage experiments rigorously, including versioned configurations, reproducible runs, experiment tracking, and compute budgeting.
  • Design and extend evaluation frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks.
  • Compare models and approaches through structured experiments and A/B testing.
  • Document results, failures, and next steps in clear technical write-ups.
  • Present findings to engineers, domain experts, and business leaders in language each audience can act on.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, machine learning, statistics, or a related field; MS or PhD preferred. Equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience training or fine-tuning language models.
  • Demonstrated reinforcement learning experience, including designing an environment and reward function end to end and training a policy in it.
  • Working knowledge of policy optimization methods for language models, such as PPO, DPO, or GRPO, including their failure modes.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, with fluency in the Hugging Face ecosystem and parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques.
  • Experience building and evaluating LLM-based agents or multi-turn systems.
  • Experience designing evaluations for language models, including held-out sets and automated grading.
  • Ability to analyze complex, detailed documentation and translate it into precise, structured, testable form.
  • Clear technical writing, with the ability to explain an experiment and its results concisely.
  • Comfort working directly with domain experts who are not machine learning practitioners.
  • Experience working with healthcare data or in another highly regulated industry is highly preferred.
  • Experience training models to produce structured or schema-constrained output is highly preferred.
  • Experience with a broad range of reinforcement learning algorithms and advanced reward design is highly preferred.
  • Experience with knowledge representation approaches such as knowledge graphs or ontologies is highly preferred.
  • Experience generating and validating synthetic data for model training is highly preferred.
  • Publications or open-source contributions in reinforcement learning, language model fine-tuning, or model evaluation is highly preferred.
  • Experience handling sensitive data, including protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA is highly preferred.
  • Timely and regular attendance.

  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations and Prerequisites

  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.

Job Description: Chief Financial Crimes Officer (CFCO)

Industry: Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, Investment

Job Type: Full-Time

Reporting To: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) / Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) / Board Risk & Compliance Committee

Job Summary

The Chief Financial Crimes Officer (CFCO) is responsible for leading the organization's enterprise-wide financial crime prevention framework, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CFT), fraud prevention, sanctions compliance, and anti-bribery & corruption programs.

This role ensures the organization is protected from financial crime risks while maintaining full compliance with regulatory requirements and international standards. The CFCO plays a critical role in safeguarding the organization's integrity, reputation, and operational resilience.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Crime Strategy & Governance

Develop and implement a comprehensive financial crime risk management strategy

Establish governance frameworks covering AML, fraud, sanctions, and anti-corruption

Align financial crime programs with enterprise risk and compliance strategies

Promote a strong financial crime compliance culture

2. AML/CFT & Sanctions Compliance

Oversee AML/CFT programs, including KYC, CDD, EDD, and transaction monitoring

Ensure compliance with international standards (e.g., FATF) and local regulations

Manage sanctions screening and compliance frameworks

Ensure timely reporting of suspicious activities (STR/SAR)

3. Fraud Risk Management

Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation frameworks

Implement controls to minimize internal and external fraud risks

Leverage advanced analytics and monitoring tools

Coordinate fraud response and recovery efforts

4. Financial Crime Detection & Investigations

Lead investigations into suspicious transactions and financial crime activities

Ensure proper escalation and reporting to regulators and authorities

Collaborate with law enforcement and financial intelligence units (FIUs)

Maintain robust case management and documentation processes

5. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

Ensure compliance with all financial crime-related regulations

Manage regulatory inspections, audits, and reporting obligations

Maintain audit-ready documentation and controls

Monitor regulatory developments and adapt frameworks accordingly

6. Technology & Analytics

Oversee financial crime technology platforms (AML, fraud detection, sanctions screening)

Implement AI/ML-based monitoring and analytics tools

Enhance detection capabilities through data-driven insights

Drive digital transformation in financial crime management

7. Training & Awareness

Develop and deliver financial crime training programs

Promote awareness of AML, fraud, and compliance risks

Ensure employees understand reporting obligations and procedures

Foster a culture of vigilance and accountability

8. Stakeholder & Regulatory Engagement

Act as the primary liaison with regulators, FIUs, and law enforcement

Provide financial crime insights to executive leadership and Board

Collaborate with risk, compliance, audit, and business units

Represent the organization in industry forums

9. Leadership & Team Management

Lead and develop financial crime compliance teams

Establish performance standards and KPIs

Foster a culture of integrity and accountability

Support talent development and succession planning

Key Requirements

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or related field

Professional certifications such as CAMS, CFE, ICA, or equivalent are highly preferred

Experience

12–18+ years of experience in financial crime, AML, fraud, compliance, or risk roles

Proven experience in senior financial crime leadership roles (e.g., CFCO, Head of Financial Crime, AML/Fraud Leader)

Strong experience in banking, financial services, insurance, or investment sectors

Skills & Competencies

Deep knowledge of AML/CFT, fraud, sanctions, and anti-corruption frameworks

Strong analytical and investigative skills

Expertise in financial crime detection and prevention technologies

Leadership and team management

Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement

High ethical standards and attention to detail

Ability to manage complex regulatory environments

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Reduction in financial crime incidents and losses

Compliance with AML/CFT and financial crime regulations

Effectiveness of detection and monitoring systems

Timeliness and accuracy of regulatory reporting

Audit and regulatory inspection outcomes

Employee awareness and training completion

Preferred Attributes

Experience in multinational or highly regulated financial institutions

Exposure to advanced analytics, AI/ML, and regtech solutions

Strong relationships with regulators and law enforcement

Ability to manage complex financial crime risks

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive executive salary

Performance-based incentives

Executive benefits and allowances

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Business Operations Associate, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: BizOps Associate, Operations Analyst, Process Analyst, Business Analyst, Business Process Associate When a process is slow, manual, or quietly leaking margin, do you want to get in and rebuild it yourself?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Business Operations Associate, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: BizOps Associate, Operations Analyst, Process Analyst, Business Analyst, Business Process Associate

When a process is slow, manual, or quietly leaking margin, do you want to get in and rebuild it yourself?

On a typical day you might map a slow process with the team that runs it in the morning, model the cost to serve a student for one program in a spreadsheet after lunch, and hand a rebuilt process and its documentation to its new owner before the end of day.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

Every time Contour doubles, the processes that ran the smaller version start to cost us: in margin, in hours, in quality. Someone has to keep rebuilding them on the ground. This is one of those roles.

About This Role

As the India-based partner to Contour's business operations lead, you are responsible for identifying operational inefficiencies and executing end-to-end process redesigns. This is a hands-on role. You will map current workflows, establish performance baselines, engineer process improvements, and manage the transition to new owners to ensure long-term stability.

Your scope includes the full build lifecycle, including analysis, metrics, and implementation. While the Business Operations lead defines strategic priorities and manages cross-functional alignment with our onshore and COO teams, you own the execution and the tangible results.

You will be the foundational operator for this function in India. Success in this role requires a measure-first methodology, ensuring every project is backed by data, and a focus on sustainability, building processes that operate independently after handoff.

What You Will Do

  • Identify operational bottlenecks:Audit support, publishing, and operations workflows to isolate processes that are manual, redundant, or failing under high volume.

  • Analyze and re-engineer processes:Map current workflows, establish performance baselines, redesign for efficiency, and manage implementation until metrics improve and stabilize.

  • Model unit economics:Quantify the cost to serve a student per program and proactively monitor overhead to prevent margin erosion.

  • Leverage automation:Evaluate and implement automation tools where appropriate, while exercising the discipline to maintain manual processes when that is the more efficient choice.

  • Ensure process sustainability:Create clear documentation, designate ownership, and provide training to ensure rebuilt processes are sustainable and do not regress.

  • Maintain performance visibility:Track two or three active re-engineering projects with clear baseline data, projected outcomes, and completion timelines for executive review.

If a better tool exists for something we run by hand, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • Operational expertise:3 to 5 years of experience in business operations, process improvement, or operational analysis with a record of driving measurable change.

  • Process mapping proficiency:Ability to model cost and volume dynamics on a whiteboard or in a spreadsheet without requiring oversight.

  • Technical adaptability:Demonstrated ability to build and deploy automations that others rely on, balanced by the judgment to know when to leave a process manual.

  • Metrics-driven mindset:Proven ability to establish performance baselines prior to intervention and ensure results are sustained post-implementation.

  • Strong communication skills:Ability to produce clear, actionable documentation that enables team members to execute processes independently.

  • Cross-timezone collaboration:Comfort working across India business hours with regular overlap into Australian time zones.

Nice to Have

  • EdTech, education services, or a student-facing organisation in your background

  • Experience moving a metric across a team or site you did not directly manage, by changing the process rather than by authority over people.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or similar training. It is useful here, but we care that you have done the work, not which belt you hold

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What Good Looks Like

  • Evidence-based baselines:Every project initiates with a documented, measured before-state rather than an estimate.

  • Sustainable outcomes:Processes are designed to run independently, requiring minimal ongoing support from you.

  • Transparent tracking:A live project scoreboard displays current status, performance metrics, and deadlines for all in-flight initiatives.

  • Margin optimization:You consistently reduce the cost-to-serve per student through process improvements that remain invisible to the student.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience, and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a practical process-improvement task, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Business Operations Lead, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a process you rebuilt hands-on: the before number, the after number, and who runs it now.

CRS JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Humanitarian Operations Technical Advisor I, RAPID - ESAROReports to: Humanitarian Operations TA II, RAPIDDepartment: HRD

Position duration: until January 30, 2028

Location: Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, Ethiopia, Sudan, South Sudan, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Malawi, Zambia

Note: this is the general coverage area of this role; this position is a Remote based position, and we will consider only qualified applicants located in these countries. Relocation is not available

Project Overview

Catholic Relief Services is implementing a global emergency response initiative designed to deliver timely, life‑saving humanitarian assistance in rapidly evolving crises worldwide. Over 18 months, the program enables fast, flexible action to address urgent needs arising from sudden shocks and protracted emergencies. It supports critical humanitarian sectors through context‑appropriate assistance while emphasizing operational readiness, locally led implementation, accountability to affected communities, and safe, dignified programming. Emergency Program Managers will support Kenya, Madagascar, Mozambique, Ethiopia, Sudan, South Sudan, Uganda, Zimbabwe, Malawi, and Zambia providing readiness and response support based on evolving needs, with the composition of countries adapted according to context and operational priorities. The initiative strengthens the organization’s ability to respond at speed and scale in complex and resource‑constrained environments, ensuring help reaches people most in need when it matters most.

Job Summary

The RAPID Humanitarian Operations Technical Advisor I provides deployable, technical and operational support to CRS humanitarian emergency responses under the guidance of HRD staff. The role contributes to CRS’ capacity, supporting target countries across a specified focus region, of emergency operations across core humanitarian functions, with primary emphasis on supply chain management—particularly procurement and logistics—and emergency suboffice setup.

The Humanitarian Operations Technical Advisor I works closely with colleagues and other technical departments to support the establishment and strengthening operational functions, including human resources, finance, security, ICT, administration, and fleet management. S/he supports the application of CRS operational standards and donor requirements, contributes to operational learning and guidance implementation, and assists with capacity strengthening efforts for CRS country programs and partners to promote efficient, compliant, and effective humanitarian response operations.

Roles & Responsibilities

General

  • Provide rapid deployment, in-country operational surge support during humanitarian emergencies, applying operational experience to support procurement, logistics, supply chain processes, and emergency suboffice setup.
  • Support emergency operations planning, implementation, and close out through remote and onsite technical assistance, aligned with CRS standards, donor requirements, and good humanitarian practice.
  • Assist with the setup and functioning of relief delivery systems, tools, and operational processes in active emergency contexts.

  • Provide operational support across HR, finance, security, GKIM, administration, and fleet management, in coordination with relevant CRS technical and departmental leads.

Capacity Strengthening and Accompaniment

  • Provide on the job support and basic technical accompaniment to CRS staff and local partners during emergency responses.
  • Support delivery of operations focused trainings, briefings, and orientations for emergency staff and partners.

  • Contribute to collaboration with local organizations and national and international CRS teams to strengthen operational capacity for emergency response.

Technical Standards, Learning, and Compliance

  • Support the application of humanitarian operations standards, tools, and guidance for field operations and emergency supply chains.
  • Contribute to updates and dissemination of tools and resources related to the Emergency Field Operations Manual (EFOM).
  • Support operational learning by helping document lessons learned, challenges, and good practices from emergency deployments.
  • Assist with emergency budgeting, basic cost tracking and support compliance with public donor regulations and operational requirements.
  • Management of supply chain and accounting systems in new or rapidly evolving emergency responses.

  • Promote awareness of staff care, safety, and security practices in emergency environments.

Coordination and Representation Support

  • Support CRS participation in humanitarian coordination, cluster, and operations forums, as requested and under guidance.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of emergency coordination mechanisms.
  • Working knowledge of humanitarian supply chain operations, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and basic commodity tracking in emergency contexts.
  • Basic understanding of emergency field operations setup, including sub-office establishment, relief delivery processes, and operational coordination.
  • Familiarity with donor regulations and compliance requirements relevant to humanitarian operations.
  • Awareness of CRS operational standards, tools, and policies, including emergency operations guidance
  • Strong familiarity with SPHERE, Core Humanitarian Standards
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions independently.
  • Extremely flexible and can cope with stressful situations in emergency environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide leadership in strategic planning initiatives
  • Ability to work both as a motivating member and a leader of a diverse team
  • Strong knowledge of effective management practices desired
  • Strong MS Office skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience setting up and managing humanitarian supply chains
  • Experience engaging partners and strengthening partnerships. Knowledge of CRS partnership strategy is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ICT/GIS an asset.
  • Familiarity with CRS programming principles preferred.

Required Languages: Proficiency (verbal and written) in English and at least one of the following languages: French, Portuguese, Spanish and Arabic.

Travel:Must be able and willing to travel at least 50% of time often at very short notice (within 48 hours) and for an average of four-six weeks (with a maximum of two consecutive months under exceptional circumstances). Should have the capacity to live and work in difficult/stressful environments and serve wherever agency needs dictate.

Supervisory Responsibilities: No

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
Are you ready to leverage your talents to make healthcare better for everyone?
Do you want the opportunity to give back to your community?
Do you want to have fun at work?
Then join the growing team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States!

Summary

Under general direction of the Executive Director or Vice President, Medicaid Services, this position provides strategic and operational leadership for an assigned portfolio of Medicaid Services external quality review (EQR) contracts, state customers, and programs. The Director is accountable for contract performance, customer satisfaction, budget management, quality and timeliness of deliverables, workforce planning, and staff development. The position serves as a liaison between a state and project that leads to support cross-functional initiatives and EQR tasks; supports business development and proposal activities; and translates EQR strategy into effective deliverables. The Director provides leadership and guidance to project managers, and other assigned staff and serves as a senior point of contact for state customers and internal partners.

Essential Competencies, Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic oversight for an assigned portfolio of Medicaid Services EQR contracts, ensuring alignment with contract requirements and applicable state and federal requirements.

  • Serve as the senior relationship leader for state Medicaid agencies, managed care entities, subcontractors, and other stakeholders; proactively resolve concerns affecting customer satisfaction.

  • Direct project planning, implementation, and performance monitoring across scope, staffing, schedules, budgets, and deliverables.

  • Lead and coach project managers and other assigned staff by setting expectations, monitoring performance, supporting development, and fostering accountability and collaboration.

  • Manage recruitment, selection, onboarding, training, evaluation, counseling, and corrective action for assigned staff in coordination with Human Resources and executive leadership.

  • Ensure customer deliverables are accurate, high quality, internally reviewed and approved, and submitted on time.

  • Leverage tools such as SharePoint and Copilot to streamline workflows and improve deliverable production.

  • Monitor financial performance, including staffing plans, labor utilization, budgets, and forecasts, in coordination with Finance and executive leadership.

  • Identify and mitigate operational, contractual, staffing, and customer risks; escalate significant concerns to the Executive Director or Vice President.

  • Advise project leads on project design, data collection and abstraction, analysis, quality review, technical assistance, training, and report development, as applicable.

  • Advance standardized, scalable processes and promote continuous improvement, innovation, and knowledge sharing across projects.

  • Coordinate with HSAG departments and shared services to resolve cross-functional issues and support high-quality contract execution.

  • Lead or support business development activities, including proposals, presentations, scope of development, and pricing assumptions.

  • Support division planning, resource allocation, succession planning, performance reporting, and organizational priorities under the direction of the Executive Director or Vice President.

  • Represent HSAG professionally in customer meetings, presentations, conferences, and other external forums.

  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with company policies, contractual obligations, and regulatory requirements.

  • Work with the Executive Director or Vice President to minimize extended work hours, which may occasionally be required to meet project deadlines.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and/or Experience

  • Master's degree in healthcare administration, public health, health services, business administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • Minimum of eight years of progressively responsible experience in Medicaid, managed care, healthcare quality, external quality review, regulatory oversight, auditing, consulting, or related field.

  • Minimum of five years of management or supervisory experience, including responsibility for complex projects, customer relationships, budgets, and staff performance.

  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple contracts or large, complex initiatives or projects and delivering results through other leaders and cross-functional teams.

  • Experience with state Medicaid agencies, Medicaid managed care organizations, external quality review activities, or related state and federal healthcare programs preferred.

  • Experience supporting proposal development and business growth activities preferred.

Other Qualifications

  • Excellent leadership, judgment, problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.

  • Excellent oral and written communication, presentation, facilitation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to establish credibility and effective working relationships with customers, executive leaders, staff, subcontractors, and external stakeholders.

  • Ability to analyze complex operational, contractual, financial, and customer issues; develop practical solutions; and communicate recommendations clearly.

  • Ability to manage competing priorities, multiple projects, and overlapping deadlines while maintaining attention to detail and quality.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office applications, including Microsoft Copilot, and the ability to learn and use other business software.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and consistently represent HSAG in a professional manner.

  • Ability to travel statewide and out of state as needed. Travel is expected to be limited and generally less than 5 percent.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Disclaimer

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts or working conditions associated with the position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, management reserves the right to revise the position or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g., emergencies, changes in personnel, work load, rush jobs requiring non-regular work hours, or technological developments).

jobs.excerpt: Our client is seeking talented Junior Software Engineers to participate in an innovative artificial intelligence initiative focused on improving the quality, accuracy, and technical capabilities of advanced AI models.
jobs.description:
Our client is seeking talented Junior Software Engineers to participate in an innovative artificial intelligence initiative focused on improving the quality, accuracy, and technical capabilities of advanced AI models.

This fully remote, contract-based opportunity is designed for software engineers with experience at leading technology companies who are interested in applying their programming knowledge to real-world AI development challenges.

Selected professionals will evaluate AI-generated code, develop complex programming challenges, analyze technical solutions, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, efficiency, maintainability, and overall software quality.
  • Develop challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases.
  • Review and assess AI-generated technical reasoning involving algorithms, data structures, debugging, software architecture, and system design.
  • Identify errors, inefficiencies, and potential improvements in AI-generated software solutions.
  • Provide clear, detailed, and actionable written technical feedback to support continuous AI model improvement.
  • Apply software engineering best practices to assess code quality and technical decision-making.
  • Contribute to projects focused on advancing the capabilities of next-generation AI systems.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Junior Software Engineer – AI Code Evaluation
  • Work Arrangement: 100% Remote
  • Employment Type: Independent Contractor
  • Compensation: USD $150–$200 per hour
  • Available Opportunities: Up to 100 positions
  • Preferred Location: United States and other English-speaking countries
  • Industry: Artificial Intelligence / Software Engineering

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This position offers software engineers the opportunity to apply their technical expertise to advanced artificial intelligence projects while working remotely.

Candidates will contribute to the evaluation and improvement of AI-generated software, gaining exposure to emerging technologies and complex engineering challenges.

Join an exciting initiative helping shape the future of AI-powered software development.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year of professional experience as a Software Engineer at a leading technology company, with at least part of that experience gained within the last 3 years.
  • Strong programming fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, debugging, and code optimization.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, system design, and software engineering best practices.
  • Ability to review, evaluate, and identify errors or inefficiencies in complex code.
  • Experience analyzing technical solutions and assessing code correctness, quality, and maintainability.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain technical decisions and provide detailed feedback.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote, contractor-based environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working at a top-tier technology company or within a highly technical software engineering environment.
  • Based in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, or another English-speaking country.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, developing technical assessments, or designing programming challenges.
  • Familiarity with evaluating AI-generated code or working with AI-assisted software development tools.
  • Ability to create challenging programming problems, reference solutions, and comprehensive test cases.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering concepts involving algorithms, debugging, architecture, and system design.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in software engineers who have gained hands-on experience at leading technology organizations and can demonstrate strong technical judgment, programming proficiency, and the ability to communicate complex engineering concepts clearly.

Candidates should be comfortable evaluating sophisticated software solutions, identifying technical weaknesses, and contributing to the improvement of advanced AI systems.

Important: This opportunity is intended for engineers with relevant professional experience. Recent graduates without qualifying software engineering experience may not meet the selection criteria.

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote
Contract Type: Independent Contractor
Compensation: USD $150–$200 per hour
Open Positions: Up to 100 opportunities
Preferred Locations: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, and other English-speaking countries.

About the Opportunity

This is a project-based opportunity for software engineers interested in contributing to advanced artificial intelligence development.

Selected candidates will work remotely on technical assignments involving AI-generated code evaluation, software engineering challenges, debugging, and technical reasoning.

Application and Selection Process

Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an application and may be required to participate in technical assessments to demonstrate their software engineering knowledge, analytical capabilities, and written communication skills.

Participation in the selection process does not guarantee an assignment or contract offer.

Important Considerations

  • Candidates must have relevant professional software engineering experience.
  • Previous employment at a leading technology company is an important selection criterion.
  • Strong written English communication skills are essential.
  • Applicants should be comfortable working independently and providing detailed technical evaluations.
  • Final selection, compensation, project assignments, and contractual terms are subject to client evaluation and approval.

Our client is a leading organization in the artificial intelligence industry, collaborating with top technology companies and AI research teams to advance the development of next-generation AI systems.

The company is seeking talented software engineers to contribute to innovative projects focused on evaluating AI-generated code, solving complex programming challenges, and improving the reasoning, accuracy, and performance of advanced AI models.

This opportunity offers the flexibility of remote contract work, competitive compensation, and the chance to contribute to cutting-edge artificial intelligence initiatives alongside highly skilled technical professionals.

jobs.title: Work From Home to Promote Sustainable Food (Thailand)
jobs.excerpt: As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will build relationships and collaborate with leading domestic and multinational food companies (restaurant chains, caterers, retailers, hospitality groups, and packaged good companies) to help them incorporate sustainable foods such as cage-free eggs and plant-based food into their supply chain.
jobs.description:
As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will build relationships and collaborate with leading domestic and multinational food companies (restaurant chains, caterers, retailers, hospitality groups, and packaged good companies) to help them incorporate sustainable foods such as cage-free eggs and plant-based food into their supply chain.

In recent years, in response to increasing concern for sustainability and animal welfare, over 2,000 companies worldwide and over 70 leading food brands in Asia and have pledged to use cage-free eggs in their operations, including Burger King, Nestle, Danone, and many others. Many of these commitments in Asia have been generated by Lever Foundation and the colleagues you will be working with. Cage-free eggs are far more humane for animals, are much higher in food safety for consumers, and have become an important part of many companies' corporate sustainability pledges.

In this full-time role with Lever Foundation, you will help educate more companies on the sustainability, animal welfare, and economic benefits of making this supply chain shift. You will provide industry updates, connect these companies with potential suppliers, and provide other resources to help them understand and make progress on the issue. In order to identify and engage new food companies, you will do online research, write and send emails, make calls, and conduct visits and meetings with companies.

You’ll work from home and hours are highly flexible. You’ll have wonderful colleagues in Asia, Europe, and the US who will work with and support you. You’ll stay in close touch with them through calls, email and messages.

Through this work you will have hands-on experience working with leading food companies on corporate sustainability, with room for advancement to managerial or other positions.

We do not require any particular educational or work background; instead, we're looking for a candidate with the specific personality traits and skills needed to succeed in this job:

Excellent interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to persuade and engage others

Ability to work highly independently, with a very strong work ethic

Resiliency — when you are ignored or brushed off, it does not discourage you but rather motivates you to try harder

Excellent verbal and written English and Thai

Personal interest in sustainability, animal welfare, or food safety

Calling all ambitious, personable individuals who want a job with meaning! Want a full-time job working from home (some travel required) at a job that makes the world a better place? Set your own full-time hours, with room for growth, competitive salary and a results-driven atmosphere. This is a great job for productive, self-directed people who are highly skilled at interpersonal communication, who are resilient, and who want to do work that makes a difference. Must be fluent in English and Thai.

Lever Foundation is a global non-profit that works to promote animal welfare in Asia. You can learn more about Lever at:

In the sustainable food sector, we work with large food companies, providing them with professional consulting services to help them add sustainable food to their supply chains, thereby improving food safety and food quality, and improving animal welfare. Our partners include leading food and beverage chains Starbucks, Burger King, Costa Coffee, international retailers Metro and Costco, as well as high-end hotel chains Marriott, Hyatt, and many others.

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. We collaborate across the company with sales, systems, and product marketing to drive efficiency and impact.

jobs.title: Payroll Systems Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Our missionWe're making Africa the first cashless continent.
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is seeking a Payroll Systems Analyst to help us streamline our payroll operations and build the tools that connect payroll to the rest of the business. We're looking for someone who is excited about solving complex process, data and technical challenges in a high-growth fintech environment, and who knows that every payroll error lands on a real person's payslip.

The Payroll Systems Analyst will report to the HR Systems Lead within the HR Technology team. You'll join just after we go live on our new HRIS. In this role, you'll act as a bridge between our Payroll, People and Finance teams and our technical capabilities, designing processes and building tools that handle multi-country payroll, different statutory and tax regimes, multiple currencies, and varying local requirements.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Defining and strengthening our Payroll team's ways of working

    • Mapping how payroll runs today in each of our markets: inputs, calendars, cut-offs, approvals, handoffs with HR and Finance, and the in-country providers involved. You'll identify where effort is manual, duplicated or at risk.
    • Aligning global payroll standards, system controls and RACIs across countries, while keeping room for the local statutory requirements that can't be standardized.
    • Defining how payroll requests, changes and issues are received, tracked and resolved, for example through our internal service desk, so that nothing depends on email threads or individual memory.
    • Training Payroll team members on new processes and tools, and acting as their primary partner for systems questions.

    Building our in-house payroll-to-finance reconciliation tool

    • Owning the design and delivery of an internal tool that reconciles payroll outputs from our providers against the HRIS and the general ledger across entities and countries, from requirements through build, testing and rollout.
    • Defining the reconciliation logic with Payroll and Finance: headcount, gross-to-net, employer costs, accruals, cost center and entity mapping, FX, and variance thresholds.
    • Automating data ingestion from payroll provider reports and HRIS extracts, and building clear exception reporting so the teams spend their time on discrepancies rather than on matching rows.
    • Iterating on the tool after launch based on user feedback and month-end close needs, and documenting it so it can be maintained and extended.

    Providing core Payroll Systems support

    • Supporting the stabilization of HRIS-to-payroll data flows after our new HRIS go-live, so that hires, job and compensation changes, leave and terminations reach payroll accurately and on time.
    • Analyzing payroll workflows and integrations to recommend improvements, with a focus on reducing manual inputs and spreadsheet handoffs between HR, Payroll and Finance.
    • Supporting future payroll provider changes, consolidations, integrations and new-market launches.
    • Coordinating the testing of legislative and system updates so that statutory changes (tax tables, social contributions, minimum wage) are applied correctly.

    Driving Payroll Data Quality and Reporting

    • Owning payroll data quality across systems and conducting regular audits to find and resolve discrepancies.
    • Developing payroll reporting and dashboards that support HR, Finance and business decisions, such as payroll cost by entity and country, and period-over-period variance.
    • Managing data privacy and access controls for sensitive pay and banking data in line with GDPR and other applicable regulations.

Key details

  • Employees in remote positions at Wave can work remotely from anywhere (between UTC -8 and +4) with reliable internet access in the US, Canada, United Kingdom, Belgium, Poland, Spain, Senegal, Cote d’Ivoire, Mali, Uganda, Kenya, or Ghana.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, we are offering an annual gross salary range of $88,100 -$125,900 depending on your level and location.
  • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
  • 6 months fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
  • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.
  • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Fluent in English and French.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in HRIS, payroll operations, payroll systems or payroll accounting, ideally in a multi-country or multi-entity organization.
  • Experience and understanding of end-to-end payroll processes, including inputs, calendars and cut-offs, gross-to-net, statutory deductions, and payments.
  • Hands-on experience reconciling payroll to the general ledger, including employer costs, accruals, and cost center and entity mapping.
  • Experience working with third-party or in-country payroll providers, and with the data flows between the HRIS, payroll and finance systems.
  • Demonstrated experience documenting, standardizing and improving processes, such as controls, checklists, sign-off flows and RACIs.
  • Advanced knowledge of data management, analysis and reporting
  • Experience building tools or automations (scripts, Apps Script, low-code platforms like Workato or Zapier), or a strong interest in learning to.
  • Experience with Business Intelligence systems like Sigma, Power BI or Looker.
  • Effective written and verbal communication to collaborate with Payroll, HR and Finance stakeholders and explain technical information to non-technical audiences.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Nice to have:

  • Payroll experience in francophone West Africa (e.g. CNPS, IPRES/CSS, ITS/IRPP) or with OHADA accounting.
  • Experience with Workday or another enterprise HRIS.
  • A payroll certification (CPP, FPC, CIPP)

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Développeur/Développeuse logiciel senior (Bases de données)
jobs.excerpt: Aperçu du rôleLorsque les radiologues reçoivent le bon examen au bon moment, les patients obtiennent des réponses plus rapidement.
jobs.description:
Aperçu du rôle

Lorsque les radiologues reçoivent le bon examen au bon moment, les patients obtiennent des réponses plus rapidement. Derrière chaque liste de travail, recherche et attribution se trouve une base de données qui doit répondre rapidement et avec précision. À titre de Développeur/Développeuse logiciel senior spécialisé en bases de données au sein de l’équipe InteleOrchestrator, vous contribuerez à moderniser une plateforme reposant sur Microsoft SQL Server qui simplifie les flux de travail en radiologie pour les établissements de santé partout dans le monde.

Vous développerez les solutions qui font évoluer la base de données : refonte de schémas et de requêtes, simplification de couches d’accès aux données héritées et migration vers des approches fortement typées et rigoureusement testées, tout en maintenant les systèmes opérationnels pour les cliniciens.

Il s’agit d’un rôle de développement logiciel pratique, et non d’un poste d’administration de bases de données. Votre temps sera consacré au code, aux plans d’exécution SQL et aux revues de code plutôt qu’aux sauvegardes, aux mises à jour de serveurs ou aux opérations d’infrastructure.

La réussite dans ce poste se traduit par un accès aux données plus rapide, plus sécuritaire et plus facile à maintenir, réduisant ainsi la charge administrative et permettant aux cliniciens de consacrer davantage de temps aux soins des patients.

Principales responsabilités

  • Diriger des projets complexes de refonte de bases de données au sein d’un schéma SQL Server mature et de grande envergure, notamment en restructurant des tables, clés et index, en éliminant des structures héritées et en normalisant les données au moyen de migrations incrémentales sécurisées et versionnées (par exemple avec Liquibase), sans interruption des opérations cliniques.

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes de performance à la source en analysant les plans d’exécution, en optimisant les requêtes SQL, en remplaçant les traitements ligne par ligne par des traitements par lots, et en concevant des stratégies d’indexation adaptées aux charges de travail réelles.

  • Moderniser la couche d’accès aux données en migrant du SQL hérité et du SQL intégré dans du code PHP et C# vers des dépôts Kotlin et jOOQ fortement typés, tout en préservant les comportements existants grâce à des tests de caractérisation, de régression et de montée en charge.

  • Renforcer la sécurité et la fiabilité de l’accès aux données en éliminant les vulnérabilités liées aux injections SQL, en appliquant des pratiques cohérentes de verrouillage, d’isolation et de gestion des délais d’exécution, et en mettant en place des mécanismes de diagnostic permettant de relier l’activité de la base de données au code qui la génère.

  • Développer les outils facilitant les changements de schéma et les déploiements, notamment des pipelines de migration et de mise à niveau basés sur Gradle et CI/CD, des environnements de test SQL Server conteneurisés et des contrôles automatisés permettant de détecter les régressions avant la mise en production.

  • Contribuer à l’orientation technique de la plateforme en définissant les normes SQL et les standards d’accès aux données, en documentant les conventions et en participant aux décisions d’architecture ainsi qu’à l’évolution de la feuille de route technique d’InteleOrchestrator.

  • Collaborer avec les autres développeurs et les accompagner par le biais de revues de code, de partages de connaissances et de mentorat technique afin de favoriser le développement de code d’accès aux données performant, sécurisé et maintenable.

Qualifications et expérience

  • Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Minimum de 7 ans d’expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel, dont au moins 4 ans consacrés au développement et à la refonte de bases de données en environnement de production (SQL, schémas et couches d’accès aux données).
  • Maîtrise avancée de T-SQL sous Microsoft SQL Server, incluant l’optimisation de requêtes, l’analyse de plans d’exécution, les stratégies d’indexation, les tables temporaires, les CTE, les fonctions analytiques (window functions), les procédures stockées et la conception orientée ensembles de données. Une expérience avec PostgreSQL est également un atout.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la modernisation progressive de schémas relationnels complexes et hérités ainsi que du code applicatif qui en dépend, dans des environnements déjà en production.
  • Maîtrise de Kotlin ou Java, ou d’un langage équivalent, pour le développement de services back-end utilisant Spring Boot ou un cadre similaire.
  • Expérience pratique avec des outils de migration et de gestion de versions de bases de données tels que Liquibase ou Flyway, intégrés à des pipelines CI/CD basés sur Git.
  • Excellente compréhension de la concurrence, des mécanismes de verrouillage, des niveaux d’isolation et de l’intégrité transactionnelle, ainsi que de leur impact sur le comportement des applications sous charge.
  • Solides connaissances des pratiques sécuritaires d’accès aux données, notamment la prévention des injections SQL et la protection des renseignements sensibles des patients.
  • Expérience au sein d’équipes Agile utilisant Gradle, Git et des pratiques modernes DevOps dans des environnements Windows et Linux.

Qualifications souhaitées et exigences particulières

  • Expérience avec jOOQ ou des bibliothèques SQL fortement typées similaires, ainsi qu’avec la génération de code à partir de schémas de bases de données.
  • Expérience dans la lecture, la maintenance ou la migration de code hérité en PHP et/ou C# (.NET).
  • Expérience avec des approches de tests de bases de données telles que Testcontainers, les environnements SQL Server basés sur Docker, les tests de caractérisation (« golden master ») et les tests de charge ou de montée en capacité.
  • Connaissance des outils de diagnostic SQL Server (Query Store, DMV, Extended Events) ainsi que des plateformes d’observabilité telles que Datadog ou New Relic.
  • Expérience avec les services de données AWS, notamment Amazon RDS pour SQL Server.
  • Expérience des normes de données en santé telles que HL7 et DICOM, ou dans d’autres industries réglementées (FDA, FAA ou équivalent).
  • Lieu : Ce poste est ouvert aux candidats résidant au Canada ou aux États-Unis.

This job description is not a comprehensive list of tasks or requirements and Intelerad reserves the right to change it at any time.

Le salaire de base pour ce poste varie entre $100,000 to $135,000/yr CAD. Le salaire peut varier en fonction des connaissances, des compétences et de l'expérience liées au poste. Intelerad est une entreprise qui offre une rémunération globale. Le salaire dépend du poste proposé. Applicants, employees and former employees are protected from employment discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age , disability and genetic information (including family medical history). Intelerad is dedicated to the fulfillment of this policy regarding all aspects of employment, including but not limited to recruiting, hiring, placement, transfer, training, promotion, rates of pay, and other compensation, termination, and all other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment.

 

Intelerad is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity for qualified individuals with disabilities. Chez Intelerad, nous croyons que le chemin vers les réponses en matière de soins de santé doit être clair, que vous attendiez un diagnostic ou que vous essayiez d'en accélérer un. Nos solutions d’imagerie médicale rationalisent le flux d’informations, simplifient les processus complexes, maximisent l’efficacité et mettent en lumière l’inconnu. Nous permettons aux médecins d'apporter aux patients les réponses dont ils ont besoin plus rapidement et d'améliorer les résultats pour tous. Grâce à une imagerie plus accessible, on sort les patients de l’obscurité.

Basée à Raleigh, en Caroline du Nord, et à Montréal, Intelerad compte près de 800 employés dans des bureaux répartis dans quatre pays. L'entreprise offre à près de 2 000 organisations de soins de santé à travers le monde la rapidité, l'évolutivité et la simplicité nécessaires pour augmenter les performances de l'entreprise tout en, surtout, en améliorant les résultats des patients. Les solutions d'entreprise modernes d'Intelerad ont été récompensées par le prix « Best in KLAS », se classant à la première place dans la catégorie « PACS Europe (UK/Irlande) » du rapport « Best in KLAS : Global Software (Non-US) » de 2026.

jobs.title: Senior Node.js Developer (Poland)
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreFlosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We’re not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We’re a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we’ve earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You’ll Build

  • High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
  • Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
  • Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
  • CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
  • Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale

Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale.
  • Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it.
  • Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why.
  • Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale.
  • Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles.

Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)

  • Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us.
  • Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products.
  • Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management.
  • Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem.

The Kind of Person We’re Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you’re building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that’s who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don’t check whether it’s “your responsibility” — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don’t wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn’t just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you’re looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn’t the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that’s scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
  • Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
  • A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
  • The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
  • Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
  • A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
  • Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

  • Capacidad para crear, ejecutar y documentar casos de prueba.
  • Experiencia reportando y realizando seguimiento a errores o incidencias.
  • Conocimiento de pruebas para aplicaciones o plataformas web.
  • Capacidad para analizar resultados, identificar inconsistencias y documentar evidencias.

  • Familiaridad con mensajes transaccionales o ISO 8583.
  • Experiencia con herramientas como Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail o similares.

  • Conocimientos básicos de consultas SQL.
  • Experiencia con metodologías ágiles.

Competencias

  • Atención al detalle.
  • Organización y seguimiento.
  • Resolución de problemas.
  • Comunicación efectiva.
  • Trabajo en equipo.
  • Orientación a resultados.
  • Responsabilidad y autonomía.
  • Capacidad de aprendizaje.

Modalidad

Trabajo principalmente remoto, con disponibilidad para asistir ocasionalmente a reuniones, capacitaciones o actividades requeridas por la compañía. También se podrá requerir disponibilidad para interactuar con clientes y equipos ubicados en diferentes países.

Lo que ofrecemos

  • Participación en proyectos tecnológicos internacionales relacionados con medios de pago.
  • Oportunidades de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.
  • Capacitaciones y desarrollo de conocimientos especializados.
  • Flexibilidad y trabajo remoto.
  • Tiempo libre remunerado de acuerdo con las políticas aplicables.
  • Bonos semestrales por resultados, sujetos al cumplimiento de objetivos, desempeño y condiciones establecidas por la compañía.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

Dentons Europe is currently seeking a Information Security Engineer, specializing in Microsoft cloud technologies to play a key role in strengthening and evolving our security landscape.

In this role, you will design and implement security controls across cloud and hybrid environments, with a strong focus on Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Azure. You will operate at the intersection of architecture and execution shaping security decisions, guiding technical teams, and ensuring that systems, applications, and integrations meet the firm’s security, compliance, and reliability standards.

As a trusted advisor and technical authority, you will work closely with Information Security, IT, and business stakeholders across Europe, embedding security into the design and delivery of technology solutions while continuously improving the organization’s overall security posture.

This is an opportunity to make a visible, enterprise-wide impact in a complex, international environment.

You will primarily be accountable for

  • Design, implement, and maintain robust security and compliance controls across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, and hybrid environments.
  • Act as a cybersecurity subject-matter expert for Europe and Country IT teams providing clear, practical guidance on secure design and implementation.
  • Assist in embedding security into application, infrastructure, identity, endpoint, and integration architectures (including APIs and data flows), ensuring alignment with secure development lifecycle practices and architectural standards.
  • Collaborate with architects, engineers, project teams, and business stakeholders to define security requirements as integral part of enterprise initiatives and technology solutions from the outset.
  • Work closely with SOC and CSIRT teams to support incident response activities, including investigation, containment, and remediation, and ensure lessons learned are reflected in improved controls and architecture.
  • Lead end-to-end vulnerability management activities, including vulnerability scanning, assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking with system owners and technical teams.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across cloud and enterprise environments, driving measurable improvements in the firm’s security posture.
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and technical leadership for complex or high-impact security issues.
  • Develop and maintain security documentation, standards, reports, and control frameworks.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in cloud security or enterprise cybersecurity engineering
  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft Azure security, including at least two of:
    • Defender for Cloud
    • Microsoft Sentinel
    • Infrastructure / Network Security (IaaS)
    • Application and API security
    • Storage and database security
  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft 365 security, including at least two of:
    • Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management
    • Microsoft Purview, data protection and compliance
    • Microsoft 365 Defender suite
    • Intune / Endpoint Manager
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Security architecture principles, including Zero Trust, defense-in-depth and least privilege
    • Hybrid cloud environments and system integrations
    • Vulnerability management, including analyzing penetration testing and coordinating remediation of results
    • API security and modern integration technologies
  • Scripting and automation skills, e.g., PowerShell, Python or Bash
  • Strong interest in security architecture, with a desire to deepen exposure and grow toward architectural responsibilities

Professional experience

  • Proven experience designing and implementing secure solutions in Microsoft technologies-based enterprise environments
  • Experience working with large-scale or multi-country IT environments
  • Solid exposure to security operations, incident response and security tooling
  • Experience collaborating across infrastructure, development and business teams

Benefits

    • 25 days of vacation/year
    • 3 sick days/year
    • Meal lump-sum
    • MultiSport card
    • Multipass card
    • Home Office allowance

jobs.excerpt: Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.
jobs.description:
Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.

We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today.

Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision.

Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –Apply Now

Profile Summary:

The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for leading the design and implementation of complex software features and systems. This role contributes significantly to architecture decisions, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates across teams to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that align with business priorities.


Profile Description:
